engines.noteZh: 雙引擎

seats.noteZh: 典型三級艙；最大 440 座

recognitionZh: 下單翼，翼尖是向上彎起的鯊鰭小翼，線條圓滑。
兩台勞斯萊斯 Trent XWB 大風扇引擎，吊掛在機翼之下。
廣體雙通道機身；駕駛艙窗外有一圈黑色「眼罩」邊框，是全機最搶眼的記號。
傳統十字尾翼，垂直尾翼高大，末端有水平尾翼。
recognitionEn: Low wing with curved, upward sharklet wingtips.
Two large Rolls-Royce Trent XWB fan engines under the wings.
Widebody twin-aisle fuselage; the black “bandit mask” frame around the cockpit windows is the quickest giveaway.
Conventional tail with a tall vertical fin and rear horizontal stabilisers.

photo.author: km30192002
photo.creditZh: 相片：km30192002／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY 2.0）· 國泰航空 A350-900（B-LRA）爬升中
photo.creditEn: Photo: km30192002 / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 2.0) · Cathay Pacific A350-900 (B-LRA) climbing
photo.captionZh: 飛行中的前下方角度：可以同時睇到彎起的翼尖、兩台引擎同黑色駕駛艙眼罩。
photo.captionEn: In-flight front-quarter view: curved wingtips, both engines and the black cockpit mask are all visible.

annotations.zh: 機鼻與駕駛艙（黑色眼罩窗框）

sourcesToCheck.labelZh: Airbus 官方 A350-900 機型頁
中文維基：空中巴士 A350

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「A350 系列」；本卡用香港國際機場最常見的 A350-900 做代表（同系列的 A350-1000 機身更長，約 73.8 米）。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The badge list says “A350 Series”; this card uses the A350-900, the variant most common at Hong Kong International Airport (the longer A350-1000 is about 73.8 m).
aircraft.introZh: 國泰航空長程主力之一：碳纖維廣體雙引擎客機，主打慳油、寧靜，在香港國際機場幾乎每日見到。
aircraft.introEn: A Cathay Pacific long-haul mainstay: a carbon-fibre widebody twinjet built for fuel efficiency and a quiet cabin, seen at Hong Kong International Airport almost every day.

history.statusZh: 生產中、服役中（2015 年由卡塔爾航空首航）
history.statusEn: In production and in service (entered service with Qatar Airways in 2015)

wings.zh: 下單翼，翼尖是向上彎起的鯊鰭小翼，線條圓滑。
wings.en: Low wing with curved, upward sharklet wingtips.

engines.zh: 兩台勞斯萊斯 Trent XWB 大風扇引擎，吊掛在機翼之下。
engines.en: Two large Rolls-Royce Trent XWB fan engines under the wings.

fuselage.zh: 廣體雙通道機身；駕駛艙窗外有一圈黑色「眼罩」邊框，是全機最搶眼的記號。
fuselage.en: Widebody twin-aisle fuselage; the black “bandit mask” frame around the cockpit windows is the quickest giveaway.

tail.zh: 傳統十字尾翼，垂直尾翼高大，末端有水平尾翼。
tail.en: Conventional tail with a tall vertical fin and rear horizontal stabilisers.

aircraft.similarZh: 同波音 787-8 比：A350 駕駛艙有黑色眼罩邊框、翼尖向上彎；787 沒有眼罩，翼尖是向後拉直的 raked 翼尖，而且機身較短（56.7 米）。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Boeing 787-8: the A350 has the black cockpit mask and curved-up wingtips; the 787 has no mask, straight raked wingtips, and a shorter fuselage (56.7 m).

deepLinks.labelZh: Airbus 官方 A350-900 機型頁
中文維基：空中巴士 A350

engines.noteZh: 四引擎，兩種引擎可選

seats.noteZh: 典型三級艙；最大認證 853 座（Airbus 官方）

recognitionZh: 超大機翼，翼展接近 80 米，翼尖有上下小翼。
四台引擎吊掛在機翼之下（相中近側見到兩台），是現役客機中少有的四引擎佈局。
全長雙層機身：兩排窗由機頭直通到機尾，機鼻渾圓，體型明顯比一般廣體機更高更闊。
垂直尾翼非常高大，全高約 24 米，相等於八層樓。
recognitionEn: A huge wing spanning almost 80 m, with winglets above and below the tips.
Four engines under the wings (two visible on the near side here) — rare among airliners today.
Full-length double deck: two window rows from nose to tail, with a rounded nose and a noticeably taller, wider body.
A very tall tail — about 24 m overall height, like an eight-storey building.

photo.author: BriYYZ
photo.creditZh: 相片：BriYYZ／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 2.0）· 阿聯酋航空 A380-800（A6-EEY）降落阿姆斯特丹
photo.creditEn: Photo: BriYYZ / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0) · Emirates A380-800 (A6-EEY) landing at Amsterdam
photo.captionZh: 後側面降落一刻：雙層窗線、高大尾翼同近側兩台引擎最清楚；機鼻在畫面右邊之外。
photo.captionEn: Rear-quarter landing view: double-deck windows, tall tail and the two near-side engines stand out; the nose is out of frame to the right.

sourcesToCheck.labelZh: Airbus 官方 A380 機型頁
中文維基：空中巴士 A380

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「A380」；本卡是唯一量產版本 A380-800，全球最大的載客客機，已經停產但仍在服役。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The badge list says “A380”; this card is the only production variant, the A380-800 — the world's largest passenger airliner, out of production but still in service.
aircraft.introZh: 空中巨無霸：全長雙層、四台引擎，一次過載到五百幾人。在機場見到佢，成個人都會忍唔住望多兩眼。
aircraft.introEn: The sky giant: a full-length double-decker with four engines carrying over five hundred people — impossible not to stare at the airport.

history.statusZh: 已停產（2021 年交付最後一架，共 251 架），仍在服役
history.statusEn: Production ended in 2021 (251 delivered); still in service

wings.zh: 超大機翼，翼展接近 80 米，翼尖有上下小翼。
wings.en: A huge wing spanning almost 80 m, with winglets above and below the tips.

engines.zh: 四台引擎吊掛在機翼之下（相中近側見到兩台），是現役客機中少有的四引擎佈局。
engines.en: Four engines under the wings (two visible on the near side here) — rare among airliners today.

fuselage.zh: 全長雙層機身：兩排窗由機頭直通到機尾，機鼻渾圓，體型明顯比一般廣體機更高更闊。
fuselage.en: Full-length double deck: two window rows from nose to tail, with a rounded nose and a noticeably taller, wider body.

tail.zh: 垂直尾翼非常高大，全高約 24 米，相等於八層樓。
tail.en: A very tall tail — about 24 m overall height, like an eight-storey building.

aircraft.similarZh: 同波音 747 比：A380 雙層由機頭伸到機尾，機鼻圓潤、駕駛艙位置較低；747 只有機身前段有上層「駝峰」，機鼻較尖。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Boeing 747: the A380's upper deck runs the full length with a rounded, low-set nose; the 747 has only a front upper-deck hump and a more pointed nose.

deepLinks.labelZh: Airbus 官方 A380 機型頁
中文維基：空中巴士 A380

engines.noteZh: 兩種引擎可選

seats.noteZh: 典型兩級艙；最大 194 座

recognitionZh: 下單翼，翼尖有向上翹起的鯊鰭小翼（相中紅色翼尖好易認）。
兩台新一代大風扇引擎（LEAP-1A 或 PW1100G），風扇直徑明顯大過舊一代 A320。
單通道窄體機身，機鼻圓尖，窗線平直，屬於中短途客機體型。
傳統尾翼，垂直尾翼末端平直，機尾有水平尾翼。
recognitionEn: Low wing with upward sharklet wingtips (red tips in this photo).
Two new-generation large-fan engines (LEAP-1A or PW1100G), clearly bigger than on the older A320.
Single-aisle narrowbody fuselage with a rounded nose — a classic short-haul shape.
Conventional tail with a straight-topped fin and rear horizontal stabilisers.

photo.author: Howard Pulling
photo.creditZh: 相片：Howard Pulling／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 2.0）· 香港快運 A320neo（B-LCL）@ 香港國際機場
photo.creditEn: Photo: Howard Pulling / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0) · HK Express A320neo (B-LCL) at Hong Kong International Airport
photo.captionZh: 地面側面全景：機鼻、引擎、機翼同尾翼一字排開，是學辨認的最佳角度。
photo.captionEn: Full ground side profile: nose, engine, wing and tail in one line — the best learning angle.

sourcesToCheck.labelZh: Airbus 官方 A320neo 機型頁
中文維基：空中巴士 A320 系列

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「A320 系列」；本卡用新一代的 A320neo 做代表，相中是香港快運的 A320neo 在香港國際機場。舊一代 A320ceo 引擎較細小，要分清楚。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The badge list says “A320 Series”; this card uses the new-generation A320neo, photographed with HK Express at Hong Kong International Airport. The older A320ceo has visibly smaller engines.
aircraft.introZh: 香港短途航線常客：單通道窄體客機，慳油引擎加鯊鰭小翼，香港快運等航空公司日日使用。
aircraft.introEn: A short-haul regular in Hong Kong: a single-aisle narrowbody with fuel-saving engines and sharklets, flown daily by HK Express and others.

history.statusZh: 生產中、服役中（2016 年由漢莎航空首航）
history.statusEn: In production and in service (entered service with Lufthansa in 2016)

wings.zh: 下單翼，翼尖有向上翹起的鯊鰭小翼（相中紅色翼尖好易認）。
wings.en: Low wing with upward sharklet wingtips (red tips in this photo).

engines.zh: 兩台新一代大風扇引擎（LEAP-1A 或 PW1100G），風扇直徑明顯大過舊一代 A320。
engines.en: Two new-generation large-fan engines (LEAP-1A or PW1100G), clearly bigger than on the older A320.

fuselage.zh: 單通道窄體機身，機鼻圓尖，窗線平直，屬於中短途客機體型。
fuselage.en: Single-aisle narrowbody fuselage with a rounded nose — a classic short-haul shape.

tail.zh: 傳統尾翼，垂直尾翼末端平直，機尾有水平尾翼。
tail.en: Conventional tail with a straight-topped fin and rear horizontal stabilisers.

aircraft.similarZh: 同舊一代 A320ceo 比：neo 引擎明顯較大，而且標準配備向上翹的鯊鰭小翼；ceo 多數是細引擎，翼尖多為小翼刀或平直翼尖。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the older A320ceo: the neo has much larger engines and standard upturned sharklets; the ceo usually has smaller engines with small wingtip fences or plain tips.

deepLinks.labelZh: Airbus 官方 A320neo 機型頁
中文維基：空中巴士 A320 系列

engines.noteZh: 兩種引擎任選其一（通用電氣或勞斯萊斯）
engines.noteEn: Choice of General Electric or Rolls-Royce engines

seats.noteZh: 典型兩級艙；高密度最多約 406 座
seats.noteEn: Typical two-class; up to about 406 in high density

recognitionZh: 下單翼，翼尖向後上方斜削（raked wingtip），沒有翼尖小翼，上反角明顯。
兩台大風扇引擎吊掛翼下；部分引擎艙後緣有鋸齒形消噪邊（chevron）。
廣體雙通道機身，機鼻圓潤微垂，駕駛艙窗沒有黑色邊框（與 A350 最易分辨之處）。
傳統尾翼，垂直尾翼高大，水平尾翼在機尾兩側。
recognitionEn: Low wing with raked, upswept tips and no winglets; noticeable dihedral.
Two large fan engines under the wing; some nacelles have serrated chevron nozzles at the rear.
Widebody twin-aisle fuselage with a rounded, drooped nose; no black frame around the cockpit windows (the quickest split from the A350).
Conventional tail with a tall fin and rear tailplanes.

photo.author: Adam Moreira (AEMoreira042281)
photo.creditZh: 相片：Adam Moreira／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 4.0）· 智利航空（LAN）787-9（CC-BGA）在紐約甘迺迪機場滑行
photo.creditEn: Photo: Adam Moreira / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) · LAN Airlines 787-9 (CC-BGA) taxiing at New York JFK
photo.captionZh: 地面側面全景：斜削翼尖、大風扇引擎同圓潤機鼻一覽無遺。
photo.captionEn: Ground side view: raked wingtip, big fan engine and rounded nose all on show.

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 787 家族有 -8（本網 AC-0037 有卡）、-9、-10 三型，主要差別在機身長度；-9 是家族中訂單最多的型號，本卡以 -9 為主角。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The 787 family has the -8 (card AC-0037 in this guide), -9 and -10, differing mainly in fuselage length; the -9 is the best-selling variant and is this card's subject.
aircraft.introZh: 波音的碳纖維廣體客機：787-9 用大量複合材料、電傳飛控和省油引擎，把「點對點」長途航線變得經濟可行，是今日遠程機隊的中流砥柱。
aircraft.introEn: Boeing's carbon-fibre widebody: the 787-9 made point-to-point long-haul flying economical with composite structure and fuel-sipping engines, and now anchors many long-haul fleets.

history.statusZh: 生產中、服役中（2014 年由紐西蘭航空首航；787 家族交付量已逾千架，-9 佔其中大多數）。
history.statusEn: In production and in service (entered service with Air New Zealand in 2014; over a thousand 787s have been delivered, most of them -9s).

wings.zh: 下單翼，翼尖向後上方斜削（raked wingtip），沒有翼尖小翼，上反角明顯。
wings.en: Low wing with raked, upswept tips and no winglets; noticeable dihedral.

engines.zh: 兩台大風扇引擎吊掛翼下；部分引擎艙後緣有鋸齒形消噪邊（chevron）。
engines.en: Two large fan engines under the wing; some nacelles have serrated chevron nozzles at the rear.

fuselage.zh: 廣體雙通道機身，機鼻圓潤微垂，駕駛艙窗沒有黑色邊框（與 A350 最易分辨之處）。
fuselage.en: Widebody twin-aisle fuselage with a rounded, drooped nose; no black frame around the cockpit windows (the quickest split from the A350).

tail.zh: 傳統尾翼，垂直尾翼高大，水平尾翼在機尾兩側。
tail.en: Conventional tail with a tall fin and rear tailplanes.

aircraft.recognitionSource: 原創撰寫：WEFT 四項（見 docs/02）
aircraft.similarZh: 同 A350-900 比（本網有卡）：A350 駕駛艙有黑色「眼罩」窗框、翼尖向上彎；787-9 沒有眼罩、翼尖斜削。同自家 787-8 比：-9 機身長約 6 米，窗數明顯更多。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the A350-900 (in this guide): the A350 wears a black cockpit mask and curved-up wingtips; the 787-9 has neither the mask nor winglets. Versus its own 787-8: the -9 is about 6 m longer with visibly more windows.

engines.noteZh: 雙引擎

seats.noteZh: 波音官方兩級艙範圍

range.noteZh: 波音官方最高約 7,500 海里

recognitionZh: 長機翼，翼尖向後拉長的 raked 翼尖，沒有小翼向上翹。
兩台通用電氣 GE90-115B，風扇直徑是民航引擎中數一數二大，圓形進氣口好搶眼。
機身特別長（73.9 米），主起落架每邊有六個車輪（三軸），停在地面時好易數出來。
傳統尾翼，機尾尾錐尖長，垂直尾翼後掠。
recognitionEn: Long wings with raked, swept-back tips and no upturned winglets.
Two GE GE90-115B engines with among the largest fan diameters of any airliner — huge round intakes.
A very long 73.9 m fuselage; each main landing gear has six wheels (three axles) — easy to count on the ground.
Conventional swept tail with a long, pointed tail cone.

photo.author: John Taggart
photo.creditZh: 相片：John Taggart／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 2.0）· 國泰航空 777-300ER（B-KQY）@ 倫敦希斯路
photo.creditEn: Photo: John Taggart / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0) · Cathay Pacific 777-300ER (B-KQY) at London Heathrow
photo.captionZh: 地面側面全景：數一數主起落架的六個車輪，再望下巨大的 GE90 引擎，就係認 777-300ER 的方法。
photo.captionEn: Ground side profile: count the six-wheel main gears and spot the huge GE90 engine — that is how you know a 777-300ER.

annotations.zh: GE90 大引擎（下方見六輪起落架）

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「B777-300」；本卡用增長程的 777-300ER 做代表（ER 即 Extended Range，是國泰等航空公司的長程主力；基本型 -300 機身一樣咁長，但航程較短、翼尖沒有向後拉長）。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The badge list says “B777-300”; this card uses the longer-range 777-300ER (Cathay Pacific's long-haul workhorse). The base -300 is just as long, but flies shorter range and lacks the raked wingtips.
aircraft.introZh: 長程雙引擎之王：機身特別長，兩台 GE90 引擎大到破紀錄，在香港飛長途幾乎班班都見到。
aircraft.introEn: The long-haul twinjet king: an extra-long fuselage and two record-size GE90 engines, seen on long-haul flights in and out of Hong Kong every day.

history.statusZh: 服役中（2004 年由法國航空首航；777 家族仍在交付新一代 777X 測試機）
history.statusEn: In service (entered service with Air France in 2004)

wings.zh: 長機翼，翼尖向後拉長的 raked 翼尖，沒有小翼向上翹。
wings.en: Long wings with raked, swept-back tips and no upturned winglets.

engines.zh: 兩台通用電氣 GE90-115B，風扇直徑是民航引擎中數一數二大，圓形進氣口好搶眼。
engines.en: Two GE GE90-115B engines with among the largest fan diameters of any airliner — huge round intakes.

fuselage.zh: 機身特別長（73.9 米），主起落架每邊有六個車輪（三軸），停在地面時好易數出來。
fuselage.en: A very long 73.9 m fuselage; each main landing gear has six wheels (three axles) — easy to count on the ground.

tail.zh: 傳統尾翼，機尾尾錐尖長，垂直尾翼後掠。
tail.en: Conventional swept tail with a long, pointed tail cone.

aircraft.similarZh: 同空中巴士 A350-900 比：777-300ER 機身更長、沒有黑色駕駛艙眼罩，主起落架每邊六個轆；A350-900 每邊只有四個轆，又有彎起的翼尖。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Airbus A350-900: the 777-300ER is longer, has no cockpit mask, and has six wheels per main gear; the A350-900 has four per gear and curved-up wingtips.

wingspan.noteZh: 連翼尖小翼（無小翼為 34.3 米）

engines.noteZh: CFM International 渦輪扇引擎

seats.noteZh: 兩級艙典型 162；單級艙最多 189

recognitionZh: 下單翼後掠，大多數裝有向上彎的混合式翼尖小翼（winglet）。
兩台 CFM56 吊掛翼下，引擎艙底部扁平如「倉鼠袋」，是 737 的招牌特徵。
單走道窄機身，機鼻尖而修長，機身離地較矮。
傳統尾翼；垂直尾翼根部有一條向前延伸的背鰭。
recognitionEn: Low swept wing; most aircraft have upward-blended winglets.
Two CFM56 engines under the wing; the flattened 'hamster pouch' nacelle bottom is a 737 signature.
Single-aisle narrow body with a pointed nose, sitting low to the ground.
Conventional tail; the fin root extends forward into a long dorsal fillet.

photo.author: Adrian Pingstone
photo.creditZh: 相片：Adrian Pingstone／Wikimedia Commons（公共領域）· Transaero 波音 737-800（EI-UNJ）降落倫敦希斯路機場
photo.creditEn: Photo: Adrian Pingstone / Wikimedia Commons (public domain) · Transaero Boeing 737-800 (EI-UNJ) landing at London Heathrow
photo.captionZh: 降落中的 737-800：留意翼下引擎艙底部扁平、翼尖小翼向上彎。
photo.captionEn: A 737-800 on final approach: note the flattened engine nacelles and upturned winglets.

aircraft.introZh: 全球最暢銷單走道客機家族的代表：737-800 是 737 新世代（Next Generation）的主力型號，在香港來往亞洲各地的短途航線上經常可以見到。
aircraft.introEn: The best-selling member of the world's most popular narrowbody family, and a familiar sight on short-haul Asian routes from Hong Kong.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「Boeing 737 Series」；本卡以家族中最暢銷的 737-800 為代表（同系另有 -700／-900ER，主要差別在機身長度）。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The badge list names the Boeing 737 Series; this card uses the best-selling 737-800 as representative (the -700/-900ER differ mainly in fuselage length).

history.statusZh: 已停產（737NG 客機型 2020 年停產；家族由 737 MAX 接棒，-800 仍是全球短途機隊主力）。
history.statusEn: Out of production (737NG airliner production ended in 2020; the 737 MAX succeeds it, but the -800 remains a global short-haul workhorse).

wings.zh: 下單翼後掠，大多數裝有向上彎的混合式翼尖小翼（winglet）。
wings.en: Low swept wing; most aircraft have upward-blended winglets.

engines.zh: 兩台 CFM56 吊掛翼下，引擎艙底部扁平如「倉鼠袋」，是 737 的招牌特徵。
engines.en: Two CFM56 engines under the wing; the flattened 'hamster pouch' nacelle bottom is a 737 signature.

fuselage.zh: 單走道窄機身，機鼻尖而修長，機身離地較矮。
fuselage.en: Single-aisle narrow body with a pointed nose, sitting low to the ground.

tail.zh: 傳統尾翼；垂直尾翼根部有一條向前延伸的背鰭。
tail.en: Conventional tail; the fin root extends forward into a long dorsal fillet.

aircraft.similarZh: 同 A320neo 比（本網有卡）：737 機鼻較尖、引擎艙底扁平、起落架較短所以機身較矮。同自家 737 MAX 比：MAX 引擎更大、翼尖是上下分叉的新式小翼。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the A320neo (also in this guide): the 737 has a pointier nose, flattened engine nacelles and shorter gear. Versus the 737 MAX: the MAX has bigger engines and split-tip winglets.

engines.noteZh: 三種引擎任選其一

seats.noteZh: 典型三級艙；單級艙最多 660 座

recognitionZh: 下單翼，翼尖有向上伸延的小翼（winglet），是 -400 別於早期 747 的主要外觀記號。
四台引擎吊掛翼下，引擎艙圓筒形，沒有 787 式鋸齒邊。
招牌式隆起機頭：上層甲板由駕駛艙向後伸延至機身前三分之一，短過 747-8 的長駝峰。
傳統尾翼，垂直尾翼高約六層樓，是全機最高點。
recognitionEn: Low wing with tall upward winglets — the main visual split from earlier 747s.
Four engines in round nacelles under the wing, without 787-style chevrons.
The signature hump: the upper deck runs from the cockpit to about a third of the fuselage — shorter than the 747-8's long hump.
Conventional tail; the fin stands about six storeys tall.

photo.author: Adrian Pingstone (Arpingstone)
photo.creditZh: 相片：Adrian Pingstone／Wikimedia Commons（公共領域）· 馬來西亞航空 747-400（9M-MPH）降落倫敦希斯路（2006 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: Adrian Pingstone / Wikimedia Commons (public domain) · Malaysia Airlines 747-400 (9M-MPH) landing at London Heathrow (2006)
photo.captionZh: 全機側面：短駝峰、四台引擎同翼尖小翼齊晒，正是 -400 的標準像。
photo.captionEn: Full side profile: short hump, four engines and winglets — the classic -400 silhouette.

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 747 家族成員眾多；本卡主角 747-400 是家族最暢銷型號（連貨機版共交付 694 架）。747-8 是最後一代（本網 AC-0008 是其貨機版）。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The 747 family is large; this card's 747-400 is its best-seller (694 delivered including freighters). The 747-8 was the final generation (its freighter is card AC-0008 in this guide).
aircraft.introZh: 「珍寶客機」的成熟之作：747-400 加上翼尖小翼、玻璃駕駛艙和省油引擎，在 90 年代至千禧年代稱霸長途航線，是整整一代人的遠程旅行記憶。
aircraft.introEn: The Jumbo Jet grown up: with winglets, a glass cockpit and efficient engines, the 747-400 ruled long-haul flying through the 1990s and 2000s.

history.statusZh: 客運型已大部份退役（疫情期間加速退場），-400 貨機版仍在貨運機隊服役；747 家族已於 2023 年停產。
history.statusEn: Most passenger aircraft are retired (the pandemic sped their exit), while -400 freighters still fly cargo; the 747 line closed in 2023.

wings.zh: 下單翼，翼尖有向上伸延的小翼（winglet），是 -400 別於早期 747 的主要外觀記號。
wings.en: Low wing with tall upward winglets — the main visual split from earlier 747s.

engines.zh: 四台引擎吊掛翼下，引擎艙圓筒形，沒有 787 式鋸齒邊。
engines.en: Four engines in round nacelles under the wing, without 787-style chevrons.

fuselage.zh: 招牌式隆起機頭：上層甲板由駕駛艙向後伸延至機身前三分之一，短過 747-8 的長駝峰。
fuselage.en: The signature hump: the upper deck runs from the cockpit to about a third of the fuselage — shorter than the 747-8's long hump.

tail.zh: 傳統尾翼，垂直尾翼高約六層樓，是全機最高點。
tail.en: Conventional tail; the fin stands about six storeys tall.

aircraft.recognitionSource: 原創撰寫：WEFT 四項（見 docs/02）
aircraft.similarZh: 同 747-8 比：-8 機身更長、上層甲板伸得更後、引擎艙有鋸齒邊而且沒有翼尖小翼（改用斜削翼尖）。同 A380 比（本網有卡）：A380 是全長雙層、機頭較圓鈍；747 的雙層只在機頭一段。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the 747-8: longer fuselage and upper deck, chevron nacelles and raked tips instead of winglets. Versus the A380 (in this guide): the Airbus is full-length double-deck with a blunter nose; the 747's second deck is only at the front.

length.noteZh: 全長（現役最長民用機之一）
length.noteEn: Overall length (among the longest civil aircraft in service)

engines.noteZh: 四引擎

payload.noteZh: 結構最大載重；收入載重約 137,700 公斤
payload.noteEn: Structural maximum; revenue payload about 137,700 kg

recognitionZh: 下單翼大幅後掠，翼尖向後斜削（raked wingtip），沒有小翼。
四台 GEnx 引擎吊掛翼下，引擎罩後緣有鋸齒形降噪邊。
機鼻上方有招牌「駝峰」上層甲板；貨機型上層較短，機鼻貨艙門可向上揭起入貨。
傳統十字尾翼，垂直尾翼高大。
recognitionEn: Low, strongly swept wing with raked, tapered wingtips and no winglets.
Four GEnx engines under the wing, with chevron (saw-tooth) nacelle trailing edges.
The signature upper-deck hump behind the nose; on the freighter it is short, and the nose cargo door hinges up for loading.
Conventional tail with a tall vertical fin.

photo.author: Mark Harkin
photo.creditZh: 相片：Mark Harkin／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY 2.0）· Cargolux 波音 747-8F（LX-VCM「Cutaway」特別塗裝）降落中
photo.creditEn: Photo: Mark Harkin / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 2.0) · Cargolux Boeing 747-8F (LX-VCM “Cutaway” livery) landing
photo.captionZh: 全機側面：駝峰、四台 GEnx 引擎同斜翼尖一覽無遺。
photo.captionEn: Full side view: the hump, four GEnx engines and raked wingtips are all visible.

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「Boeing B747-8F」；747-8 另有客機型 747-8I，本卡只計貨機型數據（客機型機身相同，窗線同貨艙佈局不同）。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The badge list names the Boeing 747-8F; the passenger 747-8I shares the airframe, but this card covers the freighter only.
aircraft.introZh: 747 家族最後一代貨機：全長 76.3 米，是現役最長的民用飛機之一；香港是全球最繁忙的貨機樞紐之一，747-8F 在香港國際機場幾乎每日升降。
aircraft.introEn: The last generation of the 747 family: at 76.3 m, one of the longest civil aircraft in service, and a near-daily sight at Hong Kong, one of the world's busiest cargo hubs.

history.statusZh: 已停產（2023 年交付最後一架 747）；仍是全球貨運機隊主力，國泰貨運亦有營運。
history.statusEn: Out of production (the final 747 was delivered in 2023); still a global freighter mainstay, including with Cathay Cargo.

wings.zh: 下單翼大幅後掠，翼尖向後斜削（raked wingtip），沒有小翼。
wings.en: Low, strongly swept wing with raked, tapered wingtips and no winglets.

engines.zh: 四台 GEnx 引擎吊掛翼下，引擎罩後緣有鋸齒形降噪邊。
engines.en: Four GEnx engines under the wing, with chevron (saw-tooth) nacelle trailing edges.

fuselage.zh: 機鼻上方有招牌「駝峰」上層甲板；貨機型上層較短，機鼻貨艙門可向上揭起入貨。
fuselage.en: The signature upper-deck hump behind the nose; on the freighter it is short, and the nose cargo door hinges up for loading.

tail.zh: 傳統十字尾翼，垂直尾翼高大。
tail.en: Conventional tail with a tall vertical fin.

aircraft.similarZh: 同 747-400F 比：-8F 機身長咗 5.6 米、斜翼尖取代小翼、引擎罩有鋸齒邊。同 A380 比：只有機鼻一段係雙層，唔係全長雙層。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the 747-400F: 5.6 m longer, raked tips instead of winglets, chevron nacelles. Versus the A380: only the nose section is double-deck, not the full length.

engines.noteZh: 通用電氣 GE90 系列，風扇直徑逾 3 米
engines.noteEn: General Electric GE90; fan diameter over 3 m

recognitionZh: 下單翼，翼尖斜削，沒有翼尖小翼；主起落架每邊六個車輪，是 777 家族的共同記號。
兩台 GE90 巨型引擎，風扇直徑比一架 Cessna 172 的機身還要闊。
貨機機身幾乎全無客窗，只有機頭一排小窗和艙門框線；機身左側近尾部有大型主甲板貨艙門。
傳統尾翼，垂直尾翼高大，尾錐有 APU 排氣口。
recognitionEn: Low wing with raked tips and no winglets; six-wheel main bogies are a 777 family signature.
Two huge GE90s; the fan is wider than a Cessna 172's fuselage.
Nearly windowless freighter fuselage with a large main-deck cargo door on the left side toward the rear.
Conventional tail with a tall fin and APU exhaust in the tail cone.

photo.author: Eric Salard
photo.creditZh: 相片：Eric Salard／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 2.0）· FedEx 777F（N886FD）降落巴黎戴高樂機場（2015 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: Eric Salard / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0) · FedEx 777F (N886FD) landing at Paris CDG (2015)
photo.captionZh: 無窗貨機機身、GE90 巨型引擎同六輪主起落架一覽無遺。
photo.captionEn: Windowless freighter fuselage, huge GE90s and six-wheel bogies on show.

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 777F 的 ICAO 代碼 B77L 與客機版 777-200LR 共用（兩者源自同一 -200 機體）；本卡數字全為貨機版 777F。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The 777F shares ICAO code B77L with the 777-200LR airliner (both derive from the -200 airframe); all figures on this card are for the 777F freighter.
aircraft.introZh: 全球最強雙引擎貨機：777F 以 777-200LR 的長程機體載 102 噸貨橫越太平洋，是 FedEx、漢莎貨運等全球貨運網絡的骨幹。
aircraft.introEn: The world's most capable twin-engine freighter: the 777F pairs the 777-200LR's long legs with a 102-tonne payload on trans-Pacific cargo networks.

history.statusZh: 生產中、服役中（2009 年由法國航空貨運首航；訂單持續，是長程貨機市場主力）。
history.statusEn: In production and in service (entered service with Air France Cargo in 2009; still the long-haul freighter benchmark).

wings.zh: 下單翼，翼尖斜削，沒有翼尖小翼；主起落架每邊六個車輪，是 777 家族的共同記號。
wings.en: Low wing with raked tips and no winglets; six-wheel main bogies are a 777 family signature.

engines.zh: 兩台 GE90 巨型引擎，風扇直徑比一架 Cessna 172 的機身還要闊。
engines.en: Two huge GE90s; the fan is wider than a Cessna 172's fuselage.

fuselage.zh: 貨機機身幾乎全無客窗，只有機頭一排小窗和艙門框線；機身左側近尾部有大型主甲板貨艙門。
fuselage.en: Nearly windowless freighter fuselage with a large main-deck cargo door on the left side toward the rear.

tail.zh: 傳統尾翼，垂直尾翼高大，尾錐有 APU 排氣口。
tail.en: Conventional tail with a tall fin and APU exhaust in the tail cone.

aircraft.recognitionSource: 原創撰寫：WEFT 四項（見 docs/02）
aircraft.similarZh: 同客機版 777-300ER 比（本網 AC-0005 有卡）：貨機用較短的 -200 機身而且全機無窗。同 747-8F 比：777F 載重較少但更省油、雙引擎維護較平。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the 777-300ER airliner (card AC-0005): the freighter uses the shorter -200 fuselage and has no windows. Versus the 747-8F: less payload, but cheaper to run with two engines.

aircraft.nameZh: 安東諾夫 An-124 魯斯蘭

engines.noteZh: 四渦輪扇引擎

range.noteZh: 約 2,420 海里（載滿 120 噸時）

recognitionZh: 高置後掠翼，翼展 73.3 米，比機身還長；翼下吊四台引擎。
四台 Progress D-18T 大風扇引擎吊在機翼下，引擎艙粗大。
超巨型機身，機頭駕駛艙高高在上，機鼻可以向上掀開入貨；機身兩側有成排起落架艙。
高大垂直尾翼加低置水平尾翼（十字尾），機尾有貨艙跳板門。
recognitionEn: High swept wing spanning 73.3 m — wider than the fuselage is long — with four engines underneath.
Four big Progress D-18T high-bypass turbofans in chunky pods under the wing.
Huge fuselage with the cockpit perched high, a nose that hinges upward for loading, and rows of gear bays along the sides.
Tall fin with low-set horizontal stabilisers (cruciform tail) and a rear cargo ramp door.

photo.author: Felix Goetting
photo.creditZh: 相片：Felix Goetting／Wikimedia Commons（GFDL 1.2）· Antonov An-124-100（RA-82043，伏爾加-第聶伯）在跑道上
photo.creditEn: Photo: Felix Goetting / Wikimedia Commons (GFDL 1.2) · Antonov An-124-100 (RA-82043, Volga-Dnepr) on the runway
photo.captionZh: 側面全身：高翼、四引擎、高駕駛艙同巨型機身比例一次睇晒（機鼻在地面未掀起）。
photo.captionEn: Full side view: high wing, four engines, high cockpit and the giant fuselage proportions (nose closed on the ground).

sourcesToCheck.labelZh: 中文維基：安托諾夫 An-124

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「Antonov An124（NATO: Condor）」；本卡以民用貨運型 An-124-100 為代表（結構載重 120 噸；軍用/加強型可達 150 噸，數字唔好混用）。相片正是 An-124-100（RA-82043）。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The badge list says “Antonov An124 (NATO: Condor)”; this card represents the civil An-124-100 freighter (120-tonne structural payload; military/uprated versions reach 150 tonnes — do not mix the figures). The photo is an An-124-100 (RA-82043).
aircraft.introZh: 蘇聯/烏克蘭安東諾夫的巨型貨機：機頭可以成個掀起、機尾有跳板，前後都上到貨，曾經是全世界最大的量產飛機，專門運超大件貨物。
aircraft.introEn: Antonov's giant freighter from the Soviet/Ukrainian era: the whole nose swings up and there is a rear ramp, so cargo loads from both ends. Once the world's largest production aircraft, it hauls outsize loads.

history.statusZh: 服役中（1982–2004 年生產；民用 An-124-100 於 1992 年認證，現由安東諾夫航空、伏爾加-第聶伯等營運）
history.statusEn: In service (built 1982–2004; the civil An-124-100 was certified in 1992 and is flown by Antonov Airlines, Volga-Dnepr and others)

wings.zh: 高置後掠翼，翼展 73.3 米，比機身還長；翼下吊四台引擎。
wings.en: High swept wing spanning 73.3 m — wider than the fuselage is long — with four engines underneath.

engines.zh: 四台 Progress D-18T 大風扇引擎吊在機翼下，引擎艙粗大。
engines.en: Four big Progress D-18T high-bypass turbofans in chunky pods under the wing.

fuselage.zh: 超巨型機身，機頭駕駛艙高高在上，機鼻可以向上掀開入貨；機身兩側有成排起落架艙。
fuselage.en: Huge fuselage with the cockpit perched high, a nose that hinges upward for loading, and rows of gear bays along the sides.

tail.zh: 高大垂直尾翼加低置水平尾翼（十字尾），機尾有貨艙跳板門。
tail.en: Tall fin with low-set horizontal stabilisers (cruciform tail) and a rear cargo ramp door.

aircraft.similarZh: 同 C-17 比：An-124 大得多（長 69.1 米 vs 53 米）、機鼻識掀起、C-17 是 T 型尾翼；同 An-225 比：225 有六台引擎同雙垂直尾翼，124 得四引擎單尾翼。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the C-17: the An-124 is far bigger (69.1 m vs 53 m), its nose hinges up, and the C-17 has a T-tail. Versus the An-225: the 225 has six engines and twin fins; the 124 has four engines and a single fin.

deepLinks.labelZh: 中文維基：安托諾夫 An-124

aircraft.nameZh: 空中巴士 A330-200F 貨機

engines.noteZh: 普惠或勞斯萊斯引擎任選其一
engines.noteEn: Choice of Pratt & Whitney or Rolls-Royce engines

payload.noteZh: 最大結構載重；Airbus 推廣數字以 65 噸級任務為主
payload.noteEn: Maximum structural payload; Airbus markets it around 65-tonne missions

range.noteZh: 載 61 噸時航程；滿載 70 噸約 5,950 公里（官方數字因載重而異，見 docs/05）
range.noteEn: Range with 61 t payload; about 5,950 km at full 70 t (see docs/05)

recognitionZh: 下單翼，翼尖有空中巴士式小翼（winglets），線條修長。
兩台大風扇引擎吊掛翼下（PW4000 或 Trent 700）。
無窗貨機機身；機鼻底部有一個明顯鼓包，收納加長了的前起落架，令貨艙地板保持水平——全機最易認的特徵。
傳統尾翼，垂直尾翼帶空中巴士弧形前緣。
recognitionEn: Low wing with Airbus-style blended winglets.
Two large fan engines under the wing (PW4000 or Trent 700).
Windowless freighter body; a distinct bulge under the nose houses a lengthened nose gear to keep the cargo floor level — the type's easiest giveaway.
Conventional tail with the curved Airbus fin leading edge.

photo.author: Nabeel Hashmi
photo.creditZh: 相片：Nabeel Hashmi／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 2.0）· 卡塔爾貨運 A330-200F 自杜拜起飛（2013 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: Nabeel Hashmi / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0) · Qatar Airways Cargo A330-200F climbing out of Dubai (2013)
photo.captionZh: 爬升中的貨機版：無窗機身同機鼻底鼓包（在機頭下方）是重點。
photo.captionEn: The freighter climbing out: windowless body and the nose-gear bulge below the cockpit are the keys.

sourcesToCheck.labelZh: 英文維基：Airbus A330（A330-200F 貨機版）

aircraft.variantNoteZh: A330-200F 的 ICAO 代碼 A332 與客機版 A330-200 共用；本卡數字全為原廠貨機版（與客改貨 A330-200P2F 不同）。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The A330-200F shares ICAO code A332 with the A330-200 airliner; all figures here are for the factory freighter (not the A330-200P2F conversion).
aircraft.introZh: 空中巴士至今唯一原廠中型廣體貨機：A330-200F 以省油雙引擎挑戰 767 貨機市場，機鼻底的起落架鼓包是它獨一無二的身分證。
aircraft.introEn: Airbus's only factory-built mid-size widebody freighter: the twin-engine A330-200F took on the 767 freighter market, with a nose-gear bulge as its unique ID card.

history.statusZh: 已停產、服役中（2010 年由阿提哈德水晶貨運首航；產量不大但仍在中東及貨運航空服役）。
history.statusEn: Out of production, in service (entered service with Etihad Crystal Cargo in 2010; a small fleet still flies, mainly in the Middle East).

wings.zh: 下單翼，翼尖有空中巴士式小翼（winglets），線條修長。
wings.en: Low wing with Airbus-style blended winglets.

engines.zh: 兩台大風扇引擎吊掛翼下（PW4000 或 Trent 700）。
engines.en: Two large fan engines under the wing (PW4000 or Trent 700).

fuselage.zh: 無窗貨機機身；機鼻底部有一個明顯鼓包，收納加長了的前起落架，令貨艙地板保持水平——全機最易認的特徵。
fuselage.en: Windowless freighter body; a distinct bulge under the nose houses a lengthened nose gear to keep the cargo floor level — the type's easiest giveaway.

tail.zh: 傳統尾翼，垂直尾翼帶空中巴士弧形前緣。
tail.en: Conventional tail with the curved Airbus fin leading edge.

aircraft.recognitionSource: 原創撰寫：WEFT 四項（見 docs/02）
aircraft.similarZh: 同客機版 A330-300 比（本網 AC-0049 有卡）：貨機較短（-200 機身）、無窗、機鼻底有鼓包。同 777F 比：A330-200F 載重和航程都細一級，但購價與油耗較低。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the A330-300 airliner (card AC-0049): shorter -200 body, no windows, and the nose bulge. Versus the 777F: a class smaller in payload and range, but cheaper to buy and run.

deepLinks.labelZh: 英文維基：Airbus A330（A330-200F 貨機版）

engines.noteZh: 普惠加拿大渦槳引擎，各驅動一副六葉螺旋槳

Two turboprops on the wing; the -600's six-blade propellers are a clue against older variants.

T-tail with the tailplane on top of the fin — an instant ATR giveaway.

photo.captionZh: 地面側面：高翼、T 尾同六葉螺旋槳齊晒，機尾「600」字樣正是 -600 型號標記。
photo.captionEn: Ground side view: high wing, T-tail and six-blade props; the '600' on the nacelle marks the variant.

aircraft.variantNoteZh: ATR 72 家族的最新玻璃駕駛艙型號；本卡數字為 -600（ATR 72-212A）。家族另有較短的 ATR 42。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The latest glass-cockpit member of the ATR 72 family; figures are for the -600 (ATR 72-212A). The shorter ATR 42 is its sibling.
aircraft.introZh: 全球最暢銷的渦槳支線客機：ATR 72-600 用兩台螺旋槳引擎飛短途航線，油耗低、可以在細機場升降，是島嶼與地區航線的主力。
aircraft.introEn: The world's best-selling regional turboprop: the ATR 72-600 flies short sectors on two propellers, sipping fuel and using small airfields across island and regional networks.

history.statusZh: 生產中、服役中（家族 1988 年首飛，-600 於 2011 年投入服務；全球最大渦槳客機機隊）。
history.statusEn: In production and in service (family first flew in 1988; the -600 entered service in 2011 and leads the world turboprop fleet).

wings.zh: 高翼設計，主翼架在機身頂部，翼尖有細小翼；主起落架收在機身兩側的鼓包內。
wings.en: High wing mounted on top of the fuselage with small winglets; main gears retract into fuselage-side blisters.

engines.zh: 兩台渦槳引擎裝在主翼上，-600 用六葉螺旋槳（數槳葉是分辨 -600 與舊型號的線索）。
engines.en: Two turboprops on the wing; the -600's six-blade propellers are a clue against older variants.

fuselage.zh: 窄體單通道機身，機尾向上收起，後艙門連登機梯在機身左後方。
fuselage.en: Narrow single-aisle body with an upswept rear fuselage; the rear door with airstairs is at the back left.

tail.zh: T 型尾翼：水平尾翼架在垂直尾翼頂端，是 ATR 一望而知的特徵。
tail.en: T-tail with the tailplane on top of the fin — an instant ATR giveaway.

aircraft.recognitionSource: 原創撰寫：WEFT 四項（見 docs/02）
aircraft.similarZh: 同 DHC-6 雙水獺比（本網 AC-0017 有卡）：ATR 大一截、T 尾、起落架可收起；DHC-6 是固定起落架的短場起降專家。同 Q400 比：ATR 載客相若但速度較慢、更省油。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the DHC-6 Twin Otter (card AC-0017): the ATR is much bigger with a T-tail and retractable gear; the Otter is a fixed-gear STOL specialist. Versus the Q400: similar seats, slower but thriftier.

engines.noteZh: 通用電氣渦輪扇引擎

cruise.noteZh: 典型巡航（約 829 公里／小時）

兩台 CF34 引擎吊掛翼下（非機尾安裝），是 E-Jet 別於 CRJ 的最大分野。
機身截面呈「雙泡泡」形，客艙 2+2 排列沒有中間位；窗戶較支線機大。
傳統低置尾翼，垂直尾翼根部線條圓滑。

Two CF34s under the wing (not at the tail) — the biggest split from the CRJ.
Double-bubble fuselage with 2+2 seating and no middle seats; windows are bigger than on older regional jets.
Conventional low-set tail with a smoothly faired fin root.

photo.captionEn: Landing side view: underwing engines, low tail and a slim fuselage — the E190 profile.

sourcesToCheck.labelZh: 英文維基：Embraer E-Jet 家族

aircraft.variantNoteZh: E-Jet 家族第一代成員（E170／175／190／195）；本卡數字為 E190。第二代 E-Jet E2 是另一代機型，不在本卡範圍。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: A first-generation E-Jet (E170/175/190/195); figures are for the E190. The second-generation E-Jet E2 is a different generation and outside this card.
aircraft.introZh: 巴西航空工業打入主線市場的代表作：E190 以「右尺寸」100 座級機身、翼下引擎同 2+2 無中間位座椅，改寫了支線噴射機的標準。
aircraft.introEn: Embraer's breakthrough into the mainline market: the 100-seat E190 reset regional-jet standards with underwing engines and a 2+2 cabin with no middle seats.

history.statusZh: 已停產（一代 E-Jet），服役中（2005 年由 JetBlue 首航；全球仍有大量機隊，家族後繼者為 E-Jet E2）。
history.statusEn: Out of production (first-generation E-Jet), in service (entered service with JetBlue in 2005; the E-Jet E2 family succeeds it).

wings.zh: 下單翼，翼尖有小翼，線條接近縮小版主線客機。
wings.en: Low wing with winglets — looks like a scaled-down mainline airliner.

engines.zh: 兩台 CF34 引擎吊掛翼下（非機尾安裝），是 E-Jet 別於 CRJ 的最大分野。
engines.en: Two CF34s under the wing (not at the tail) — the biggest split from the CRJ.

fuselage.zh: 機身截面呈「雙泡泡」形，客艙 2+2 排列沒有中間位；窗戶較支線機大。
fuselage.en: Double-bubble fuselage with 2+2 seating and no middle seats; windows are bigger than on older regional jets.

tail.zh: 傳統低置尾翼，垂直尾翼根部線條圓滑。
tail.en: Conventional low-set tail with a smoothly faired fin root.

aircraft.recognitionSource: 原創撰寫：WEFT 四項（見 docs/02）
aircraft.similarZh: 同 CRJ900 比（本網 AC-0014 有卡）：CRJ 引擎在機尾兩側加 T 尾，機身幼長；E190 引擎在翼下、機身較粗。同 A220 比：兩者同走 100 座級翼下引擎路線，A220 機身較新較長程。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the CRJ900 (card AC-0014): the CRJ has tail-mounted engines, a T-tail and a slimmer body; the E190 has underwing engines and a wider cabin. Versus the A220: same 100-seat underwing formula, but the Airbus is newer and longer-legged.

engines.noteZh: 裝在機尾兩側

兩台 CF34 裝在機尾兩側（尾吊式），是 CRJ 與 E-Jet 最易分辨之處。
幼長機身源自 Challenger 公務機，客窗細小而密，機鼻尖長。

Two CF34s mounted on the rear fuselage — the easiest split from the E-Jet.
Slim Challenger-derived fuselage with small, closely spaced windows and a long pointed nose.
T-tail with the tailplane atop the fin, clear of the rear engines' exhaust.

photo.captionEn: Slim fuselage, rear engines and T-tail — the CRJ identity at a glance.

aircraft.variantNoteZh: CRJ 家族（CRJ100／200／700／900／1000）的加長型號；本卡數字為 CRJ900。家族生產已於 2021 年結束，現由三菱重工支援。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The stretched member of the CRJ family (CRJ100/200/700/900/1000); figures are for the CRJ900. Production ended in 2021 and Mitsubishi now supports the fleet.
aircraft.introZh: 把公務機拉長成的支線噴射機：CRJ900 以幼長機身、尾置引擎同 T 尾，在北美和歐洲的支線網絡飛了二十多年。
aircraft.introEn: A business jet stretched into an airliner: the slim CRJ900 with tail-mounted engines and a T-tail served North American and European regional networks for over two decades.

history.statusZh: 已停產（CRJ 家族 2021 年交付最後一架），服役中（主要用戶包括漢莎、北歐及美國支線航空）。
history.statusEn: Out of production (the last CRJ was delivered in 2021), in service with Lufthansa, SAS and US regional carriers among others.

wings.zh: 下單翼，翼尖有小翼；主翼位置偏後，令機身前段顯得特別長。
wings.en: Low wing with winglets, set well back so the forward fuselage looks extra long.

engines.zh: 兩台 CF34 裝在機尾兩側（尾吊式），是 CRJ 與 E-Jet 最易分辨之處。
engines.en: Two CF34s mounted on the rear fuselage — the easiest split from the E-Jet.

fuselage.zh: 幼長機身源自 Challenger 公務機，客窗細小而密，機鼻尖長。
fuselage.en: Slim Challenger-derived fuselage with small, closely spaced windows and a long pointed nose.

tail.zh: T 型尾翼，水平尾翼在垂直尾翼頂端，避開尾置引擎的氣流。
tail.en: T-tail with the tailplane atop the fin, clear of the rear engines' exhaust.

aircraft.recognitionSource: 原創撰寫：WEFT 四項（見 docs/02）
aircraft.similarZh: 同 E190 比（本網 AC-0013 有卡）：E190 引擎在翼下、尾翼低置、機身較粗；CRJ900 引擎在機尾、T 尾、機身幼長，一眼可分。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the E190 (card AC-0013): the Embraer has underwing engines, a low tail and a wider body; the CRJ900's rear engines, T-tail and slim tube are unmistakable.

photo.captionZh: 高翼加支柱、固定起落架——全球訓練機的經典佈局。
photo.captionEn: Strut-braced high wing and fixed gear — the classic trainer layout.

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「Cessna 172 Skyhawk」；規格以現行生產型 172S 為代表。Cessna 172 自 1956 年累計生產逾 45,000 架，是史上產量最高的飛機。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The badge list says “Cessna 172 Skyhawk”; figures are for the current-production 172S. Over 45,000 Cessna 172s have been built since 1956 — the most-produced aircraft in history.
aircraft.introZh: 全球最常見的訓練機：高翼、固定起落架、四個座位，好多機師的第一課都係坐佢學飛；香港飛行訓練空域亦常見同系機蹤影。
aircraft.introEn: The world's most common training aircraft: high wing, fixed gear, four seats — many pilots took their very first lesson in one.

history.statusZh: 生產中（172S 為現行型號；全球機隊龐大，飛行學校主力）。
history.statusEn: In production (the 172S is the current model; the global fleet is huge and anchors flight training).

wings.zh: 高置直翼，機翼有支柱（strut）撐住機身——高翼加支柱是記號。
wings.en: High, straight wing braced by struts to the fuselage — the classic giveaway.

engines.zh: 機鼻一台活塞引擎帶動螺旋槳（172S 為 180 匹）。
engines.en: A single piston engine and propeller in the nose (180 hp in the 172S).

fuselage.zh: 四座小機身，兩側大窗，固定三點式起落架唔收得。
fuselage.en: Small four-seat fuselage, big side windows, fixed tricycle gear that does not retract.

tail.zh: 傳統尾翼，垂直尾翼前緣有延伸鰭。
tail.en: Conventional tail with a dorsal fin extension ahead of the fin.

aircraft.similarZh: 同 C152 比：172 大一圈、四座、後窗較多。同 C182 比外形極似，新手常撈亂——記住 172 是同系最常見、體型中等的入門型。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the C152: bigger, four seats, more rear windows. Very similar to the C182 — remember the 172 is the mid-size, most common family member.

aircraft.variantZh: PA-28-181 Archer（代表 PA-28 家族）
aircraft.variantNoteZh: PA-28 切羅基家族型號眾多（Warrior、Archer、Arrow 等）；本卡以最常見的訓練與私人型號 PA-28-181 Archer 為代表，數字為 Archer 級數。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The PA-28 Cherokee family has many members (Warrior, Archer, Arrow and more); this card uses the common PA-28-181 Archer trainer/tourer as representative, with Archer-class figures.
aircraft.introZh: 與 Cessna 172 齊名的飛行訓練主力：低翼的派珀 PA-28 自 1960 年代起教出一代又一代機師，全球產量以萬計，是飛行學校的常見身影。
aircraft.introEn: Alongside the Cessna 172, the low-wing Piper PA-28 has trained generations of pilots since the 1960s, with tens of thousands built for flying schools worldwide.

history.statusZh: 生產中、服役中（家族 1960 年首飛、1961 年交付；現代版 Archer 仍在生產，是飛行訓練市場兩大主力之一）。
history.statusEn: In production and in service (family first flew in 1960 and was delivered from 1961; today's Archer is still built and remains a training-market staple).

wings.zh: 低翼（主翼在機身底部），是與高翼 Cessna 172 最直接的分辨法。
wings.en: Low wing at the bottom of the fuselage — the quickest split from the high-wing Cessna 172.

engines.zh: 單台活塞引擎在機頭，雙葉螺旋槳；引擎罩兩側有入風口。
engines.en: One piston engine in the nose with a two-blade propeller and cooling inlets either side of the cowling.

fuselage.zh: 四座小機艙，窗戶大，機身上部線條平直；固定三點式起落架不收起。
fuselage.en: Four-seat cabin with big windows and a flat-topped fuselage; fixed tricycle gear that does not retract.

tail.zh: 傳統尾翼加全動式水平尾翼（stabilator）低置於機尾。
tail.en: Conventional tail with a low-set all-moving stabilator.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Cessna 172 (card AC-0015): the 172 is high-wing, the PA-28 low-wing — check the wing position on the ground. Same story against the Cessna 182 (AC-0067).

range.noteZh: 約數（標準油箱、零載重）；載客時較短
range.noteEn: Approx. (standard tanks, zero payload); less with passengers

recognitionZh: 高置直翼，翼面平直，起落架固定唔收。
兩台 PT6A 渦輪螺旋槳引擎裝在翼上，三葉螺旋槳。
方正機身，一排小圓角窗，最多 19 名乘客；可換浮筒（相片即浮筒型）。
高垂直尾翼，水平尾翼裝在機尾中段。
recognitionEn: High, straight wing with fixed landing gear.
Two PT6A turboprops on the wing with three-blade propellers.
Boxy fuselage with a row of small windows for up to 19 passengers; floats can be fitted (as pictured).
Tall vertical fin with the horizontal tail at the rear fuselage.

photo.author: Alain Rioux
photo.creditZh: 相片：Alain Rioux／Wikimedia Commons（GFDL 1.2 only）· 安大略省自然資源部 DHC-6-300（C-GOGB）浮筒型
photo.creditEn: Photo: Alain Rioux / Wikimedia Commons (GFDL 1.2 only) · Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources DHC-6-300 (C-GOGB) on floats
photo.captionZh: 黃色 Series 300 浮筒型：高翼、雙槳、方機身，Series 400 外形相同。
photo.captionEn: A yellow Series 300 on floats: high wing, twin props, boxy fuselage — the Series 400 looks the same.

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「Viking Air DHC-6 Twin Otter」；規格以現行生產的 Viking Series 400 為代表。相片是較早期的 Series 300 浮筒型，外形與 Series 400 基本相同，主要分別在駕駛艙航電同引擎。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Figures are for the current Viking Series 400. The photo shows an earlier Series 300 on floats — externally near-identical; the 400 differs mainly in avionics and engines.
aircraft.introZh: 短場起降（STOL）雙渦槳客機：起落架可換浮筒、雪橇，落湖面雪地都得，專飛大飛機去不到的小機場，是偏遠地區的「山區巴士」。
aircraft.introEn: A twin-turboprop STOL airliner that swaps wheels for floats or skis to reach small strips big aircraft cannot use — the bush communities' bus.

history.statusZh: 生產中（DHC-6 家族 1965 年首飛、1966 年服役；Viking Air 2008 年復產 Series 400，2010 年起交付）。
history.statusEn: In production (the DHC-6 family first flew in 1965 and entered service in 1966; Viking Air restarted production with the Series 400, delivered from 2010).

wings.zh: 高置直翼，翼面平直，起落架固定唔收。
wings.en: High, straight wing with fixed landing gear.

engines.zh: 兩台 PT6A 渦輪螺旋槳引擎裝在翼上，三葉螺旋槳。
engines.en: Two PT6A turboprops on the wing with three-blade propellers.

fuselage.zh: 方正機身，一排小圓角窗，最多 19 名乘客；可換浮筒（相片即浮筒型）。
fuselage.en: Boxy fuselage with a row of small windows for up to 19 passengers; floats can be fitted (as pictured).

tail.zh: 高垂直尾翼，水平尾翼裝在機尾中段。
tail.en: Tall vertical fin with the horizontal tail at the rear fuselage.

aircraft.similarZh: 同 C172 比：同是高翼，但 DHC-6 雙引擎、大一截、19 座。同 BN-2 Islander 比：DHC-6 用渦槳、載客更多、STOL 性能更強。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Cessna 172: also high-wing, but twin-engined, much bigger, 19 seats. Versus the BN-2 Islander: turboprops, more seats, stronger STOL performance.

length.noteZh: 全長（連轉動中旋翼；機身長 10.58 米）

engines.noteZh: 單台渦輪軸引擎（約 813 軸馬力）

seats.noteZh: 連機師共 7 座

range.noteZh: 最大航程（不同來源有 598–612 公里，見 docs/05）
range.noteEn: Maximum range (sources vary 598–612 km; see docs/05)

recognitionZh: 四葉主旋翼（源自 OH-58D 的設計），飛行時槳葉下垂弧度柔和；這是 407 別於兩葉 JetRanger 的關鍵。
單台渦輪軸引擎藏在機艙後的引擎艙內，頂部有入氣口、兩側排氣。
蛋形機艙源自 206 家族但更寬，窗戶大；滑橇式起落架。
幼長尾梁，末端有垂直尾翼和兩葉尾旋翼，下方有尾橇保護。
recognitionEn: Four-blade main rotor (from the OH-58D) — the key split from the two-blade JetRanger.
One turboshaft in the deck behind the cabin, with a top intake and side exhausts.
Wider egg-shaped cabin from the 206 family with big windows; skid landing gear.
Slim tail boom with a fin, two-blade tail rotor and a protective tail skid.

photo.author: Raimond Spekking
photo.creditZh: 相片：Raimond Spekking／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 4.0）· Bell 407（D-HBEN）在德國下萊茵機場地面啟動（2004 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: Raimond Spekking / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) · Bell 407 (D-HBEN) starting up at Niederrhein, Germany (2004)
photo.captionZh: 地面啟動中：四葉主旋翼、蛋形大窗機艙同滑橇一覽無遺。
photo.captionEn: Starting up on the ground: four-blade rotor, big-window egg cabin and skids.

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 本卡為標準型 Bell 407（源自 Bell 206 JetRanger 家族）；其後有馬力更強的 407GX／GXi 玻璃駕駛艙型號，外形大致相同。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: This card covers the standard Bell 407 (developed from the Bell 206 JetRanger family); the later 407GX/GXi have glass cockpits but look much the same.
aircraft.introZh: 把 JetRanger 升級成四葉旋翼的輕型直升機：Bell 407 以平滑寧靜的飛行品質，成為警務、醫療救援和觀光飛行的常用機型。
aircraft.introEn: The JetRanger grown smoother: with a four-blade rotor, the Bell 407 became a favourite for police, air-ambulance and sightseeing work.

history.statusZh: 生產中、服役中（1996 年投入服務；全球交付逾千架，香港亦有同系 Bell 206 家族服役背景可作對照）。
history.statusEn: In production and in service (entered service in 1996; over a thousand delivered worldwide).

wings.zh: 四葉主旋翼（源自 OH-58D 的設計），飛行時槳葉下垂弧度柔和；這是 407 別於兩葉 JetRanger 的關鍵。
wings.en: Four-blade main rotor (from the OH-58D) — the key split from the two-blade JetRanger.

engines.zh: 單台渦輪軸引擎藏在機艙後的引擎艙內，頂部有入氣口、兩側排氣。
engines.en: One turboshaft in the deck behind the cabin, with a top intake and side exhausts.

fuselage.zh: 蛋形機艙源自 206 家族但更寬，窗戶大；滑橇式起落架。
fuselage.en: Wider egg-shaped cabin from the 206 family with big windows; skid landing gear.

tail.zh: 幼長尾梁，末端有垂直尾翼和兩葉尾旋翼，下方有尾橇保護。
tail.en: Slim tail boom with a fin, two-blade tail rotor and a protective tail skid.

aircraft.recognitionSource: 原創撰寫：WEFT 四項（見 docs/02）
aircraft.similarZh: 同自家 Bell 206 JetRanger 比：206 是兩葉旋翼、機艙較窄；407 是四葉、較寬較寧靜。同 R66 比（本網 AC-0064 有卡）：R66 體形較細、兩葉旋翼，407 大一級而且是四葉。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus its own Bell 206 JetRanger ancestor: two blades and a narrower cabin there; four blades, wider and quieter here. Versus the R66 (card AC-0064): the Robinson is smaller with two blades; the 407 is a class up.

length.noteZh: 連主旋翼轉動全長（D 值）

engines.value: 2 × Safran Arrius 2B2 Plus or Pratt & Whitney Canada PW206B3
engines.noteZh: 雙渦軸引擎（二選一）

seats.noteZh: 最多（1–2 名機師＋乘客）

recognitionZh: 四葉主旋翼，直徑 10.40 米，轉速低、噪音細。
機身上方並排兩台引擎（Arrius 2B2 Plus 或 PW206B3）。
流線蛋形機身，大面積玻璃駕駛艙，滑橇式起落架。
招牌 Fenestron：尾槳藏在尾翼的圓形涵道入面，冇外露槳葉。
recognitionEn: Four-blade main rotor, 10.40 m diameter, quiet-running.
Two engines side by side above the cabin (Arrius 2B2 Plus or PW206B3).
Streamlined egg-shaped fuselage, large glazed cockpit, skid landing gear.
Signature Fenestron: the tail rotor is enclosed in a circular duct in the fin — no exposed blades.

photo.author: James
photo.creditZh: 相片：James／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 2.0）· 英國國家警察航空服務 EC135（G-POLD）升空
photo.creditEn: Photo: James / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0) · UK National Police Air Service EC135 (G-POLD) lifting off
photo.captionZh: 警用 EC135：尾翼圓筒入面的 Fenestron 涵道尾槳一眼可認。
photo.captionEn: Police EC135: the fenestron duct in the fin is visible at a glance.

sourcesToCheck.labelZh: Airbus 官方 H135 技術資料

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「Eurocopter EC-135」；2014 年起改隸 Airbus Helicopters 並改名 H135，ICAO 代碼同為 EC35。規格以 H135 為準；相片是英國警用 EC135，同型外形相同。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Listed as “Eurocopter EC-135”; renamed H135 under Airbus Helicopters from 2014, same ICAO code EC35. Figures are for the H135; the photo shows a UK police EC135, externally identical.
aircraft.introZh: 輕型雙引擎直升機：尾旋翼藏在尾翼圓筒入面（Fenestron 涵道尾槳），噪音低，是全球警務同空中醫療的主力機種，在城市上空特別常見。
aircraft.introEn: A light twin helicopter whose tail rotor hides inside a fenestron duct — quiet, and a worldwide police and air-ambulance favourite over cities.

history.statusZh: 生產中（1996 年以 EC135 投入服務，2014 年起改名 H135）。
history.statusEn: In production (entered service as the EC135 in 1996; renamed H135 from 2014).

wings.zh: 四葉主旋翼，直徑 10.40 米，轉速低、噪音細。
wings.en: Four-blade main rotor, 10.40 m diameter, quiet-running.

engines.zh: 機身上方並排兩台引擎（Arrius 2B2 Plus 或 PW206B3）。
engines.en: Two engines side by side above the cabin (Arrius 2B2 Plus or PW206B3).

fuselage.zh: 流線蛋形機身，大面積玻璃駕駛艙，滑橇式起落架。
fuselage.en: Streamlined egg-shaped fuselage, large glazed cockpit, skid landing gear.

tail.zh: 招牌 Fenestron：尾槳藏在尾翼的圓形涵道入面，冇外露槳葉。
tail.en: Signature Fenestron: the tail rotor is enclosed in a circular duct in the fin — no exposed blades.

aircraft.similarZh: 同 H145 比：H145 大一級而且用傳統外露尾槳。同 AW139 比：H135 是輕型（約 3 噸），AW139 是中型（約 7 噸），大細差一倍有多。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the H145: a size bigger with a conventional exposed tail rotor. Versus the AW139: light class (about 3 t) against a medium (about 7 t) — half the size.

deepLinks.labelZh: Airbus 官方 H135 技術資料

aircraft.nameZh: 西科斯基 UH-60 黑鷹直升機

length.noteZh: 連旋翼轉動全長；機身 15.27 米

engines.noteZh: 雙渦軸引擎

seats.noteZh: 全副武裝士兵（另加機組人員）

range.noteZh: 轉場航程（連外掛油箱）；作戰半徑約 592 公里
range.noteEn: Ferry range (with external tanks); combat radius about 592 km

recognitionZh: 四葉主旋翼，直徑 16.36 米，旋翼頭有整流罩。
機身兩側上方兩台 T700 引擎，排氣口向外上方。
方正軍用機身，兩側大趟門；起落架尾輪在機尾最末端。
大型可調水平安定面橫貫機尾，是黑鷹的特徵；尾旋翼在尾端。
recognitionEn: Four-blade main rotor, 16.36 m diameter, with a faired hub.
Two T700 engines high on the fuselage sides, exhausting up and out.
Boxy military fuselage with large sliding cabin doors; the tail wheel sits at the very end of the tail.
A large adjustable stabilator across the tail — a Black Hawk trademark — with the tail rotor at the tip.

photo.author: Sgt. 1st Class Antony Joseph, U.S. Army
photo.creditZh: 相片：Sgt. 1st Class Antony Joseph／美國陸軍（Public domain）· 美軍 UH-60 編隊於伊拉克起飛（2006）
photo.creditEn: Photo: Sgt. 1st Class Antony Joseph / U.S. Army (Public domain) · U.S. Army UH-60s lifting off in Iraq (2006)
photo.captionZh: 編隊起飛（右上為主機）：方正機身、大安定面同尾輪佈局齊全。
photo.captionEn: Formation lift-off (main aircraft top right): boxy fuselage, big stabilator and tail-wheel layout.

sourcesToCheck.labelZh: 英文維基：Sikorsky UH-60 Black Hawk

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「Sikorsky UH-60 Black Hawk」；ICAO 代碼 H60 涵蓋整個 S-70 家族（海鷹、鋪路鷹等），規格以陸軍 UH-60 為代表。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The ICAO code H60 covers the whole S-70 family (Seahawk, Pave Hawk, etc.); figures represent the Army UH-60.
aircraft.introZh: 美軍主力通用直升機：可載 11 名士兵、吊運裝備，電影《黑鷹降落》令佢家喻戶曉；全球多國軍隊採用，是軍事迷必認的機型。
aircraft.introEn: The US military's workhorse utility helicopter — 11 troops or sling loads, made famous by “Black Hawk Down” and flown by many armed forces.

history.statusZh: 生產中、廣泛服役（衍生型包括海軍 SH-60 海鷹、空軍 HH-60 鋪路鷹等）。
history.statusEn: In production and widespread service (derivatives include the Navy SH-60 Seahawk and Air Force HH-60 Pave Hawk).

wings.zh: 四葉主旋翼，直徑 16.36 米，旋翼頭有整流罩。
wings.en: Four-blade main rotor, 16.36 m diameter, with a faired hub.

engines.zh: 機身兩側上方兩台 T700 引擎，排氣口向外上方。
engines.en: Two T700 engines high on the fuselage sides, exhausting up and out.

fuselage.zh: 方正軍用機身，兩側大趟門；起落架尾輪在機尾最末端。
fuselage.en: Boxy military fuselage with large sliding cabin doors; the tail wheel sits at the very end of the tail.

tail.zh: 大型可調水平安定面橫貫機尾，是黑鷹的特徵；尾旋翼在尾端。
tail.en: A large adjustable stabilator across the tail — a Black Hawk trademark — with the tail rotor at the tip.

aircraft.similarZh: 同直-9 比：UH-60 大一級、方正軍味濃、尾輪在最後。同 AW139 比：UH-60 是軍用設計（趟門、尾輪佈局），AW139 是民用客艙設計。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Z-9: a size bigger, boxier and unmistakably military, tail wheel at the very rear. Versus the AW139: military layout (sliding doors, tail wheel) against a civil cabin design.

deepLinks.labelZh: 英文維基：Sikorsky UH-60 Black Hawk
deepLinks.labelEn: English Wikipedia: Sikorsky UH-60 Black Hawk

aircraft.nameZh: 羅賓遜 R44 直升機

engines.noteZh: 單活塞引擎

seats.noteZh: 含機師

recognitionZh: 兩葉主旋翼，旋翼桅桿特別高（high mast），直徑約 10.06 米。
機艙後一台 Lycoming 活塞引擎，機身兩側有散熱格柵。
圓潤蛋形機艙，前座大玻璃，滑橇式起落架。
細長尾桿，尾端兩葉尾旋翼加上垂直尾翼。
recognitionEn: Two-blade main rotor on a distinctively tall mast, about 10.06 m diameter.
A single Lycoming piston engine behind the cabin, with cooling grilles on the fuselage sides.
Rounded egg-shaped cabin, big front glazing, skid landing gear.
Slender tail boom with a two-blade tail rotor and vertical fin at the end.

photo.author: Adrian Pingstone (Arpingstone)
photo.creditZh: 相片：Adrian Pingstone (Arpingstone)／Wikimedia Commons（Public domain）· Robinson R44 Astro（G-PFML）懸停中
photo.creditEn: Photo: Adrian Pingstone (Arpingstone) / Wikimedia Commons (Public domain) · Robinson R44 Astro (G-PFML) hovering
photo.captionZh: 高旋翼桅加蛋形機艙——Robinson 家族的招牌模樣。
photo.captionEn: Tall rotor mast and egg-shaped cabin — the Robinson family look.

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「Robinson R44」；規格以燃油噴射的 Raven II 為代表。相片是早期活塞化油器型 Astro，外形與 Raven II 相同。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Figures are for the fuel-injected Raven II. The photo shows the earlier carburetted Astro, externally identical.
aircraft.introZh: 全球最暢銷的輕型直升機之一：四座、活塞引擎，好多人學飛、空中攝影同遊覽飛行都用佢，在香港的直升機服務亦常見。
aircraft.introEn: One of the world's best-selling light helicopters: four seats and a piston engine, used for training, photography and sightseeing.

history.statusZh: 生產中（1992 年獲 FAA 認證；R44 家族是 Robinson 最暢銷產品）。
history.statusEn: In production (FAA-certified in 1992; the R44 family is Robinson's best seller).

wings.zh: 兩葉主旋翼，旋翼桅桿特別高（high mast），直徑約 10.06 米。
wings.en: Two-blade main rotor on a distinctively tall mast, about 10.06 m diameter.

engines.zh: 機艙後一台 Lycoming 活塞引擎，機身兩側有散熱格柵。
engines.en: A single Lycoming piston engine behind the cabin, with cooling grilles on the fuselage sides.

fuselage.zh: 圓潤蛋形機艙，前座大玻璃，滑橇式起落架。
fuselage.en: Rounded egg-shaped cabin, big front glazing, skid landing gear.

tail.zh: 細長尾桿，尾端兩葉尾旋翼加上垂直尾翼。
tail.en: Slender tail boom with a two-blade tail rotor and vertical fin at the end.

aircraft.similarZh: 同 R22 比：R44 大一圈、四座（R22 兩座）、機櫈較圓。同 H135 比：R44 是活塞單引擎輕型機，H135 是渦軸雙引擎，尾槳亦不同（外露對 Fenestron）。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the R22: a size bigger with four seats (R22: two). Versus the H135: piston single against a turbine twin, exposed tail rotor against a fenestron.

aircraft.nameZh: 波音 CH-47 契努克直升機

length.noteZh: 旋翼轉動時全長（機身長 15.9 米）

height.noteEn: To the top of the rear pylon

engines.noteZh: Honeywell 渦軸引擎（裝於後塔兩側）

seats.noteZh: 可載全副裝備士兵 33 名（最多 55 人）

range.noteZh: 任務航程（轉場航程約 2,020 公里）
range.noteEn: Mission radius range (ferry range about 2,020 km)

recognitionZh: 縱列雙旋翼：機頭和機尾各一副三葉旋翼，前後配合升空，沒有尾槳。
兩台 T55 引擎裝在機尾旋翼塔兩側的短艙內。
扁長機身，機尾有整幅跳板貨艙門，機腹中央設吊運鉤，兩側有長形油箱整流罩。
沒有傳統尾翼；高聳的後旋翼塔就是 Chinook 最招牌的剪影。
recognitionEn: Tandem rotors: a three-blade rotor at each end working together, with no tail rotor.
Two T55 engines in pods flanking the rear rotor pylon.
Long slab-sided body with a full-width rear loading ramp, a belly cargo hook and long fuel sponsons.
No conventional tail; the tall rear pylon is the Chinook's signature silhouette.

photo.author: Cpl. Jeraco Jenkins, U.S. Marine Corps
photo.creditZh: 相片：Cpl. Jeraco Jenkins／美國海軍陸戰隊／Wikimedia Commons（公共領域）· 西班牙陸軍 CH-47 在吊運訓練中低空懸停
photo.creditEn: Photo: Cpl. Jeraco Jenkins / U.S. Marine Corps / Wikimedia Commons (public domain) · A Spanish Army CH-47 hovering during sling-load training
photo.captionZh: 低空懸停的 CH-47：前後雙旋翼、後塔引擎艙同長形油箱罩都清楚可見。
photo.captionEn: A CH-47 at a low hover: tandem rotors, rear-pylon engine pods and long sponsons all show clearly.

annotations.zh: 後塔旁的 T55 引擎艙
annotations.en: T55 engine pod by the rear pylon

aircraft.introZh: 服役逾 60 年的重型運輸直升機代表作：前後雙旋翼、後跳板入貨，可以吊起火炮和車輛，是各國軍方和救災任務的重型吊運主力。
aircraft.introEn: The definitive heavy-lift helicopter, in service for over 60 years: tandem rotors and a rear ramp let it sling artillery and vehicles for militaries and disaster relief worldwide.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「Boeing CH-47 Chinook」；本卡以現役主力 CH-47F 的數據為代表（早期 A／D 型尺寸大致相同，航電與引擎有別）。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The badge list names the Boeing CH-47 Chinook; this card uses the current CH-47F as representative (earlier A/D models are near-identical in size, with different avionics and engines).

history.statusZh: 服役中（美國陸軍 CH-47F 及 Block II 升級持續中；十多國採用，日本、印度、澳洲等都有機隊）。
history.statusEn: In service (the US Army's CH-47F and Block II upgrades continue; more than a dozen nations fly it, including Japan, India and Australia).

wings.zh: 縱列雙旋翼：機頭和機尾各一副三葉旋翼，前後配合升空，沒有尾槳。
wings.en: Tandem rotors: a three-blade rotor at each end working together, with no tail rotor.

engines.zh: 兩台 T55 引擎裝在機尾旋翼塔兩側的短艙內。
engines.en: Two T55 engines in pods flanking the rear rotor pylon.

fuselage.zh: 扁長機身，機尾有整幅跳板貨艙門，機腹中央設吊運鉤，兩側有長形油箱整流罩。
fuselage.en: Long slab-sided body with a full-width rear loading ramp, a belly cargo hook and long fuel sponsons.

tail.zh: 沒有傳統尾翼；高聳的後旋翼塔就是 Chinook 最招牌的剪影。
tail.en: No conventional tail; the tall rear pylon is the Chinook's signature silhouette.

aircraft.similarZh: 同 UH-60 黑鷹比（本網有卡）：Chinook 大得多、用縱列雙旋翼而唔係尾槳，載重以噸計，全機尾跳板入貨。同普通直升機最大分別：一眼數到兩副大旋翼。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the UH-60 Black Hawk (also in this guide): the Chinook is far bigger, uses tandem rotors instead of a tail rotor, lifts tonnes, and loads through a rear ramp. The twin rotors give it away instantly.

aircraft.nameZh: 洛克希德馬丁 F-16 戰隼

wingspan.noteZh: 連翼尖飛彈；不連飛彈 9.45 米

engines.value: 1 × Pratt & Whitney F100 or General Electric F110 (afterburning)
engines.noteZh: 單引擎（加後燃器）

seats.noteZh: 飛行員（C 型單座；D 型雙座）

range.noteZh: 轉場航程逾 2,000 英里（美國空軍資料，約數）
range.noteEn: Ferry range over 2,000 mi (USAF data, approx.)

cruise.noteZh: 最大速度（戰鬥機以最大速度標示）

recognitionZh: 中置後掠翼同機身融合（翼身融合），翼下可掛飛彈同副油箱（相片全副武裝）。
機尾一台加後燃器引擎；入氣口在機鼻下方（下巴式入氣口）——正面認機關鍵。
修長機身，氣泡形座艙罩視野無遮擋，機鼻尖細。
單一垂直尾翼，尾翼下方有兩片腹鰭。
recognitionEn: Mid-set swept wing blended into the fuselage, carrying missiles and drop tanks (fully armed in the photo).
One afterburning engine in the tail; the intake sits under the nose (chin intake) — the key head-on recognition point.
Slender fuselage with an all-round-vision bubble canopy and a pointed nose.
Single vertical fin with two ventral fins beneath the tail.

photo.author: Staff Sgt. Cherie A. Thurlby, U.S. Air Force
photo.creditZh: 相片：Staff Sgt. Cherie A. Thurlby／美國空軍（Public domain）· F-16 於伊拉克上空飛行（2003）
photo.creditEn: Photo: Staff Sgt. Cherie A. Thurlby / U.S. Air Force (Public domain) · F-16 over Iraq (2003)
photo.captionZh: 正前方角度：氣泡座艙、機腹下巴入氣口同翼下武裝一覽無遺。
photo.captionEn: Head-on view: bubble canopy, chin intake and underwing stores all on show.

sourcesToCheck.labelZh: 美國空軍官方 F-16 資料頁

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「Lockheed Martin F-16 Falcon」；規格以最常見的單座 F-16C 為代表（雙座版為 F-16D）。F-16 原由 General Dynamics 研製，生產線後轉至 Lockheed Martin。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Figures represent the single-seat F-16C (the two-seater is the F-16D). Designed by General Dynamics; production later moved to Lockheed Martin.
aircraft.introZh: 全球最普及的戰鬥機之一：單引擎、單座、氣泡座艙，1979 年服役至今仍是多國空軍主力，產量逾 4,600 架——航空迷必認的經典。
aircraft.introEn: One of the world's most widely used fighters: single engine, single seat, bubble canopy — frontline since 1979 with over 4,600 built.

history.statusZh: 生產中（最新 Block 70/72 仍有訂單；全球多國空軍服役）。
history.statusEn: In production (latest Block 70/72 still on order; in service with many air forces).

wings.zh: 中置後掠翼同機身融合（翼身融合），翼下可掛飛彈同副油箱（相片全副武裝）。
wings.en: Mid-set swept wing blended into the fuselage, carrying missiles and drop tanks (fully armed in the photo).

engines.zh: 機尾一台加後燃器引擎；入氣口在機鼻下方（下巴式入氣口）——正面認機關鍵。
engines.en: One afterburning engine in the tail; the intake sits under the nose (chin intake) — the key head-on recognition point.

fuselage.zh: 修長機身，氣泡形座艙罩視野無遮擋，機鼻尖細。
fuselage.en: Slender fuselage with an all-round-vision bubble canopy and a pointed nose.

tail.zh: 單一垂直尾翼，尾翼下方有兩片腹鰭。
tail.en: Single vertical fin with two ventral fins beneath the tail.

aircraft.similarZh: 同 F-22 比：F-16 單引擎、單尾翼、外形圓滑傳統；F-22 雙引擎、雙尾翼、稜角隱形。同殲-20 比：殲-20 有鴨翼、雙引擎、大一截，而且是隱形設計。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the F-22: one engine and fin, rounded classic lines, against twin engines, twin fins and stealth angles. Versus the J-20: the J-20 adds canards, a second engine and stealth shaping, and is much bigger.

deepLinks.labelZh: 美國空軍官方 F-16 資料頁
deepLinks.labelEn: U.S. Air Force official F-16 fact sheet

aircraft.nameZh: 洛克希德馬丁 F-35A 閃電II

engines.noteZh: 單台普惠渦輪扇引擎（連後燃器）

seats.noteZh: 單座機師

range.noteZh: 內部燃油航程（作戰半徑約 1,093 公里）
range.noteEn: Range on internal fuel (combat radius about 1,093 km)

cruise.noteZh: 最大速度（戰鬥機慣例在此欄列最大速度）

recognitionZh: 梯形主翼後掠角大，與機身融合（blend）成匿蹤外形，翼尖截平。
單台 F135 引擎藏在機身內，兩側是 DSI「無附面層」進氣道（有一塊鼓起的駝峰），尾噴口在雙尾翼之間。
機身線條多平面折角、鋸齒邊緣對齊，全部為減低雷達反射；座艙罩一體成型向前開。
一對外傾的垂直尾翼加全動水平尾翼，尾翼之間是引擎噴口。
recognitionEn: A trapezoidal wing blended smoothly into the fuselage for stealth, with clipped tips.
One F135 buried in the body, fed by two diverterless (DSI) intakes with their tell-tale bumps; the nozzle sits between the tails.
Faceted, edge-aligned surfaces everywhere to cut radar returns; a one-piece forward-opening canopy.
Twin canted vertical tails and all-moving tailplanes flanking the engine nozzle.

photo.author: MSgt. Donald R. Allen, U.S. Air Force
photo.creditZh: 相片：MSgt. Donald R. Allen／美國空軍／Wikimedia Commons（公共領域）· 美國空軍 F-35A 在空中加油任務中飛行
photo.creditEn: Photo: MSgt. Donald R. Allen / U.S. Air Force / Wikimedia Commons (public domain) · A USAF F-35A during an aerial-refuelling mission
photo.captionZh: 正面飛來的 F-35A：DSI 進氣道駝峰、外傾雙尾翼同匿蹤折角一覽無遺。
photo.captionEn: An F-35A head-on: DSI intake bumps, canted twin tails and faceted stealth shaping.

sourcesToCheck.labelZh: 英文維基：Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II

aircraft.introZh: 西方世界產量最大的第五代匿蹤戰機：F-35 把雷達匿蹤、超音速和全機感測器融合在一架單引擎戰機上，十多國空軍都以它作主力；2025 年珠海航展以外的亞洲部署亦越來越常見。
aircraft.introEn: The West's most-produced fifth-generation stealth fighter, packing radar stealth, supersonic speed and fused sensors into a single-engine jet flown by more than a dozen air forces.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II」；本卡以最普及的空軍型 F-35A 為代表（B 型可短場垂直升降、C 型是航母艦載型，外形略有不同）。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The badge list names the Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II; this card uses the most common air-force F-35A (the B can take off short and land vertically; the C is the carrier version).

history.statusZh: 生產中、服役中（美國空軍 2016 年宣佈 F-35A 形成戰力；全球訂單逾 3,000 架，是史上最大戰機計劃）。
history.statusEn: In production and in service (the USAF declared the F-35A combat-ready in 2016; over 3,000 are on order in history's largest fighter programme).

wings.zh: 梯形主翼後掠角大，與機身融合（blend）成匿蹤外形，翼尖截平。
wings.en: A trapezoidal wing blended smoothly into the fuselage for stealth, with clipped tips.

engines.zh: 單台 F135 引擎藏在機身內，兩側是 DSI「無附面層」進氣道（有一塊鼓起的駝峰），尾噴口在雙尾翼之間。
engines.en: One F135 buried in the body, fed by two diverterless (DSI) intakes with their tell-tale bumps; the nozzle sits between the tails.

fuselage.zh: 機身線條多平面折角、鋸齒邊緣對齊，全部為減低雷達反射；座艙罩一體成型向前開。
fuselage.en: Faceted, edge-aligned surfaces everywhere to cut radar returns; a one-piece forward-opening canopy.

tail.zh: 一對外傾的垂直尾翼加全動水平尾翼，尾翼之間是引擎噴口。
tail.en: Twin canted vertical tails and all-moving tailplanes flanking the engine nozzle.

aircraft.similarZh: 同 F-22 比（本網有卡）：F-35 較細、單引擎、機身較肥，任務偏多用途打擊；F-22 是雙引擎空優專長。同 F-16 比：F-16 機腹單一進氣道好易認，F-35 是兩側 DSI 進氣加匿蹤折角外形。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the F-22 (also in this guide): the F-35 is smaller, single-engined and plumper, built for multirole strike; the F-22 is a twin-engine air-superiority specialist. Versus the F-16: the F-16's single chin intake is obvious, while the F-35 has twin cheek DSI intakes and faceted stealth shaping.

deepLinks.labelZh: 英文維基：Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II
deepLinks.labelEn: English Wikipedia: Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II
Lockheed Martin: F-35 official product page

aircraft.nameZh: 波音 C-17 全球霸王III

wingspan.noteZh: 翼展至翼尖小翼（169 尺 10 吋）
wingspan.noteEn: Wingspan to winglet tips (169 ft 10 in)

engines.noteZh: 四渦輪扇引擎

recognitionZh: 高置後掠翼，翼尖有小翼，翼下四台引擎；大襟翼令它可以慢慢飛入短跑道。
四台 Pratt & Whitney F117 渦輪扇（波音 757 引擎的軍用版），短艙貼住機翼。
粗壯高身機身，機頭圓鈍、駕駛艙窗細細哋高高在上；機尾有大跳板門入貨。
T 型尾翼：水平尾翼在垂直尾翼頂端，是 C-17 最易認的記號之一。
recognitionEn: High swept wing with winglets and four engines underneath; big flaps let it fly slowly into short strips.
Four Pratt & Whitney F117 turbofans (military version of the Boeing 757's engine) in pods hugging the wing.
Chunky, tall fuselage with a blunt nose and small high cockpit windows; a big rear ramp loads cargo.
T-tail: the horizontal stabiliser sits on top of the fin — one of the C-17's easiest tells.

photo.author: U.S. Air Force
photo.creditZh: 相片：美國空軍／Wikimedia Commons（公有領域）· C-17 Globemaster III T-1 在加州 Owens Valley 上空試飛
photo.creditEn: Photo: U.S. Air Force / Wikimedia Commons (public domain) · C-17 Globemaster III T-1 over Owens Valley, California
photo.captionZh: 飛行中前側面：T 型尾翼、四台引擎同翼尖小翼全部入鏡，是 Commons 的特色圖片。
photo.captionEn: In-flight front-quarter view: T-tail, four engines and winglets all in frame — a Commons featured picture.

sourcesToCheck.labelZh: 美國空軍官方：C-17 Fact Sheet
中文維基：波音 C-17 全球霸王 III
英文維基：Boeing C-17 Globemaster III

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 本卡是 C-17A（唯一量產型）；由麥道研製、波音在 2015 年交付最後一架後停產，現役於美國、英國、澳洲、印度等多國空軍。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: This card is the C-17A, the only production variant; developed by McDonnell Douglas, with Boeing delivering the last aircraft in 2015. It serves with the US, UK, Australian, Indian and other air forces.
aircraft.introZh: 美軍主力戰略兼戰術運輸機：可以洲際運送坦克，又可以在短而簡陋的跑道升降，T 型尾翼加四引擎是招牌外形。
aircraft.introEn: The USAF's main strategic-and-tactical airlifter: it can haul a tank across oceans yet use short, austere strips. The T-tail and four engines are its signature.

history.statusZh: 服役中；已停產（1991–2015 年共 279 架，最後一架 2015 年交付）
history.statusEn: In service; production ended (279 built 1991–2015, last delivered in 2015)

wings.zh: 高置後掠翼，翼尖有小翼，翼下四台引擎；大襟翼令它可以慢慢飛入短跑道。
wings.en: High swept wing with winglets and four engines underneath; big flaps let it fly slowly into short strips.

engines.zh: 四台 Pratt & Whitney F117 渦輪扇（波音 757 引擎的軍用版），短艙貼住機翼。
engines.en: Four Pratt & Whitney F117 turbofans (military version of the Boeing 757's engine) in pods hugging the wing.

fuselage.zh: 粗壯高身機身，機頭圓鈍、駕駛艙窗細細哋高高在上；機尾有大跳板門入貨。
fuselage.en: Chunky, tall fuselage with a blunt nose and small high cockpit windows; a big rear ramp loads cargo.

tail.zh: T 型尾翼：水平尾翼在垂直尾翼頂端，是 C-17 最易認的記號之一。
tail.en: T-tail: the horizontal stabiliser sits on top of the fin — one of the C-17's easiest tells.

aircraft.similarZh: 同 C-130H 比：C-17 用噴射引擎（C-130 是螺旋槳）、大得多而且是 T 尾；同 An-124 比：C-17 細一截（53 米 vs 69.1 米），機鼻唔會掀起，靠機尾跳板入貨。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the C-130H: the C-17 is jet-powered (the Hercules has propellers), much bigger and T-tailed. Versus the An-124: the C-17 is smaller (53 m vs 69.1 m), its nose does not open, and it loads through the rear ramp.

deepLinks.labelEn: US Air Force official: C-17 fact sheet
