aircraft.introEn: COMAC's first jet airliner: rear-mounted engines and a T-tail, in service with Chengdu Airlines since 2016 — a milestone for China's regional jet industry.

history.statusZh: 生產中（2024 年改名 C909 繼續交付；成都航空、中國國際航空等營運）。
history.statusEn: In production (deliveries continue under the C909 name since 2024; flown by Chengdu Airlines, Air China and others).

wings.zh: 下單翼後掠翼，翼尖有小翼，裝在機身後半部。
wings.en: Low swept wing with winglets, set well back on the fuselage.

engines.zh: 兩台引擎裝在機尾兩側（尾吊式），唔在翼下——最關鍵的辨認點。
engines.en: Two engines mounted on the rear fuselage (not under the wing) — the key recognition point.

fuselage.zh: 窄體單通道機身，機尾向上收窄，窗線平直。
fuselage.en: Narrowbody single-aisle fuselage with an upswept tail cone.

tail.zh: T 形尾翼：水平尾翼裝在垂直尾翼頂端。
tail.en: T-tail: horizontal stabiliser on top of the fin.

aircraft.similarZh: 同 A320 系列比：ARJ21 細一截（33.5 米），而且引擎在機尾唔在翼下。同 CRJ、E-Jet 等支線機比，尾吊引擎加 T 尾的組合最接近；外形常被指似 DC-9/MD-80 家族。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the A320 family: much smaller (33.5 m) with rear-mounted engines. Closest to CRJ/E-Jet regional jets in layout; often compared to the DC-9/MD-80 family.

aircraft.nameZh: 昌河 直-8 直升機

length.noteZh: 連旋翼轉動全長；機身 19.40 米

engines.noteZh: 三台渦軸引擎

seats.noteZh: 士兵；民用型可載客約 39 名
seats.noteEn: Troops; civil versions carry about 39 passengers

range.noteZh: 一般任務航程（約數）；加油箱轉場更遠
range.noteEn: Typical mission range (approx.); ferry range longer with tanks

recognitionZh: 六葉主旋翼，直徑 18.90 米。
機身上方三台 WZ-6 引擎並排——三引擎是超級黃蜂家族記號。
船形機底可水上起降，機身兩側有穩定浮筒；艦載型機鼻有大型雷達罩（相片）。
尾桿尾端有尾旋翼；艦載型尾桿可摺疊方便入艦庫。
recognitionEn: Six-blade main rotor, 18.90 m diameter.
Three WZ-6 engines in a row above the fuselage — the Super Frelon family trademark.
Boat hull for water operations with sponsons on the sides; naval versions carry a large nose radome (as pictured).
Tail rotor at the boom tip; naval versions fold the tail for shipboard stowage.

photo.author: Rob Schleiffert
photo.creditZh: 相片：Rob Schleiffert／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 2.0）· 中國海軍直-8J 停泊於艦上（鹿特丹，2015）
photo.creditEn: Photo: Rob Schleiffert / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0) · PLA Navy Z-8J on deck (Rotterdam, 2015)
photo.captionZh: 艦載直-8J：黑色機鼻雷達罩、船形機底同三引擎佈局清楚可見。
photo.captionEn: Naval Z-8J: black nose radome, boat hull and three-engine deck all visible.

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「Changhe Z-8 / SA-321 Super Frelon」；直-8 本是法國 SA 321 超級黃蜂的國產化版本，所以 ICAO 代碼同原版共用 FREL。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The Z-8 is the Chinese-developed version of the French SA 321 Super Frelon, so it shares the ICAO code FREL with the original.
aircraft.introZh: 中國重型直升機代表：源自法國超級黃蜂，三台引擎、六葉旋翼，船形機底可以落水，是海軍艦載、運輸同搜救的重型主力。
aircraft.introEn: China's heavy helicopter: developed from the French Super Frelon with three engines, a six-blade rotor and a boat hull for water landings — a naval transport and SAR heavyweight.

history.statusZh: 服役中（改進型直-8L、直-18 等持續發展；海軍、陸軍同空軍均有使用）。
history.statusEn: In service (improved Z-8L and Z-18 derivatives continue development across the navy, army and air force).

wings.zh: 六葉主旋翼，直徑 18.90 米。
wings.en: Six-blade main rotor, 18.90 m diameter.

engines.zh: 機身上方三台 WZ-6 引擎並排——三引擎是超級黃蜂家族記號。
engines.en: Three WZ-6 engines in a row above the fuselage — the Super Frelon family trademark.

fuselage.zh: 船形機底可水上起降，機身兩側有穩定浮筒；艦載型機鼻有大型雷達罩（相片）。
fuselage.en: Boat hull for water operations with sponsons on the sides; naval versions carry a large nose radome (as pictured).

tail.zh: 尾桿尾端有尾旋翼；艦載型尾桿可摺疊方便入艦庫。
tail.en: Tail rotor at the boom tip; naval versions fold the tail for shipboard stowage.

aircraft.similarZh: 同 UH-60 比：直-8 大一級、三引擎、船形機底；UH-60 雙引擎、陸上起落架。同 AW139 比：直-8 是 13 噸級重型，AW139 是約 7 噸中型，旋翼六葉對五葉。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the UH-60: a size bigger, three engines, boat hull. Versus the AW139: 13-tonne heavy against a 7-tonne medium, six rotor blades against five.

engines.noteZh: 單渦軸引擎

seats.noteZh: 1 名機師＋4 名乘客

recognitionZh: 五葉主旋翼，直徑 8.33 米。
機身上方一台 Rolls-Royce 250 渦軸引擎。
圓蛋形機身（MD 500 家族外形），滑橇式起落架。
招牌 NOTAR：尾桿圓粗，尾端只有噴氣口同小垂直翼，完全冇尾旋翼。
recognitionEn: Five-blade main rotor, 8.33 m diameter.
A single Rolls-Royce 250 turboshaft above the fuselage.
Rounded egg-shaped fuselage (the MD 500 family shape) on skid gear.
Signature NOTAR: a fat round tail boom ending in a jet outlet and small fins — no tail rotor at all.

photo.author: Collectorofinsignia
photo.creditZh: 相片：Collectorofinsignia／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 3.0）· 比利時聯邦警察 MD 520N 飛行中
photo.creditEn: Photo: Collectorofinsignia / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 3.0) · Belgian Federal Police MD 520N in flight
photo.captionZh: 尾桿尾端冇任何槳葉——NOTAR 系統的直接證據。
photo.captionEn: No blades at the end of the tail boom — direct evidence of the NOTAR system.

sourcesToCheck.labelZh: 英文維基：MD Helicopters MD 500（520N 屬同系）

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「MD Helicopter MD-520N」；MD 520N 是 MD 500 家族成員，專門以 NOTAR 無尾槳系統作賣點，ICAO 代碼 MD52。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: A member of the MD 500 family built around the NOTAR no-tail-rotor system; ICAO code MD52.
aircraft.introZh: 冇尾旋翼的直升機：用 NOTAR 噴氣系統代替尾槳，安靜又唔怕撞到尾槳，是警用巡邏寵兒——認佢最易：尾巴圓碌碌、冇槳葉。
aircraft.introEn: The helicopter with no tail rotor: its NOTAR air-jet system is quiet and removes tail-rotor strike risk — a police favourite. Spot it by the smooth, blade-less tail.

history.statusZh: 已停產（1991 年獲 FAA 認證，首架同年交付美國鳳凰城警方；約 2000 年停產，仍有警隊使用）。
history.statusEn: Out of production (FAA-certified in 1991, first delivered to Phoenix police the same year; built until about 2000, still in police service).

wings.zh: 五葉主旋翼，直徑 8.33 米。
wings.en: Five-blade main rotor, 8.33 m diameter.

engines.zh: 機身上方一台 Rolls-Royce 250 渦軸引擎。
engines.en: A single Rolls-Royce 250 turboshaft above the fuselage.

fuselage.zh: 圓蛋形機身（MD 500 家族外形），滑橇式起落架。
fuselage.en: Rounded egg-shaped fuselage (the MD 500 family shape) on skid gear.

tail.zh: 招牌 NOTAR：尾桿圓粗，尾端只有噴氣口同小垂直翼，完全冇尾旋翼。
tail.en: Signature NOTAR: a fat round tail boom ending in a jet outlet and small fins — no tail rotor at all.

aircraft.similarZh: 同 MD 500E 比：外形幾乎一樣，差在尾巴——500E 有尾槳、520N 冇。同 H135 比：兩者都冇外露尾槳，但 H135 的 Fenestron 入面有槳葉，520N 連槳葉都冇、用噴氣。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the MD 500E: near-identical shape, but the 500E has a tail rotor and the 520N does not. Versus the H135: no exposed rotor either, but the fenestron hides blades while NOTAR uses air jets alone.

deepLinks.labelZh: 英文維基：MD Helicopters MD 500（520N 屬同系）
deepLinks.labelEn: English Wikipedia: MD Helicopters MD 500 (520N family)

aircraft.nameZh: 雲氏 RV-8 小型飛機

engines.noteZh: 單活塞引擎

seats.noteZh: 前後串列

recognitionZh: 下置直翼，翼尖簡單修圓，翼下冇支柱。
機鼻一台 Lycoming 活塞引擎帶螺旋槳，引擎罩兩側有散熱腮。
細小流線機身，前後串列雙座，氣泡座艙罩向後滑開；尾輪起落架令機鼻微微向上。
傳統尾翼，垂直尾翼面積大（相片紅色尾翼特別搶眼）。
recognitionEn: Low, straight wing with simple rounded tips and no struts.
A Lycoming piston engine and propeller in the nose, cooling gills on the cowling sides.
Small streamlined fuselage, tandem seats under a rearward-sliding bubble canopy; the tailwheel sits the nose slightly up.
Conventional tail with a large vertical fin (the red fin in the photo stands out).

photo.author: Robert Frola
photo.creditZh: 相片：Robert Frola／Wikimedia Commons（GFDL 1.2 or later）· Van's RV-8（VH-YGY）於澳洲飛行節
photo.creditEn: Photo: Robert Frola / Wikimedia Commons (GFDL 1.2 or later) · Van's RV-8 (VH-YGY) at an Australian fly-in
photo.captionZh: 尾輪、串列氣泡艙加低翼——自製特技機的經典佈局。
photo.captionEn: Tailwheel, tandem bubble canopy and low wing — the classic homebuilt aerobat layout.

sourcesToCheck.labelZh: Van's Aircraft 官方 RV-8 頁面

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「Van's Aircraft RV-8」；RV-8 是尾輪（後三點）版本，前輪版本叫 RV-8A。本卡規格以原廠 RV-8 為準；香港科學館收藏的 B-KOO「啟程」號就是由本地學生參與建造的 RV-8。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The RV-8 is the tailwheel version (the nosewheel version is the RV-8A). Hong Kong's Science Museum displays B-KOO “Inspiration”, an RV-8 built with local students.
aircraft.introZh: 自己砌的飛機：Van's 以套件形式出售，買家在車房砌好再飛；串列雙座、可作特技飛行，是全球自製飛機（homebuilt）熱潮的代表作。
aircraft.introEn: A homebuilt sold as a kit and assembled by its owner: tandem two seats, stressed for aerobatics — the poster child of the homebuilt movement.

history.statusZh: 生產中（套件熱賣；截至 2022 年逾 1,600 架 RV-8／8A 建成首飛）。
history.statusEn: In production as a kit (over 1,600 RV-8/8As completed and flown by 2022).

wings.zh: 下置直翼，翼尖簡單修圓，翼下冇支柱。
wings.en: Low, straight wing with simple rounded tips and no struts.

engines.zh: 機鼻一台 Lycoming 活塞引擎帶螺旋槳，引擎罩兩側有散熱腮。
engines.en: A Lycoming piston engine and propeller in the nose, cooling gills on the cowling sides.

fuselage.zh: 細小流線機身，前後串列雙座，氣泡座艙罩向後滑開；尾輪起落架令機鼻微微向上。
fuselage.en: Small streamlined fuselage, tandem seats under a rearward-sliding bubble canopy; the tailwheel sits the nose slightly up.

tail.zh: 傳統尾翼，垂直尾翼面積大（相片紅色尾翼特別搶眼）。
tail.en: Conventional tail with a large vertical fin (the red fin in the photo stands out).

aircraft.similarZh: 同 C172 比：RV-8 低翼、串列座、尾輪、可特技；C172 高翼、並排四座、固定前輪。同 RV-7 比：RV-7 是並排座，RV-8 是串列座——睇座艙闊度就分到。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Cessna 172: low wing, tandem seats, tailwheel, aerobatic — against a high-wing four-seater. Versus the RV-7: side-by-side seats there, tandem here; check cabin width.

deepLinks.labelZh: Van's Aircraft 官方 RV-8 頁面

aircraft.nameZh: 龐巴迪 環球快車 XRS 商務機

engines.noteZh: 尾吊雙引擎

seats.noteZh: 典型佈局；最多 19 座

recognitionZh: 下單翼後掠翼，翼尖有小翼，翼面修長。
兩台 BR710 引擎裝在機尾兩側。
細長機身，一排大圓窗（商務機窗比客機大），機鼻尖長。
T 形尾翼，水平尾翼在垂直尾翼頂。
recognitionEn: Low swept wing with winglets and a long, slender planform.
Two BR710 engines mounted on the rear fuselage.
Long slender fuselage with a row of large oval windows and a pointed nose.
T-tail with the horizontal stabiliser atop the fin.

photo.author: Aktug Ates
photo.creditZh: 相片：Aktug Ates／Wikimedia Commons（GFDL 1.2 only）· Bombardier Global Express XRS（OE-IRA）降落中
photo.creditEn: Photo: Aktug Ates / Wikimedia Commons (GFDL 1.2 only) · Bombardier Global Express XRS (OE-IRA) landing
photo.captionZh: 長機身、一排大窗、尾吊雙引擎加 T 尾——超長程商務機公式。
photo.captionEn: Long fuselage, big windows, rear engines and a T-tail — the ultra-long-range business jet formula.

sourcesToCheck.labelZh: 中文維基：龐巴迪環球快車
Wikimedia Commons：Global Express 圖庫分類

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「Bombardier Global Express XRS」；XRS 是 Global Express 的增程版（BD-700-1A10），ICAO 代碼 GLEX 與整個 Global Express 家族共用。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The XRS is the extended-range Global Express (BD-700-1A10); the ICAO code GLEX covers the Global Express family.
aircraft.introZh: 超長程商務機：一次飛逾 11,000 公里（香港直飛倫敦有餘），機艙載十幾人在空中開會瞓覺，是企業同富豪的「空中辦公室」，香港商務航空常見。
aircraft.introEn: An ultra-long-range business jet flying 11,000+ km non-stop — Hong Kong to London with ease — a flying office common in Hong Kong business aviation.

history.statusZh: 已停產（Global Express 家族 1996 年首飛；XRS 約 2006 年投入服務，後由 Global 5500／6500／7500 接棒）。
history.statusEn: Out of production (the Global Express family first flew in 1996; the XRS entered service around 2006, succeeded by the Global 5500/6500/7500).

wings.zh: 下單翼後掠翼，翼尖有小翼，翼面修長。
wings.en: Low swept wing with winglets and a long, slender planform.

engines.zh: 兩台 BR710 引擎裝在機尾兩側。
engines.en: Two BR710 engines mounted on the rear fuselage.

fuselage.zh: 細長機身，一排大圓窗（商務機窗比客機大），機鼻尖長。
fuselage.en: Long slender fuselage with a row of large oval windows and a pointed nose.

tail.zh: T 形尾翼，水平尾翼在垂直尾翼頂。
tail.en: T-tail with the horizontal stabiliser atop the fin.

aircraft.similarZh: 同 Challenger 605 比：Global Express XRS 機身長得多（30.3 對約 20.9 米）、窗更多、航程遠近一倍。同 Falcon 7X 比：兩引擎對三引擎（7X 機尾中間多一台）。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Challenger 605: much longer (30.3 vs about 20.9 m), more windows, nearly double the range. Versus the Falcon 7X: two engines against three (centre engine on the 7X).

deepLinks.labelZh: 中文維基：龐巴迪環球快車
Wikimedia Commons：Global Express 圖庫分類
deepLinks.labelEn: Wikimedia Commons: Global Express gallery category

aircraft.nameZh: 洛克希德馬丁 F-22 猛禽戰鬥機

engines.noteZh: 雙引擎（推力向量）

seats.noteZh: 飛行員

range.noteZh: 轉場航程（連外掛油箱，約數）

cruise.noteZh: 超音速巡航（不開後燃器）；最大約 Mach 2.25
cruise.noteEn: Supercruise without afterburner; maximum about Mach 2.25

recognitionZh: 梯形中翼同機身高度融合，前緣後掠角一致對齊（隱形邊緣對齊）。
兩台 F119 引擎藏於機身內，尾噴口扁平（2D 推力向量噴口可上下擺）。
扁平寬闊機身，邊緣全部對齊斜面；武器藏入機身內置彈艙，外表乾淨。
兩片垂直尾翼向外傾斜（外傾雙垂尾），是 F-22 的招牌。
recognitionEn: Trapezoidal mid wing blended into the fuselage, all leading edges aligned at matching sweep angles (stealth edge alignment).
Two F119 engines buried in the fuselage with flat 2D thrust-vectoring nozzles.
Flat, wide fuselage with aligned angled surfaces; weapons hide in internal bays, keeping the outline clean.
Two vertical fins canted outward — an F-22 signature.

photo.author: Tech. Sgt. Mike Ammons, U.S. Air Force
photo.creditZh: 相片：Tech. Sgt. Mike Ammons／美國空軍（Public domain）· 首架作戰型 F-22A（01-4018）交付飛行，佛羅里達上空
photo.creditEn: Photo: Tech. Sgt. Mike Ammons / U.S. Air Force (Public domain) · First operational F-22A (01-4018) on its delivery flight over Florida
photo.captionZh: 外傾雙尾翼、扁平機身同融合翼——F-22 的隱形輪廓。
photo.captionEn: Canted twin fins, flat fuselage and blended wing — the F-22 stealth silhouette.

sourcesToCheck.labelZh: 美國空軍官方 F-22 資料頁

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「Lockheed Martin F-22 Raptor」；F-22 只生產單座作戰型 F-22A，美國法律禁止出口，只有美國空軍使用。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Only the single-seat F-22A was produced; US law bans export, so the U.S. Air Force is the sole operator.
aircraft.introZh: 全球第一款服役的第五代隱形戰鬥機：雙引擎、可超音速巡航（唔開後燃器），全身稜角斜面融入隱形設計；產量不足 200 架，是空戰迷眼中的「天花板」。
aircraft.introEn: The world's first fifth-generation stealth fighter in service: twin engines, supercruise without afterburner, and all-angled stealth shaping — fewer than 200 built.

history.statusZh: 已停產（2011 年停產，共 195 架）；升級延壽服役中，只供美國空軍。
history.statusEn: Out of production (ended 2011, 195 built); upgraded and in U.S. Air Force service only.

wings.zh: 梯形中翼同機身高度融合，前緣後掠角一致對齊（隱形邊緣對齊）。
wings.en: Trapezoidal mid wing blended into the fuselage, all leading edges aligned at matching sweep angles (stealth edge alignment).

engines.zh: 兩台 F119 引擎藏於機身內，尾噴口扁平（2D 推力向量噴口可上下擺）。
engines.en: Two F119 engines buried in the fuselage with flat 2D thrust-vectoring nozzles.

fuselage.zh: 扁平寬闊機身，邊緣全部對齊斜面；武器藏入機身內置彈艙，外表乾淨。
fuselage.en: Flat, wide fuselage with aligned angled surfaces; weapons hide in internal bays, keeping the outline clean.

tail.zh: 兩片垂直尾翼向外傾斜（外傾雙垂尾），是 F-22 的招牌。
tail.en: Two vertical fins canted outward — an F-22 signature.

aircraft.similarZh: 同 F-16 比：F-22 雙引擎、雙尾翼、稜角分明、大一截。同殲-20 比：殲-20 有鴨翼、機身更長（約 20.4 米）；F-22 無鴨翼、尾翼外傾角度更大。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the F-16: twin engines and fins, angular stealth shaping, much bigger. Versus the J-20: the J-20 has canards and a longer fuselage (about 20.4 m); the F-22 has no canards and more strongly canted fins.

deepLinks.labelZh: 美國空軍官方 F-22 資料頁
deepLinks.labelEn: U.S. Air Force official F-22 fact sheet

aircraft.nameZh: 成都 殲-20 戰鬥機

engines.value: 2 × Shenyang WS-10C (later aircraft reported with WS-15)
engines.noteZh: 雙引擎（型號屬公開報道）

seats.noteZh: 飛行員（雙座型為殲-20S）

range.noteZh: 作戰半徑估計（約數）；官方未公布航程
range.noteEn: Combat-radius estimate (approx.); no official range published

recognitionZh: 三角主翼前方有一對鴨翼（前翼）——同 F-22 最大的外形分別。
兩台引擎藏於機身尾部，尾噴口呈圓形（相片可見）。
長而扁平的隱形機身，機鼻尖、單座座艙，邊緣對齊斜面。
兩片全動式垂直尾翼向外傾，機腹有腹鰭。
recognitionEn: A pair of canards ahead of the delta main wing — the biggest visible difference from the F-22.
Two engines buried in the rear fuselage with round exhaust nozzles (visible in photos).
Long, flat stealth fuselage with a pointed nose, single-seat canopy and aligned edges.
Two canted all-moving vertical fins, plus ventral fins under the tail.

photo.author: emperornie
photo.creditZh: 相片：emperornie／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 2.0）· 殲-20 編隊於珠海航展（2018）
photo.creditEn: Photo: emperornie / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0) · J-20 formation at Airshow China, Zhuhai (2018)
photo.captionZh: 編隊中前方一架：鴨翼、三角翼同外傾雙尾可以逐一對照。
photo.captionEn: The lead aircraft in formation: check off the canards, delta wing and canted twin fins.

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 重要：殲-20 官方性能數據從未公布，本卡所有數字均屬公開文獻估計（約數），只作辨認學習之用，唔代表官方規格。外形特徵則可由公開相片直接觀察。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Important: China has never published official J-20 performance data. All figures here are open-literature estimates for recognition learning only; the visible features, however, can be checked against public photos.
aircraft.introZh: 中國第一款隱形戰鬥機：鴨翼加雙引擎布局，2017 年公開列裝，珠海航展常客；外形同美製隱形機明顯不同，值得認清分別。
aircraft.introEn: China's first stealth fighter: a canard-plus-twin-engine design, publicly in service since 2017 and a Zhuhai airshow regular, visibly different from US stealth types.

history.statusZh: 生產中、服役中（2017 年官方宣布列裝部隊；雙座型殲-20S 已公開）。
history.statusEn: In production and service (induction announced in 2017; the two-seat J-20S has since appeared).

wings.zh: 三角主翼前方有一對鴨翼（前翼）——同 F-22 最大的外形分別。
wings.en: A pair of canards ahead of the delta main wing — the biggest visible difference from the F-22.

engines.zh: 兩台引擎藏於機身尾部，尾噴口呈圓形（相片可見）。
engines.en: Two engines buried in the rear fuselage with round exhaust nozzles (visible in photos).

fuselage.zh: 長而扁平的隱形機身，機鼻尖、單座座艙，邊緣對齊斜面。
fuselage.en: Long, flat stealth fuselage with a pointed nose, single-seat canopy and aligned edges.

tail.zh: 兩片全動式垂直尾翼向外傾，機腹有腹鰭。
tail.en: Two canted all-moving vertical fins, plus ventral fins under the tail.

aircraft.similarZh: 同 F-22 比：殲-20 有鴨翼、機身更長（約 20.4 對 18.9 米）、尾翼全動；F-22 無鴨翼。同 F-16 比：雙引擎對單引擎、隱形稜角對傳統圓滑、體型大一截。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the F-22: canards, a longer fuselage (about 20.4 vs 18.9 m) and all-moving fins; the F-22 has no canards. Versus the F-16: twin engines and stealth angles against a single engine and classic rounded lines.

aircraft.nameZh: 諾斯洛普格魯曼 RQ-4 全球鷹無人機

engines.noteZh: 單噴射引擎（機背）

seats.noteZh: 無機組——由地面站遙控
seats.noteEn: Uncrewed — flown from a ground station

range.noteZh: 美國空軍資料（12,300 海里）；滯空逾 34 小時
range.noteEn: USAF data (12,300 nmi); endurance over 34 hours

recognitionZh: 極長的直薄翼，翼展近 40 米（比 737 更闊），飛行時微微上彎。
一台噴射引擎裝在機身背部尾端，入氣口在背脊凸起處。
圓頭機鼻（入面是衛星通訊天線），全機冇任何座艙窗——無人機的鐵證。
倒 V 形尾翼：兩片尾翼向下方斜出，同一般飛機相反。
recognitionEn: Very long, straight, slender wing spanning nearly 40 m (wider than a 737), flexing slightly upward in flight.
A single jet engine on top of the rear fuselage, intake in the dorsal hump.
Bulbous nose hiding the satellite-comms antenna, and no cockpit windows anywhere — proof it is uncrewed.
Inverted V-tail: two surfaces sloping downward, the opposite of the usual arrangement.

photo.author: Aldo Bidini
photo.creditZh: 相片：Aldo Bidini／Wikimedia Commons（GFDL 1.2 only）· 美國空軍 RQ-4A 於新加坡樟宜展出（2010）
photo.creditEn: Photo: Aldo Bidini / Wikimedia Commons (GFDL 1.2 only) · U.S. Air Force RQ-4A displayed at Changi, Singapore (2010)
photo.captionZh: 冇窗的圓機鼻、機背引擎、超長翼同倒 V 尾——無人機特徵齊全。
photo.captionEn: Windowless bulb nose, dorsal engine, huge wing and inverted V-tail — the full drone checklist.

sourcesToCheck.labelZh: 美國空軍官方 RQ-4 資料頁

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「Northrop Grumman RQ-4 Global Hawk」；規格以 RQ-4B 為代表。相片是較早的 RQ-4A（新加坡樟宜展出），基本外形相同，B 型翼展更長（39.9 米）、機身感應器更多。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Figures represent the RQ-4B. The photo shows the earlier RQ-4A (displayed at Changi, Singapore) — same basic shape; the B model has a longer 39.9 m wing and more sensors.
aircraft.introZh: 冇駕駛艙的偵察機：由地面站遙控，在約 18 公里高空連續飛 30 小時以上偵察影相；圓碌碌機鼻藏住衛星通訊天線，是無人機時代的代表作。
aircraft.introEn: A reconnaissance aircraft with no cockpit at all: flown from a ground station, watching from about 18 km up for 30+ hours — an icon of the drone age.

history.statusZh: 服役中（2001 年起實戰部署；美國、日本、韓國、北約等使用，任務逐步由多平台分擔）。
history.statusEn: In service (operationally deployed since 2001; flown by the US, Japan, South Korea and NATO, with missions increasingly shared).

wings.zh: 極長的直薄翼，翼展近 40 米（比 737 更闊），飛行時微微上彎。
wings.en: Very long, straight, slender wing spanning nearly 40 m (wider than a 737), flexing slightly upward in flight.

engines.zh: 一台噴射引擎裝在機身背部尾端，入氣口在背脊凸起處。
engines.en: A single jet engine on top of the rear fuselage, intake in the dorsal hump.

fuselage.zh: 圓頭機鼻（入面是衛星通訊天線），全機冇任何座艙窗——無人機的鐵證。
fuselage.en: Bulbous nose hiding the satellite-comms antenna, and no cockpit windows anywhere — proof it is uncrewed.

tail.zh: 倒 V 形尾翼：兩片尾翼向下方斜出，同一般飛機相反。
tail.en: Inverted V-tail: two surfaces sloping downward, the opposite of the usual arrangement.

aircraft.similarZh: 同 U-2 偵察機比：RQ-4 無座艙窗、尾翼向下；U-2 有人駕駛。同 MQ-9 比：全球鷹大得多（翼展 39.9 對約 20 米）、用噴射引擎；MQ-9 尾部有螺旋槳。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the U-2: no cockpit windows and a downward V-tail; the U-2 is crewed. Versus the MQ-9: far bigger (39.9 vs 20 m span) with a jet engine; the MQ-9 has a rear propeller.

deepLinks.labelZh: 美國空軍官方 RQ-4 資料頁
deepLinks.labelEn: U.S. Air Force official RQ-4 fact sheet

aircraft.nameZh: 空中巴士 A300-600ST 大白鯨

wingspan.noteZh: 翼展（沿用 A300 主翼）

engines.noteZh: 通用電氣渦輪扇引擎

payload.noteZh: 最大載重（貨艙容積約 1,400 立方米）

range.noteZh: 載 40 噸時（載 26 噸可達 4,630 公里）
range.noteEn: With 40 t payload (4,630 km with 26 t)

recognitionZh: A300 式下單翼後掠，與普通 A300 相同。
兩台 CF6 引擎吊掛翼下。
機身上半膨脹成巨型圓筒貨艙（直徑 7.7 米），駕駛艙壓低在貨艙前下方，機鼻貨門向上揭開——全機最易認的特徵。
高大垂直尾翼；水平尾翼兩端各加一塊細垂直端板幫助穩定。
recognitionEn: Low swept wing inherited from the A300.
Two CF6 engines under the wing.
The upper fuselage swells into a giant tube (7.7 m hold); the cockpit sits low in front and the nose door hinges up — the type's unmistakable feature.
Tall fin; the tailplane tips carry small extra vertical endplates for stability.

photo.author: Jeroen Stroes Aviation Photography
photo.creditZh: 相片：Jeroen Stroes Aviation Photography／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY 2.0）· 空中巴士 Beluga 二號機（F-GSTB）滑行中
photo.creditEn: Photo: Jeroen Stroes Aviation Photography / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 2.0) · Airbus Beluga No. 2 (F-GSTB) taxiing
photo.captionZh: Beluga 二號機全側面：巨型貨艙、壓低的駕駛艙同尾翼端板都清楚可見。
photo.captionEn: Beluga No. 2 in profile: the giant hold, low-set cockpit and tailplane endplates are all visible.

aircraft.introZh: 空中巴士的「大白鯨」：用 A300 機身加大成巨型貨艙，專門在歐洲各地的廠房之間運送機翼和機身部件，是飛機載飛機的奇景。
aircraft.introEn: Airbus's 'Beluga' whale: an A300 rebuilt with a huge cargo hold to ferry wings and fuselage sections between factories across Europe — an aeroplane carrying aeroplanes.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「Airbus A300-600ST (Super Transporter) Beluga」；本卡即以 A300-600ST「白鯨」為準（新一代 BelugaXL 是另一型號）。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The badge list names the Airbus A300-600ST (Super Transporter) Beluga; this card covers exactly that type (the newer BelugaXL is a different aircraft).

history.statusZh: 逐步退役中（共建 5 架；2019 年起由更大的 BelugaXL 接棒，原 Beluga 機隊轉投貨運服務）。
history.statusEn: Being retired (five built; the larger BelugaXL took over from 2019, with the original fleet moving to cargo work).

wings.zh: A300 式下單翼後掠，與普通 A300 相同。
wings.en: Low swept wing inherited from the A300.

engines.zh: 兩台 CF6 引擎吊掛翼下。
engines.en: Two CF6 engines under the wing.

fuselage.zh: 機身上半膨脹成巨型圓筒貨艙（直徑 7.7 米），駕駛艙壓低在貨艙前下方，機鼻貨門向上揭開——全機最易認的特徵。
fuselage.en: The upper fuselage swells into a giant tube (7.7 m hold); the cockpit sits low in front and the nose door hinges up — the type's unmistakable feature.

tail.zh: 高大垂直尾翼；水平尾翼兩端各加一塊細垂直端板幫助穩定。
tail.en: Tall fin; the tailplane tips carry small extra vertical endplates for stability.

aircraft.similarZh: 同波音 Dreamlifter 比（本卡批次另一架）：Beluga 駕駛艙沉在貨艙之下、由機鼻入貨；Dreamlifter 保留 747 駝峰、成段機尾橫向打開入貨。同普通 A300 比（本網有貨機卡）：A300 是正常客機身材，Beluga 上半身脹大逾倍。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus Boeing's Dreamlifter (in this batch): the Beluga's cockpit sits below the hold and loads through the nose; the Dreamlifter keeps the 747 hump and swings its whole tail open. Versus a normal A300 (freighter card in this guide): the Beluga's upper body is more than twice as fat.

engines.noteZh: 四台 CFM International 渦輪扇引擎

seats.noteZh: 典型三級艙（最多 440 座）

recognitionZh: 下單翼長而修長，翼尖有小翼（winglet）。
四台引擎吊掛翼下——同雙引擎的 A330 最大的分別。
雙走道寬機身，圓潤的空中巴士家族機鼻；機腹中央有一組額外主起落架。
傳統尾翼，垂直尾翼大小適中。
recognitionEn: Long, slender low wing with winglets.
Four engines under the wing — the key difference from the twin-engine A330.
Wide twin-aisle body with the rounded Airbus nose; an extra centre main gear sits under the belly.
Conventional tail with a medium-sized fin.

photo.author: Adrian Pingstone
photo.creditZh: 相片：Adrian Pingstone／Wikimedia Commons（公共領域）· 阿提哈航空空中巴士 A340-300（A6-EYC）降落倫敦希斯路機場
photo.creditEn: Photo: Adrian Pingstone / Wikimedia Commons (public domain) · Etihad Airways Airbus A340-300 (A6-EYC) landing at London Heathrow
photo.captionZh: 四台引擎、修長主翼同中央起落架，是 A340-300 在空中最易認的三個特徵。
photo.captionEn: Four engines, a slender wing and the centre landing gear: the A340-300's three giveaways on approach.

aircraft.introZh: 四引擎長途客機：A340-300 是 1990 年代空中巴士進軍超長途市場的主力，國泰航空亦曾用它營運來往香港的長途航線。
aircraft.introEn: A four-engine long-haul airliner: the A340-300 spearheaded Airbus's 1990s push into very-long-haul flying, and Cathay Pacific once operated it from Hong Kong.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「Airbus A340 Series」；本卡以家族首個、產量最多的 A340-300 為代表（-200 較短、-500／-600 較長且引擎不同）。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The badge list names the Airbus A340 Series; this card uses the first and most-built A340-300 as representative (-200 is shorter; -500/-600 are longer with different engines).

history.statusZh: 已停產（2011 年結束生產）；絕大部分已退役，由 A350 和 777 等雙引擎機取代，少數仍作包機及政府專機。
history.statusEn: Out of production (ended 2011); most are retired in favour of twins such as the A350 and 777, with a few flying charters and government missions.

wings.zh: 下單翼長而修長，翼尖有小翼（winglet）。
wings.en: Long, slender low wing with winglets.

engines.zh: 四台引擎吊掛翼下——同雙引擎的 A330 最大的分別。
engines.en: Four engines under the wing — the key difference from the twin-engine A330.

fuselage.zh: 雙走道寬機身，圓潤的空中巴士家族機鼻；機腹中央有一組額外主起落架。
fuselage.en: Wide twin-aisle body with the rounded Airbus nose; an extra centre main gear sits under the belly.

tail.zh: 傳統尾翼，垂直尾翼大小適中。
tail.en: Conventional tail with a medium-sized fin.

aircraft.similarZh: 同 A330-300 比（本網有卡）：外形幾乎一樣，但 A340 有四台引擎（A330 兩台），機腹中間多一組起落架。同 777-300ER 比：777 只有兩台特大引擎，機身亦較粗。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the A330-300 (also in this guide): nearly identical shape, but the A340 has four engines (the A330 has two) plus a centre landing gear. Versus the 777-300ER: the Boeing has just two very large engines and a fatter body.

engines.noteZh: 普惠渦輪扇引擎

payload.noteZh: 最大載重（貨艙容積 1,840 立方米，為 747 貨機約三倍）
payload.noteEn: Maximum payload (1,840 m³ hold, about three times a 747 freighter's volume)

recognitionZh: 747-400 式下單翼，翼尖有小翼。
四台 PW4000 吊掛翼下，保留 747 佈局。
機身上半膨脹成無窗的巨型貨艙，747 駝峰被拉長覆蓋大半機身；整段機尾可向左橫向打開入貨。
747 式高大垂直尾翼，機尾段可橫開所以尾翼連在可動段上。
recognitionEn: 747-400 low wing with winglets.
Four PW4000 engines in the classic 747 layout.
A windowless swollen hold stretches the 747 hump over most of the body; the whole tail swings sideways for loading.
Tall 747 fin, carried on the swinging tail section.

photo.author: Eric Salard
photo.creditZh: 相片：Eric Salard／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 2.0）· 波音 747-400LCF Dreamlifter（N780BA）降落佩恩機場
photo.creditEn: Photo: Eric Salard / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0) · Boeing 747-400LCF Dreamlifter (N780BA) landing at Paine Field
photo.captionZh: Dreamlifter 全側面：拉長的駝峰貨艙、無窗機身同四台引擎一覽無遺。
photo.captionEn: The Dreamlifter in profile: stretched hump, windowless hold and four engines.

annotations.zh: 巨型貨艙（容積 1,840 立方米）

aircraft.introZh: 波音的巨無霸搬運工：由 747-400 改裝而成，貨艙容積達 1,840 立方米，專門把 787 的機翼和機身部件由日本、意大利運到美國總廠裝配。
aircraft.introEn: Boeing's giant mover: converted from the 747-400 with a 1,840 m³ hold, it ferries 787 wings and fuselage sections from Japan and Italy to final assembly in the USA.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「Boeing 747-400LCF Dreamlifter」；本卡即以此型為準——全球只有 4 架，全部由 747-400 客機改裝。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The badge list names the Boeing 747-400LCF Dreamlifter; this card covers exactly that type — only four exist, all converted from 747-400 airliners.

history.statusZh: 服役中（4 架由 Atlas Air 為波音營運，支援 787 生產；改裝工程在台北進行，首飛亦在台灣）。
history.statusEn: In service (four aircraft operated by Atlas Air for Boeing, supporting 787 production; conversion work was done in Taipei, where it also first flew).

wings.zh: 747-400 式下單翼，翼尖有小翼。
wings.en: 747-400 low wing with winglets.

engines.zh: 四台 PW4000 吊掛翼下，保留 747 佈局。
engines.en: Four PW4000 engines in the classic 747 layout.

fuselage.zh: 機身上半膨脹成無窗的巨型貨艙，747 駝峰被拉長覆蓋大半機身；整段機尾可向左橫向打開入貨。
fuselage.en: A windowless swollen hold stretches the 747 hump over most of the body; the whole tail swings sideways for loading.

tail.zh: 747 式高大垂直尾翼，機尾段可橫開所以尾翼連在可動段上。
tail.en: Tall 747 fin, carried on the swinging tail section.

aircraft.similarZh: 同空中巴士 Beluga 比（本卡批次另一架）：Dreamlifter 體積更大、用 747 底盤、由機尾入貨；Beluga 駕駛艙沉在貨艙下、由機鼻入貨。同 747-8F 貨機比（本網有卡）：LCF 無窗、身材脹大、唔用機鼻入貨。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus Airbus's Beluga (in this batch): the Dreamlifter is bigger, based on the 747, and loads through the tail; the Beluga's cockpit sits below its hold and loads through the nose. Versus the 747-8F freighter (also in this guide): the LCF is windowless and swollen, with no nose door.

engines.noteZh: 420 軸馬力渦軸引擎（現屬勞斯萊斯）

seats.noteZh: 包括機師（前 2 後 3）

recognitionZh: 五葉主旋翼，直徑細、轉速快，反應靈敏。
一台渦軸引擎藏在機背旋翼之後，排氣口向後上方。
圓碌碌的蛋形機身加大面積玻璃座艙，視野極佳；滑橇式起落架。
幼長尾桁末端是 T 形尾翼（500E 特徵）加尾槳；下垂尾有助保護尾槳。
recognitionEn: Five-blade main rotor: small diameter, fast-turning and very responsive.
A single turboshaft sits behind the rotor mast, exhausting up and aft.
A rounded egg-shaped cabin with a big glasshouse and skid gear.
A slim boom ending in the 500E's T-tail and tail rotor, with a lower fin guarding the rotor.

photo.author: Pedro Aragão
photo.creditZh: 相片：Pedro Aragão／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 3.0）· Heli Portugal MD 500E（CS-HBK）停泊在葡萄牙法魯機場
photo.creditEn: Photo: Pedro Aragão / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 3.0) · Heli Portugal MD 500E (CS-HBK) at Faro Airport, Portugal
photo.captionZh: MD 500E 全側面：蛋形座艙、五葉旋翼同 T 形尾翼是它的三大特徵。
photo.captionEn: An MD 500E in profile: egg cabin, five-blade rotor and T-tail are its three giveaways.

aircraft.introZh: 輕巧靈活的「飛蛋」：MD 500 源自越戰時期的 OH-6 偵察直升機，蛋形機身加五葉旋翼，操控反應極快，是全球警用巡邏和訓練的常客。
aircraft.introEn: The nimble 'flying egg': descended from the Vietnam-era OH-6 scout, the MD 500's egg-shaped body and five-blade rotor make it a police and patrol favourite worldwide.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「MD Helicopters MD 500」；本卡以家族最常見的 MD 500E 為代表（同系另有 500D、無尾槳的 520N 和軍用 530F；ICAO 代碼 H500 涵蓋全家族）。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The badge list names the MD Helicopters MD 500; this card uses the most common MD 500E as representative (relatives include the 500D, the NOTAR 520N and the military 530F; ICAO code H500 covers the family).

history.statusZh: 生產中（家族自 1963 年 OH-6 首飛至今；現由 MD Helicopters 生產 500E 的後繼型 530F 等，全球機隊龐大）。
history.statusEn: In production (the family dates to the OH-6's 1963 first flight; MD Helicopters still builds successors such as the 530F, and the global fleet is huge).

wings.zh: 五葉主旋翼，直徑細、轉速快，反應靈敏。
wings.en: Five-blade main rotor: small diameter, fast-turning and very responsive.

engines.zh: 一台渦軸引擎藏在機背旋翼之後，排氣口向後上方。
engines.en: A single turboshaft sits behind the rotor mast, exhausting up and aft.

fuselage.zh: 圓碌碌的蛋形機身加大面積玻璃座艙，視野極佳；滑橇式起落架。
fuselage.en: A rounded egg-shaped cabin with a big glasshouse and skid gear.

tail.zh: 幼長尾桁末端是 T 形尾翼（500E 特徵）加尾槳；下垂尾有助保護尾槳。
tail.en: A slim boom ending in the 500E's T-tail and tail rotor, with a lower fin guarding the rotor.

aircraft.similarZh: 同 R44 比（本網有卡）：MD 500E 用渦軸引擎（R44 是活塞）、五葉旋翼、蛋形更圓、尾巴是 T 形。同自家 520N 比：520N 無尾槳（NOTAR 圓筒尾），500E 有傳統尾槳。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the R44 (also in this guide): the MD 500E has a turbine engine (the R44 is piston), five blades, a rounder egg shape and a T-tail. Versus its 520N sister: the 520N has no tail rotor (a NOTAR boom), the 500E keeps a conventional one.

aircraft.nameZh: 麥道 MD902 探險家直升機

length.noteZh: 旋翼轉動時全長（機身 10.39 米）

engines.noteZh: 普惠加拿大渦軸引擎（各 710 軸馬力起飛功率）
engines.noteEn: Pratt & Whitney Canada turboshafts (710 shp each for takeoff)

seats.noteZh: 機師 1 名加乘客 7 名（或雙機師加 6 名乘客）
seats.noteEn: One pilot plus seven passengers (or two pilots plus six)

recognitionZh: 五葉主旋翼，槳葉尖端向後斜削，飛行安靜。
兩台渦軸引擎並列機頂，排氣口在旋翼後方兩側。
寬闊方正的座艙可平放擔架；尾桁粗大圓筒是 NOTAR 風扇系統，沒有尾槳。
尾端有一對垂直端板（雙尾鰭）幫助航向穩定，末端噴出氣流代替尾槳。
recognitionEn: Five-blade main rotor with swept-back tips, tuned for quiet flight.
Two turboshafts side by side on top, exhausting behind the rotor.
A wide boxy cabin that swallows a stretcher; the fat round boom houses the NOTAR fan — there is no tail rotor.
Twin endplate fins for stability; air blown from the boom tip replaces the tail rotor.

photo.author: Elisabeth Klimesch
photo.creditZh: 相片：Elisabeth Klimesch／Wikimedia Commons（GFDL 1.2）· MD 902 Explorer（N906AF）在摩納哥外海飛行
photo.creditEn: Photo: Elisabeth Klimesch / Wikimedia Commons (GFDL 1.2) · MD 902 Explorer (N906AF) flying off Monaco
photo.captionZh: 飛行中的 MD 902：粗大 NOTAR 尾桁、雙尾鰭同無尾槳的尾端一目了然。
photo.captionEn: An MD 902 in flight: the fat NOTAR boom, twin endplate fins and clean tail tip are unmistakable.

sourcesToCheck.labelZh: 英文維基：MD Helicopters MD Explorer

aircraft.introZh: 沒有尾槳的安靜直升機：MD 902 用 NOTAR 風扇系統代替尾槳，噪音低又安全，深受空中救護和警隊歡迎；香港的商業直升機公司 Heliservices 亦有營運同系機種。
aircraft.introEn: The quiet helicopter with no tail rotor: the MD 902's NOTAR fan system makes it safe and quiet for air ambulances and police work — Hong Kong's Heliservices flies the family too.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「MD Helicopter MD-902 Explorer」；本卡即以 MD 902（PW207E 引擎加強版）為準，MD 900 是它的早期版本。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The badge list names the MD Helicopters MD-902 Explorer; this card covers exactly that type (the MD 900 is its earlier version).

history.statusZh: 服役中（生產已放緩；全球用於空中救護、警用及商用接送，包括香港 Heliservices、倫敦空中救護前機隊等）。
history.statusEn: In service (production has slowed; flown worldwide on air-ambulance, police and charter work, including Hong Kong's Heliservices and formerly London's Air Ambulance).

wings.zh: 五葉主旋翼，槳葉尖端向後斜削，飛行安靜。
wings.en: Five-blade main rotor with swept-back tips, tuned for quiet flight.

engines.zh: 兩台渦軸引擎並列機頂，排氣口在旋翼後方兩側。
engines.en: Two turboshafts side by side on top, exhausting behind the rotor.

fuselage.zh: 寬闊方正的座艙可平放擔架；尾桁粗大圓筒是 NOTAR 風扇系統，沒有尾槳。
fuselage.en: A wide boxy cabin that swallows a stretcher; the fat round boom houses the NOTAR fan — there is no tail rotor.

tail.zh: 尾端有一對垂直端板（雙尾鰭）幫助航向穩定，末端噴出氣流代替尾槳。
tail.en: Twin endplate fins for stability; air blown from the boom tip replaces the tail rotor.

aircraft.similarZh: 同 MD 500E 比（本卡批次另一架）：902 大得多、雙引擎、無尾槳。同 EC135／H135 比（本網有卡）：H135 用函道尾槳（fenestron），902 連尾槳都沒有，尾桁末端光滑噴氣。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the MD 500E (in this batch): the 902 is much bigger, twin-engined and has no tail rotor. Versus the H135 (also in this guide): the H135 uses a fenestron fan in its fin, while the 902's boom tip is smooth and simply blows air.

deepLinks.labelZh: 英文維基：MD Helicopters MD Explorer
deepLinks.labelEn: English Wikipedia: MD Helicopters MD Explorer

aircraft.nameZh: 羅便臣 R66 直升機

engines.noteZh: 渦軸引擎（R66 專用研製）

seats.noteZh: 機師 1 名加乘客 4 名

recognitionZh: 雙葉主旋翼加高桅杆，是 Robinson 家族的典型設計。
一台 RR300 渦軸引擎藏在座艙後上方，機背有一列散熱進氣格柵。
比 R44 略大、較圓潤的五座座艙，大面積玻璃，機尾有行李艙。
幼尾桁末端是垂直尾翼加左側尾槳，下方有細長安定面。
recognitionEn: Two-blade main rotor on a tall mast — the Robinson family trademark.
A single RR300 turboshaft behind the cabin, with cooling intakes along the spine.
A slightly larger, rounder five-seat cabin than the R44, with big windows and a baggage bay.
A slim boom ending in a fin, port-side tail rotor and a lower stabiliser.

photo.author: Md Shaifuzzaman Ayon
photo.creditZh: 相片：Md Shaifuzzaman Ayon／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 4.0）· Robinson R66（S2-AIN）飛行中，機身寫有「R66 TURBINE」
photo.creditEn: Photo: Md Shaifuzzaman Ayon / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) · Robinson R66 (S2-AIN) in flight, with 'R66 TURBINE' titles
photo.captionZh: 飛行中的 R66：高桅杆雙葉旋翼、機背引擎格柵同五座座艙都清楚可見。
photo.captionEn: An R66 in flight: tall two-blade rotor, spine engine grilles and the five-seat cabin.

aircraft.introZh: Robinson 首款渦軸引擎直升機：R66 是暢銷 R44 的五座渦輪升級版，速度更快、載人更多，設計仍然簡單易保養，深受私人機主歡迎。
aircraft.introEn: Robinson's first turbine helicopter: the R66 is a five-seat turbine upgrade of the best-selling R44 — faster, roomier, and just as simple to maintain.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「Robinson R-66 Helicopter」；本卡即以 R66 Turbine 為準（現時生產的唯一版本）。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The badge list names the Robinson R-66 Helicopter; this card covers the R66 Turbine, the only version produced.

history.statusZh: 生產中（2010 年取得 FAA 認證後交付；全球私人、訓練及巡邏市場持續增長）。
history.statusEn: In production (FAA certification and first deliveries in 2010; growing worldwide in private, training and patrol roles).

wings.zh: 雙葉主旋翼加高桅杆，是 Robinson 家族的典型設計。
wings.en: Two-blade main rotor on a tall mast — the Robinson family trademark.

engines.zh: 一台 RR300 渦軸引擎藏在座艙後上方，機背有一列散熱進氣格柵。
engines.en: A single RR300 turboshaft behind the cabin, with cooling intakes along the spine.

fuselage.zh: 比 R44 略大、較圓潤的五座座艙，大面積玻璃，機尾有行李艙。
fuselage.en: A slightly larger, rounder five-seat cabin than the R44, with big windows and a baggage bay.

tail.zh: 幼尾桁末端是垂直尾翼加左側尾槳，下方有細長安定面。
tail.en: A slim boom ending in a fin, port-side tail rotor and a lower stabiliser.

aircraft.similarZh: 同 R44 比（本網有卡）：外形好似，但 R66 大一截、用渦軸引擎（機背有格柵）、五座、機尾有行李艙門。R44 是活塞引擎、四座。同 MD 500E 比：R66 旋翼只有兩葉，500E 有五葉。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the R44 (also in this guide): a similar shape, but the R66 is bigger, turbine-powered (note the spine grilles), seats five and has a tail baggage door; the R44 is a four-seat piston. Versus the MD 500E: the R66's rotor has two blades, the 500E's has five.

aircraft.nameZh: 卡莫夫 Ka-31 直升機

length.noteZh: 機身長（不含旋翼）約 11.3 米；全長以公開資料為準
length.noteEn: Fuselage about 11.3 m; overall figure from published data

rotorDiameter.noteZh: 同軸上下兩副旋翼直徑（可摺疊）

engines.noteZh: 兩台渦軸引擎並列機頂
engines.noteEn: Two turboshafts side by side on top

seats.noteZh: 機組兩名（機師加雷達操作員）
seats.noteEn: Crew of two (pilot plus radar operator)

cruise.noteZh: 巡航速度（最大 250 公里／小時）

recognitionZh: 同軸反轉雙旋翼：上下兩副旋翼反向轉，不需要尾槳，槳葉可摺疊慳甲板空間。
兩台 TV3-117 引擎並列裝在座艙頂、旋翼之前。
短粗機身；機腹有一面可收放的大型平板雷達天線，飛行時放下並旋轉掃描——全機最招牌的特徵。
水平尾翼兩端有垂直端板，收起落架後方便艦上停放；沒有尾槳。
recognitionEn: Coaxial contra-rotating rotors: two stacked rotors turning opposite ways, so no tail rotor; blades fold for shipboard stowage.
Two TV3-117 turboshafts side by side above the cabin, ahead of the rotors.
Short, stubby body; a large flat radar antenna folds down from the belly and rotates in flight — the type's signature feature.
Endplate fins on the tailplane; no tail rotor.

photo.author: Indian Navy
photo.creditZh: 相片：印度海軍／Wikimedia Commons（印度政府開放數據授權 GODL）· 印度海軍 Ka-31（IN562）在軍艦甲板上空懸停
photo.creditEn: Photo: Indian Navy / Wikimedia Commons (Government Open Data License – India) · An Indian Navy Ka-31 (IN562) hovering over a warship's deck
photo.captionZh: 在甲板上空的 Ka-31：同軸雙旋翼、雙引擎同摺起的機腹雷達是它的身分證。
photo.captionEn: A Ka-31 over the deck: coaxial rotors, twin engines and the folded belly radar are its identity card.

aircraft.introZh: 航母艦隊的「空中眼睛」：Ka-31 把一面大型預警雷達掛在機腹，升空後可望到地平線以外，專門為沒有固定翼預警機的航母提早發現來襲飛機和船隻。
aircraft.introEn: The carrier fleet's 'eye in the sky': the Ka-31 carries a big surveillance radar under its belly, seeing over the horizon for fleets that have no fixed-wing radar aircraft.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「Kamov Ka-31」；本卡即以 Ka-31 艦載預警型為準（與反潛的 Ka-27／Ka-29 同家族但任務不同，機腹裝大型雷達）。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The badge list names the Kamov Ka-31; this card covers that shipborne radar variant (the anti-submarine Ka-27/Ka-29 share the airframe but not the big belly radar).

history.statusZh: 服役中（俄羅斯、印度和中國海軍採用；印度是最大海外用戶，本卡相片就是印度海軍的 Ka-31）。
history.statusEn: In service (with the Russian, Indian and Chinese navies; India is the biggest export user, and this card's photo shows an Indian Navy machine).

wings.zh: 同軸反轉雙旋翼：上下兩副旋翼反向轉，不需要尾槳，槳葉可摺疊慳甲板空間。
wings.en: Coaxial contra-rotating rotors: two stacked rotors turning opposite ways, so no tail rotor; blades fold for shipboard stowage.

engines.zh: 兩台 TV3-117 引擎並列裝在座艙頂、旋翼之前。
engines.en: Two TV3-117 turboshafts side by side above the cabin, ahead of the rotors.

fuselage.zh: 短粗機身；機腹有一面可收放的大型平板雷達天線，飛行時放下並旋轉掃描——全機最招牌的特徵。
fuselage.en: Short, stubby body; a large flat radar antenna folds down from the belly and rotates in flight — the type's signature feature.

tail.zh: 水平尾翼兩端有垂直端板，收起落架後方便艦上停放；沒有尾槳。
tail.en: Endplate fins on the tailplane; no tail rotor.

aircraft.similarZh: 同 Ka-27 反潛直升機比（同家族）：外形幾乎一樣，但 Ka-31 機腹有大雷達板、無聲納浮標投放器，任務是預警不是反潛。同陸基預警機比：Ka-31細得多、航程短，但可以在無彈射器的航母和巡洋艦上升降。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus its Ka-27 anti-submarine cousin: nearly the same shape, but the Ka-31 has the belly radar and no sonobuoy launchers — its job is radar picket duty, not hunting submarines. Versus land-based radar aircraft: far smaller and shorter-ranged, but it can operate from carriers and cruisers without catapults.

engines.noteZh: 兩台渦輪扇引擎裝於機尾兩側
engines.noteEn: Two turbofans mounted at the rear fuselage

seats.noteZh: 典型 14 座，最多 19 座

cruise.noteZh: 典型巡航（遠程巡航 Mach 0.80）

recognitionZh: 下單翼大幅後掠，翼尖有大型小翼。
兩台 BR710 裝在機身尾部兩側，是商務機的典型佈局。
修長機身一列橢圓形大窗（灣流招牌窗），機鼻圓滑下垂。
T 形尾翼：水平尾翼裝在垂直尾翼頂端。
recognitionEn: Low, strongly swept wing with large winglets.
Two BR710 engines on the rear fuselage — the classic business-jet layout.
A long fuselage with Gulfstream's signature oval windows and a drooped, rounded nose.
T-tail, with the tailplane on top of the fin.

photo.author: Adrian Pingstone
photo.creditZh: 相片：Adrian Pingstone／Wikimedia Commons（公共領域）· NetJets Europe 灣流 G550（CS-DKF）起飛爬升
photo.creditEn: Photo: Adrian Pingstone / Wikimedia Commons (public domain) · NetJets Europe Gulfstream G550 (CS-DKF) climbing away
photo.captionZh: 爬升中的 G550：橢圓窗、尾置雙引擎同 T 形尾翼是灣流家族的招牌組合。
photo.captionEn: A G550 climbing out: oval windows, rear engines and a T-tail — the Gulfstream signature.

aircraft.introZh: 超遠程商務噴射機的標竿：G550 航程逾 12,500 公里，可由香港不停站直飛美國西岸，是政商專機和多國空軍遠程任務機的熱門選擇。
aircraft.introEn: The benchmark ultra-long-range business jet: with over 12,500 km of range, a G550 can fly Hong Kong to the US West Coast non-stop, and many air arms use it for special missions.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「Gulfstream G550」；本卡即以 G550 為準（前身是 Gulfstream V／GV-SP，機身相同、航電升級）。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The badge list names the Gulfstream G550; this card covers exactly that type (developed from the Gulfstream V/GV-SP with the same airframe and upgraded avionics).

history.statusZh: 已停產（2021 年交付最後一架）；全球機隊仍然龐大，由 G600／G650／G700 等新一代接棒。
history.statusEn: Out of production (the last was delivered in 2021); the large global fleet soldiers on, succeeded by the G600/G650/G700 family.

wings.zh: 下單翼大幅後掠，翼尖有大型小翼。
wings.en: Low, strongly swept wing with large winglets.

engines.zh: 兩台 BR710 裝在機身尾部兩側，是商務機的典型佈局。
engines.en: Two BR710 engines on the rear fuselage — the classic business-jet layout.

fuselage.zh: 修長機身一列橢圓形大窗（灣流招牌窗），機鼻圓滑下垂。
fuselage.en: A long fuselage with Gulfstream's signature oval windows and a drooped, rounded nose.

tail.zh: T 形尾翼：水平尾翼裝在垂直尾翼頂端。
tail.en: T-tail, with the tailplane on top of the fin.

aircraft.similarZh: 同 Global Express XRS 比（本網有卡）：兩者都是超遠程商務機；G550 窗是橢圓形、機尾引擎較貼身，Global 系列機身較粗、窗較方。同細佬 G450 比：G550 機身更長、航程遠得多（多約 4,000 公里）。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Global Express XRS (also in this guide): both are ultra-long-range jets; the G550 has oval windows and slimmer rear engines, the Global a fatter body and squarer windows. Versus the smaller G450: the G550 is longer and flies some 4,000 km farther.

engines.noteZh: 230 匹水平對置活塞引擎

seats.noteZh: 包括機師

recognitionZh: 高翼佈局，左右各有一支斜撐桿連住機身，是 Cessna 單引擎機的典型模樣。
機鼻一副三葉螺旋槳，由 230 匹活塞引擎驅動。
四座機艙，固定三點式起落架連流線輪罩，機身比 172 略寬大。
傳統尾翼，垂直尾翼向後掠並向前延伸背鰭。
recognitionEn: High wing with a strut on each side — the classic Cessna single look.
A three-blade propeller on the nose, driven by a 230 hp piston engine.
Four-seat cabin with fixed tricycle gear in streamlined wheel fairings; slightly larger than a 172.
Conventional tail with a swept fin and dorsal extension.

photo.author: Alan Lebeda
photo.creditZh: 相片：Alan Lebeda／Wikimedia Commons（GFDL 1.2）· Cessna 182T Skylane（D-ETTM）停泊在布拉格機場
photo.creditEn: Photo: Alan Lebeda / Wikimedia Commons (GFDL 1.2) · Cessna 182T Skylane (D-ETTM) at Prague Airport
photo.captionZh: 182T 全側面：高翼撐桿、四座機艙同輪罩起落架是 Cessna 高翼家族的標準模樣。
photo.captionEn: An 182T in profile: strut-braced high wing, four-seat cabin and faired fixed gear.

annotations.zh: 機鼻活塞引擎與螺旋槳

aircraft.introZh: 私人飛行的經典四座機：Cessna 182 是 172 的「大哥」，引擎更強、載得更多，自 1956 年至今累計生產逾 23,000 架，是全球最成功的私人飛機之一。
aircraft.introEn: A private-flying classic: the Cessna 182 is the 172's bigger brother — more power and payload, over 23,000 built since 1956, and one of the most successful light aircraft ever.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「Cessna 182 Skylane」；本卡以現行生產的 182T 型數據為代表（家族自 1956 年生產至今，外形基本不變）。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The badge list names the Cessna 182 Skylane; this card uses the current-production 182T as representative (the family has been built since 1956 with the same basic shape).

history.statusZh: 生產中（家族 1956 年至今持續生產，中間曾停產十年；現行型號為 182T Skylane，飛行學校進階訓練和私人都愛用）。
history.statusEn: In production (built since 1956 with one ten-year pause; the current 182T Skylane is popular for advanced training and private touring).

wings.zh: 高翼佈局，左右各有一支斜撐桿連住機身，是 Cessna 單引擎機的典型模樣。
wings.en: High wing with a strut on each side — the classic Cessna single look.

engines.zh: 機鼻一副三葉螺旋槳，由 230 匹活塞引擎驅動。
engines.en: A three-blade propeller on the nose, driven by a 230 hp piston engine.

fuselage.zh: 四座機艙，固定三點式起落架連流線輪罩，機身比 172 略寬大。
fuselage.en: Four-seat cabin with fixed tricycle gear in streamlined wheel fairings; slightly larger than a 172.

tail.zh: 傳統尾翼，垂直尾翼向後掠並向前延伸背鰭。
tail.en: Conventional tail with a swept fin and dorsal extension.

aircraft.similarZh: 同 Cessna 172 比（本網有卡）：182 大一圈、引擎多 50 匹、機鼻較長、載重航程都更好，認錯率最高的兄弟機。同 Piper PA-28 比：182 是高翼加撐桿，PA-28 是下翼無撐桿。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Cessna 172 (also in this guide): the 182 is a size up, with 50 hp more, a longer nose and better payload/range — the most-confused pair in light aviation. Versus the Piper PA-28: the 182 is a strut-braced high-wing, the PA-28 a low-wing.

wingspan.noteZh: 翼展（長翼設計好滑翔性能）

engines.noteZh: 125 匹活塞引擎

seats.noteZh: 並排兩座（教官加學員）

range.noteZh: 最大航程（留 30 分鐘備用油）

recognitionZh: 下單翼幼長（展弦比大），翼尖微微上反，源自滑翔機設計。
機鼻一副雙葉螺旋槳，引擎罩圓滑貼身。
複合材料流線機身，一體式大泡泡座艙罩，視野開揚。
T 形尾翼：水平尾翼裝在垂尾頂端，是 DA20 最易認的特徵。
recognitionEn: A long, slender low wing from the type's glider heritage.
A two-blade propeller on a slim, tight-fitting cowling.
A streamlined composite fuselage with a one-piece bubble canopy.
T-tail with the tailplane atop the fin — the DA20's easiest giveaway.

photo.author: Alan Wilson
photo.creditZh: 相片：Alan Wilson／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 2.0）· Diamond DA20-C1 Katana（SE-MEV）於瑞典 Malmen 航展靜態展示
photo.creditEn: Photo: Alan Wilson / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0) · Diamond DA20-C1 Katana (SE-MEV) on static display at Malmen airshow, Sweden
photo.captionZh: 地面的 DA20-C1：長翼、泡泡艙罩同 T 形尾翼一目了然（艙罩打開中）。
photo.captionEn: A DA20-C1 on the ground: long wing, bubble canopy (open here) and T-tail.

aircraft.introZh: 輕盈漂亮的雙座訓練機：DA20 用滑翔機式長翼和 T 形尾翼，省油易飛，是全球飛行學校最愛的初級教練機之一。
aircraft.introEn: A light, pretty two-seat trainer: the DA20's glider-like long wing and T-tail make it economical and forgiving — a flight-school favourite worldwide.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「Diamond DA20」；本卡以最常見的 DA20-C1（Eclipse／Evolution）為代表。留意 ICAO 機型代碼是 DV20，不是 DA20。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The badge list names the Diamond DA20; this card uses the most common DA20-C1 (Eclipse/Evolution). Note the ICAO type designator is DV20, not DA20.

history.statusZh: 生產中（奧地利設計、加拿大生產；全球飛行學校廣泛採用，C1 型 1999 年起生產）。
history.statusEn: In production (designed in Austria, built in Canada; used by flight schools worldwide, with the C1 in production since 1999).

wings.zh: 下單翼幼長（展弦比大），翼尖微微上反，源自滑翔機設計。
wings.en: A long, slender low wing from the type's glider heritage.

engines.zh: 機鼻一副雙葉螺旋槳，引擎罩圓滑貼身。
engines.en: A two-blade propeller on a slim, tight-fitting cowling.

fuselage.zh: 複合材料流線機身，一體式大泡泡座艙罩，視野開揚。
fuselage.en: A streamlined composite fuselage with a one-piece bubble canopy.

tail.zh: T 形尾翼：水平尾翼裝在垂尾頂端，是 DA20 最易認的特徵。
tail.en: T-tail with the tailplane atop the fin — the DA20's easiest giveaway.

aircraft.similarZh: 同 Cessna 152 比（本網有卡）：DA20 是下翼加 T 尾、泡泡艙罩向後開；152 是高翼、車門式艙門。同自家 DA40 比：DA40 是四座、機身較大，尾翼同樣是 T 形。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Cessna 152 (also in this guide): the DA20 is a low-wing T-tail with a rear-hinged bubble canopy; the 152 is a high-wing with car-style doors. Versus its DA40 sister: the DA40 is a bigger four-seater with the same T-tail idea.

engines.noteZh: 普惠加拿大 867 軸馬力渦槳引擎

seats.noteZh: 視佈局而定（貨運型可拆座椅載貨）
seats.noteEn: Depending on layout (freighters swap seats for cargo)

payload.noteZh: 可用載重 useful load（連燃油計；實際載貨較少）
payload.noteEn: Useful load (including fuel; pure cargo is less)

recognitionZh: 高翼加雙撐桿，翼形厚實，專為短跑道慢速起降而設。
機鼻一副三葉螺旋槳，由 PT6A 渦槳引擎驅動，排氣管在機鼻右側。
方正的大機艙開滿方窗，固定起落架；貨運型機腹可加長條貨艙莢。
傳統尾翼，垂尾高大，尾翼下有細腹鰭幫助穩定。
recognitionEn: Strut-braced high wing, thick-sectioned for short-field, slow-speed work.
A three-blade propeller driven by a PT6A turboprop; exhaust stub on the right of the nose.
A boxy cabin full of square windows on fixed gear; freighters add a long belly cargo pod.
Conventional tail with a tall fin and a small ventral strake.

photo.author: Konstantin von Wedelstaedt
photo.creditZh: 相片：Konstantin von Wedelstaedt／Wikimedia Commons（GFDL 1.2）· SkyDive Dubai 的 Cessna 208B Grand Caravan（DU-SD1）
photo.creditEn: Photo: Konstantin von Wedelstaedt / Wikimedia Commons (GFDL 1.2) · SkyDive Dubai Cessna 208B Grand Caravan (DU-SD1)
photo.captionZh: 208B 全側面：高翼撐桿、方窗機艙同機腹貨艙莢，是 Caravan 的標準認證照。
photo.captionEn: A 208B in profile: strut-braced wing, square-window cabin and belly cargo pod.

aircraft.introZh: 無跑道都難佢唔倒的多用途運輸機：Caravan 用一台渦槳引擎載十幾人或成噸貨，草地、泥地、水面（加浮筒）都去得，是偏遠地區的空中貨車。
aircraft.introEn: The go-anywhere utility hauler: a single turboprop carrying a dozen people or a tonne of cargo from grass, dirt or water (on floats) — the pickup truck of remote-region aviation.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「Cessna 208 Caravan」；本卡以加長版 208B Grand Caravan EX 的數據為代表（標準 208 較短、引擎較細；相片中的跳傘機同屬 208B）。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The badge list names the Cessna 208 Caravan; this card uses the stretched 208B Grand Caravan EX as representative (the standard 208 is shorter with a smaller engine; the photo aircraft is also a 208B).

history.statusZh: 生產中（2023 年交付第 3,000 架 Caravan 家族；FedEx 是最大貨運用戶之一，全球逾 100 國採用）。
history.statusEn: In production (the 3,000th Caravan-family aircraft was delivered in 2023; FedEx is a major cargo user, with operators in over 100 countries).

wings.zh: 高翼加雙撐桿，翼形厚實，專為短跑道慢速起降而設。
wings.en: Strut-braced high wing, thick-sectioned for short-field, slow-speed work.

engines.zh: 機鼻一副三葉螺旋槳，由 PT6A 渦槳引擎驅動，排氣管在機鼻右側。
engines.en: A three-blade propeller driven by a PT6A turboprop; exhaust stub on the right of the nose.

fuselage.zh: 方正的大機艙開滿方窗，固定起落架；貨運型機腹可加長條貨艙莢。
fuselage.en: A boxy cabin full of square windows on fixed gear; freighters add a long belly cargo pod.

tail.zh: 傳統尾翼，垂尾高大，尾翼下有細腹鰭幫助穩定。
tail.en: Conventional tail with a tall fin and a small ventral strake.

aircraft.similarZh: 同 DHC-6 Twin Otter 比（本網有卡）：Caravan 是單引擎（Twin Otter 雙引擎）、機身較長。同 Cessna 182 比：Caravan 大幾倍、用渦槳引擎，是載貨為主的「空中貨車」。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the DHC-6 Twin Otter (also in this guide): the Caravan has one engine (the Otter has two) and a longer cabin. Versus the Cessna 182: the Caravan is several times bigger, turbine-powered and cargo-first.

engines.noteZh: 兩台渦輪扇引擎（部分型號連推力向量噴口）
engines.noteEn: Two turbofans (some versions with thrust vectoring)

seats.noteZh: 前後串列雙座（機師加武器官）
seats.noteEn: Two in tandem (pilot plus weapons officer)

cruise.noteZh: 最大速度（戰鬥機慣例在此欄列最大速度）

recognitionZh: 大後掠翼與機身融合，翼根延伸（LERX）拉到座艙旁，翼尖截平可掛導彈。
兩台 AL-31 引擎相距甚闊，裝在主翼下兩條獨立的引擎艙，尾噴口在雙尾翼之間外露。
機身扁寬，前後串列雙座艙高聳；機鼻右下方有一支空中加油探管，座艙左前方有紅外線搜索球（IRST）。
一對外傾的垂直尾翼，尾翼之間有一條長長的尾錐（裝減速傘），是側衛家族的招牌剪影。
recognitionEn: A big swept wing blended into the body, with leading-edge extensions reaching the cockpit and missile-ready clipped tips.
Two widely spaced AL-31s in separate nacelles under the wing, nozzles exposed between the fins.
A wide flat body with a raised tandem two-seat cockpit; a refuelling probe by the nose and an IRST ball ahead of the windscreen.
Twin canted fins with a long tail cone (housing the brake parachute) between them — the Flanker signature.

photo.author: Sergey Krivchikov
photo.creditZh: 相片：Sergey Krivchikov／Wikimedia Commons（GFDL 1.2）· 俄羅斯空軍 Sukhoi Su-30 在雲海上飛行（2010 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: Sergey Krivchikov / Wikimedia Commons (GFDL 1.2) · A Russian Air Force Sukhoi Su-30 above the clouds (2010)
photo.captionZh: 雲海上的 Su-30：串列雙座艙、闊分雙引擎同雙尾翼是側衛家族的標準認證照。
photo.captionEn: A Su-30 above the clouds: tandem cockpit, widely spaced engines and twin fins.

sourcesToCheck.labelZh: 聯合航空製造公司（UAC）官方網站

aircraft.introZh: 「側衛」家族的雙座多用途戰機：Su-30 由 Su-27 教練型發展而成，航程遠、載彈多，印度、中國、俄羅斯等十多國都有採用，是東方陣營最常見的重型戰機之一。
aircraft.introEn: The two-seat multirole member of the 'Flanker' family: developed from the Su-27 trainer, the long-legged, heavily armed Su-30 serves with more than a dozen air forces including India, China and Russia.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「Sukhoi Su-30」；本卡以基本型 Su-30（AL-31F 引擎）數據為準，各國衍生型（印度的 MKI、中國的 MKK、俄羅斯的 SM）航電和設備差別甚大。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The badge list names the Sukhoi Su-30; this card uses the baseline Su-30 (AL-31F engines), while national derivatives (India's MKI, China's MKK, Russia's SM) differ greatly in avionics and kit.

history.statusZh: 生產中、服役中（各國衍生型持續升級；印度、中國、阿爾及利亞、越南等都有機隊）。
history.statusEn: In production and in service (national derivatives keep being upgraded; fleets include India, China, Algeria and Vietnam).

wings.zh: 大後掠翼與機身融合，翼根延伸（LERX）拉到座艙旁，翼尖截平可掛導彈。
wings.en: A big swept wing blended into the body, with leading-edge extensions reaching the cockpit and missile-ready clipped tips.

engines.zh: 兩台 AL-31 引擎相距甚闊，裝在主翼下兩條獨立的引擎艙，尾噴口在雙尾翼之間外露。
engines.en: Two widely spaced AL-31s in separate nacelles under the wing, nozzles exposed between the fins.

fuselage.zh: 機身扁寬，前後串列雙座艙高聳；機鼻右下方有一支空中加油探管，座艙左前方有紅外線搜索球（IRST）。
fuselage.en: A wide flat body with a raised tandem two-seat cockpit; a refuelling probe by the nose and an IRST ball ahead of the windscreen.

tail.zh: 一對外傾的垂直尾翼，尾翼之間有一條長長的尾錐（裝減速傘），是側衛家族的招牌剪影。
tail.en: Twin canted fins with a long tail cone (housing the brake parachute) between them — the Flanker signature.

aircraft.similarZh: 同單座的 Su-27 比：Su-30 是雙座（座艙前後兩格）、多數有加油探管，任務偏多用途。同美國 F-15E 比：兩者都是雙座重型打擊機；Su-30 引擎分得更開、雙尾翼之間有長尾錐。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the single-seat Su-27: the Su-30 has a tandem two-seat cockpit and usually a refuelling probe, and is strike-oriented. Versus the US F-15E: both are two-seat heavy strikers, but the Su-30's engines are spaced wider apart with a long tail cone between the fins.

deepLinks.labelZh: 聯合航空製造公司（UAC）官方網站

aircraft.nameZh: 西安 轟-6K 轟炸機

engines.noteZh: 兩台渦輪扇引擎裝在翼根機身兩側
engines.noteEn: Two turbofans in the wing roots

seats.noteZh: 機組四名

payload.noteZh: 最大武器載荷（翼下可掛 6 枚長劍-10 巡航導彈；估算值）
payload.noteEn: Maximum warload (six CJ-10 cruise missiles underwing; estimated)

range.noteZh: 家族公開數字（K 型實際性能為外界估算）
range.noteEn: Family published figure (K-model performance is externally estimated)

cruise.noteZh: 巡航約 Mach 0.75（最大約 1,050 公里／小時；估算值）
cruise.noteEn: About Mach 0.75 cruise (maximum about 1,050 km/h; estimated)

recognitionZh: 中單翼大幅後掠（35 度），翼根粗厚包住引擎，是 1950 年代蘇聯轟炸機的典型布局。
兩台 D-30 渦扇藏在翼根機身兩側，進氣口在翼根前緣、噴口在翼後伸出，和翼下吊掛式完全不同。
修長圓筒機身；K 型機鼻是實心雷達罩（早期型是玻璃機鼻），座艙在機鼻上方，機尾有尾艙。
高大後掠垂直尾翼連大型水平尾翼，尾翼根部有背鰭。
recognitionEn: A mid-set, strongly swept (35°) wing with thick roots swallowing the engines — classic 1950s Soviet bomber layout.
Two D-30 turbofans buried in the wing roots, intakes at the leading edge and nozzles behind the wing — nothing hangs under the wing.
A long cylindrical body; the K has a solid radar nose (early models had a glazed nose), cockpit on top and a tail position.
A tall swept fin and large tailplanes with a dorsal fillet.

photo.author: Andrei Shmatko
photo.creditZh: 相片：Andrei Shmatko／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 4.0）· 解放軍空軍轟-6K 在俄羅斯 Aviadarts 比賽期間降落（2021 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: Andrei Shmatko / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) · A PLAAF H-6K landing during the Aviadarts contest in Russia (2021)
photo.captionZh: 降落中的轟-6K：實心機鼻、翼根進氣口同後掠翼是 Tu-16 家族傳到今天的 DNA。
photo.captionEn: An H-6K landing: solid nose, wing-root intakes and swept wing — Tu-16 DNA carried into today.

sourcesToCheck.labelZh: 中國航空工業集團（AVIC）官方網站
Wikimedia Commons：Xian H-6 圖庫分類

aircraft.introZh: 中國空軍的遠程打擊主力：轟-6K 是 1950 年代 Tu-16 的深度現代化後代，換上省油渦扇引擎和巡航導彈，可以在防區外攻擊數千公里外的目標，近年經常出現在台海和南海巡航新聞中。
aircraft.introEn: The PLAAF's long-range strike workhorse: the H-6K is a deeply modernised descendant of the 1950s Tu-16, with fuel-efficient turbofans and cruise missiles for stand-off attacks — a regular in Taiwan Strait and South China Sea patrol reports.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「Xian H-6K」；本卡即以轟-6K 為準（H-6 家族源自蘇聯 Tu-16，K 型換上渦扇引擎及新航電，是現役主力；其性能數字中國官方甚少公佈，多為外界估算，本卡已逐項標明）。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The badge list names the Xian H-6K; this card covers that variant (the H-6 family derives from the Soviet Tu-16; the K has turbofans and new avionics. China publishes little performance data, so figures are outside estimates and are flagged as such).

history.statusZh: 服役中（H-6 家族 1959 年首飛、生產至今；K 型是現役主力，另有加油型與更新的 N 型）。
history.statusEn: In service (the H-6 family first flew in 1959 and remains in production; the K is the current mainstay, alongside tanker and newer N variants).

wings.zh: 中單翼大幅後掠（35 度），翼根粗厚包住引擎，是 1950 年代蘇聯轟炸機的典型布局。
wings.en: A mid-set, strongly swept (35°) wing with thick roots swallowing the engines — classic 1950s Soviet bomber layout.

engines.zh: 兩台 D-30 渦扇藏在翼根機身兩側，進氣口在翼根前緣、噴口在翼後伸出，和翼下吊掛式完全不同。
engines.en: Two D-30 turbofans buried in the wing roots, intakes at the leading edge and nozzles behind the wing — nothing hangs under the wing.

fuselage.zh: 修長圓筒機身；K 型機鼻是實心雷達罩（早期型是玻璃機鼻），座艙在機鼻上方，機尾有尾艙。
fuselage.en: A long cylindrical body; the K has a solid radar nose (early models had a glazed nose), cockpit on top and a tail position.

tail.zh: 高大後掠垂直尾翼連大型水平尾翼，尾翼根部有背鰭。
tail.en: A tall swept fin and large tailplanes with a dorsal fillet.

aircraft.similarZh: 同俄羅斯 Tu-16「原版」比：H-6K 換了渦扇引擎（進氣口較大）、實心機鼻和新航電，外形仍一眼認出。同美國 B-52 比：H-6K 細得多、雙引擎（B-52 八台）、航程亦較短，但任務同樣是防區外導彈打擊。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus its Soviet Tu-16 ancestor: the H-6K has turbofans with larger intakes, a solid nose and new avionics, but the family resemblance is instant. Versus the US B-52: much smaller, twin-engined (the B-52 has eight) and shorter-legged, but with the same stand-off missile mission.

length.noteEn: Overall length (longest of the A350 family)

engines.noteZh: 勞斯萊斯渦輪扇引擎（-1000 專用大推力版）
engines.noteEn: Rolls-Royce turbofans (higher-thrust version unique to the -1000)

seats.noteZh: 三級艙典型佈局（最多可載 480）

wings.zh: 大後掠主翼，翼尖向上彎起的鯊鰭小翼（blended winglet）是 A350 家族的招牌線條。
wings.en: Big swept wing with upward-curving blended winglets — the A350 family's signature line.

engines.zh: 兩台 Trent XWB 引擎艙巨大，風扇直徑逾 3 米；引擎艙後緣平滑，沒有鋸齒。
engines.en: Two huge Trent XWB nacelles with fans over 3 m across and smooth exhaust lips.

fuselage.zh: 機身特長，駕駛艙窗外框有一圈黑色「面罩」描邊；主起落架是三對輪（-900 是兩對），是分辨 -1000 最快的方法。
fuselage.en: Very long fuselage with a black 'mask' outline around the cockpit windows; three pairs of main-gear wheels (the -900 has two) are the quickest -1000 tell.

tail.zh: 傳統尾翼，垂直尾翼根部線條圓滑過渡，尾錐收窄上翹。
tail.en: Conventional tail with a smoothly blended fin root and an upswept tail cone.

recognitionEn: Big swept wing with upward-curving blended winglets — the A350 family's signature line.
Two huge Trent XWB nacelles with fans over 3 m across and smooth exhaust lips.
Very long fuselage with a black 'mask' outline around the cockpit windows; three pairs of main-gear wheels (the -900 has two) are the quickest -1000 tell.
Conventional tail with a smoothly blended fin root and an upswept tail cone.

兩台 Trent XWB 引擎艙巨大，風扇直徑逾 3 米；引擎艙後緣平滑，沒有鋸齒。
機身特長，駕駛艙窗外框有一圈黑色「面罩」描邊；主起落架是三對輪（-900 是兩對），是分辨 -1000 最快的方法。
傳統尾翼，垂直尾翼根部線條圓滑過渡，尾錐收窄上翹。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the A350-900 (card AC-0001): the -1000 is about 7 m longer with three-wheel-pair main gears and more thrust. Versus the rival 777-300ER (card AC-0005): the 777 is fatter with bigger engines but no curved winglets — use the nose profile and cockpit mask to split them, as both have triple bogies.
aircraft.similarZh: 同自家 A350-900 比（本網 AC-0001 有卡）：-1000 長約 7 米、主起落架三對輪（-900 兩對）、引擎推力更大。同對手 777-300ER 比（本網 AC-0005）：777 機身較粗、引擎更大但翼尖沒有上彎小翼，而且起落架同樣三對輪，要靠機鼻線條同駕駛艙黑面罩分辨。
aircraft.introEn: One of Cathay Pacific's long-haul flagships: with a carbon-fibre fuselage and huge Trent XWB fans, the A350-1000 flies over 16,000 km and is an everyday sight at Hong Kong International Airport — a benchmark modern ultra-long-range twin.
aircraft.introZh: 國泰航空的長途旗艦之一：A350-1000 用碳纖維機身、Trent XWB 大風扇引擎飛出逾 16,000 公里航程，在香港國際機場每日都見得到，是現今最常見的超長程雙發客機代表。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The longest member of the A350 family (about 7 m longer than the A350-900); figures are for the -1000. The photo is Cathay Pacific's first A350-1000 (B-LXA) landing at Hong Kong International Airport.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: A350 家族最長的一員（比 A350-900 長約 7 米）；本卡數字為 -1000 型。相片是國泰航空首架 A350-1000（B-LXA）降落香港國際機場。

history.statusZh: 服役中並持續交付（ launch 用戶卡塔爾航空 2018 年首航；國泰航空是主要用戶之一，營運來往歐美澳的長途航線）。
history.statusEn: In service with deliveries continuing (launched by Qatar Airways in 2018; Cathay Pacific is a major operator on long-haul routes to Europe, North America and Australia).

wings.zh: 主翼帶向上翹的鯊鰭小翼（Sharklet）；比 A320neo 的翼完全同款，靠機身長度分辨。
wings.en: Wing with upturned Sharklets, shared with the A320neo — length is the giveaway.

engines.zh: 引擎艙明顯比舊款 A321 大一圈（LEAP-1A 風扇直徑近 2 米），短艙設計。
engines.en: Nacelles visibly fatter than the old A321's (LEAP-1A fan near 2 m), on short pylons.

fuselage.zh: 家族中最長的機身；新款 ACF 艙門佈局是翼前後各一對門加一對翼上出口，窗排特別長。
fuselage.en: The family's longest fuselage; the ACF layout has doors fore and aft of the wing plus overwing exits, and a very long window line.

tail.zh: 傳統尾翼，與 A320neo 相同設計。
tail.en: Conventional tail, shared with the A320neo.

recognitionEn: Wing with upturned Sharklets, shared with the A320neo — length is the giveaway.
Nacelles visibly fatter than the old A321's (LEAP-1A fan near 2 m), on short pylons.
The family's longest fuselage; the ACF layout has doors fore and aft of the wing plus overwing exits, and a very long window line.
Conventional tail, shared with the A320neo.
recognitionZh: 主翼帶向上翹的鯊鰭小翼（Sharklet）；比 A320neo 的翼完全同款，靠機身長度分辨。
引擎艙明顯比舊款 A321 大一圈（LEAP-1A 風扇直徑近 2 米），短艙設計。

傳統尾翼，與 A320neo 相同設計。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the A320neo (card AC-0003): about 7 m longer and some 40 more seats on the same wing and engines — count windows and judge the stretch. Versus the 737 MAX 8 (card AC-0074): the MAX has split up-down winglets and sits lower; the Airbus has a single upturned Sharklet.
aircraft.similarZh: 同自家 A320neo 比（本網 AC-0003 有卡）：A321neo 長約 7 米、載客多約 40 人，引擎同翼一樣，要數窗同睇機身長度。同對手 737 MAX 8 比（本網 AC-0074）：MAX 的翼尖是上下分叉，A321neo 是向上單片鯊鰭；MAX 機身較低矮。
aircraft.introEn: The big brother of the world's best-selling narrowbody family: Cathay Pacific and HK Express fly the A321neo on Asian short- and medium-haul routes, making it a daily sight at Hong Kong airport.
aircraft.introZh: 全球賣得最好的窄體客機家族成員：A321neo 是 A320neo 家族的大哥，國泰航空同香港快運都用它飛亞洲短中程航線，在香港機場日日見到。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Figures are for the standard A321neo; the longer-range LR (7,400 km) and XLR (8,700 km) look almost identical. The photo is a Cathay Pacific A321-251NX (B-HPJ) on a pre-delivery test flight.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 本卡數字為標準型 A321neo；家族另有長程 LR（7,400 km）與超長程 XLR（8,700 km）型，外形幾乎一樣。相片是國泰航空的 A321-251NX（B-HPJ）交機試飛。

history.statusZh: 服役中，是全球交付量最大的窄體機家族之一（連 LR／XLR 型訂單龐大；國泰集團用於區域航線）。
history.statusEn: In service and among the highest-selling narrowbodies ever (with large LR/XLR backlogs; the Cathay Group flies it regionally).

engines.noteZh: CFM International 渦輪扇引擎（737 專用版）

seats.noteZh: 兩級艙典型（單級艙最多 210）

wings.zh: 翼尖是上下分叉的「剪刀」小翼（AT winglet），是 MAX 一望即認的標記。
wings.en: Split 'scissor' winglets pointing up and down — the MAX's instant tell.

engines.zh: LEAP-1B 引擎艙比 737NG 大，裝得更前更高，引擎艙尾緣有鋸齒（chevron）降噪。
engines.en: LEAP-1B nacelles are bigger than the 737NG's, mounted further forward and higher, with chevron exhaust lips.

fuselage.zh: 機身同 737-800 一樣長，但尾錐（APU 排氣）拉長收尖；起落架較短令機身離地較低。
fuselage.en: Same length as the 737-800, but with a longer, tapered tail cone; short gears keep the fuselage low.

tail.zh: 傳統尾翼，垂直尾翼根部有長延伸段（dorsal fillet 加長）。
tail.en: Conventional tail with an extended dorsal fillet at the fin root.

recognitionEn: Split 'scissor' winglets pointing up and down — the MAX's instant tell.
LEAP-1B nacelles are bigger than the 737NG's, mounted further forward and higher, with chevron exhaust lips.
Same length as the 737-800, but with a longer, tapered tail cone; short gears keep the fuselage low.
Conventional tail with an extended dorsal fillet at the fin root.
recognitionZh: 翼尖是上下分叉的「剪刀」小翼（AT winglet），是 MAX 一望即認的標記。
LEAP-1B 引擎艙比 737NG 大，裝得更前更高，引擎艙尾緣有鋸齒（chevron）降噪。
機身同 737-800 一樣長，但尾錐（APU 排氣）拉長收尖；起落架較短令機身離地較低。
傳統尾翼，垂直尾翼根部有長延伸段（dorsal fillet 加長）。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the previous 737-800 (card AC-0006): split winglets, bigger chevroned engines and the long tail cone split them. Versus the A321neo (card AC-0073): the Airbus is 5 m longer with a single upturned Sharklet instead of the split tip.
aircraft.similarZh: 同上一代 737-800 比（本網 AC-0006 有卡）：MAX 的分叉翼尖、大引擎連鋸齒尾緣同長尾錐是三分法；唔睇翼尖好易撈亂。同對手 A321neo 比（本網 AC-0073）：A321neo 機身長 5 米、翼尖單片向上，MAX 就分叉。
aircraft.introEn: The fourth generation of the 737: bigger LEAP-1B engines and split winglets make the MAX 8 one of the world's most common narrowbodies, flown into Hong Kong by several foreign carriers.
aircraft.introZh: 737 家族的第四代：換上更大的 LEAP-1B 引擎同分叉翼尖，MAX 8 是全球最常見的窄體客機之一，多間外航用它飛來香港。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The 737 MAX family spans the -7/-8/-9/-10; this card uses the best-selling MAX 8 (the photo is a Southwest Airlines aircraft rotating). A high-density MAX 8200 also exists.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 737 MAX 家族有 -7／-8／-9／-10 四個型號，本卡以產量最大的 MAX 8 為代表；家族另有高密度版 MAX 8200。相片是美國西南航空的 MAX 8 起飛。

history.statusZh: 服役中（2019–2020 年曾因兩宗事故全球停飛，完成設計修改同重新認證後分階段復飛，現為全球窄體機隊主力之一）。
history.statusEn: In service (grounded worldwide in 2019–2020 after two accidents; returned in phases after design changes and recertification, and again a global narrowbody mainstay).

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the 787-9 (card AC-0004): 5.5 m longer, about 40 more seats, 2,200 km less range — judge by window-line length. Versus the A350-1000 (card AC-0072): curved winglets and a cockpit mask there; raked tips and no mask here.
aircraft.similarZh: 同自家 787-9 比（本網 AC-0004 有卡）：-10 長 5.5 米、多載約 40 人但航程短約 2,200 公里，外觀要靠數窗長度分辨。同 A350-1000 比（本網 AC-0072）：A350 翼尖上彎、787 是斜削翼尖；A350 有駕駛艙黑面罩，787 沒有。
aircraft.introEn: The biggest Dreamliner: composite fuselage, huge windows and a quiet cabin; Singapore Airlines, EVA Air and others fly the 787-10 on medium- and long-haul routes, including to Hong Kong.
aircraft.introZh: 夢幻客機家族的大哥：787-10 以複合材料機身、大窗同寧靜客艙見長，新加坡航空、長榮等用它飛中長途，在香港機場不難見到。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The longest Dreamliner (about 5.5 m over the -9), trading range for seats; figures are for the -10. The photo is a Singapore Airlines 787-10 (9V-SCC) — SIA was the launch operator and flies the type to Hong Kong.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 787 家族最長的一員（比 -9 長約 5.5 米），用載客量換航程；本卡數字為 -10 型。相片是新加坡航空的 787-10（9V-SCC）——新航是全球首家營運商，亦有飛香港。

history.statusZh: 服役中（新加坡航空 2018 年首航；用戶包括全日空、長榮、聯合、英航等，主攻高需求中長途航線）。
history.statusEn: In service (launched by Singapore Airlines in 2018; operators include ANA, EVA Air, United and British Airways on busy medium/long-haul routes).

機身沿用 A330-300，但駕駛艙窗外加了黑色面罩描邊——同舊 A330 分辨最快的一招。
尾翼沿用 A330 設計，垂直尾翼形狀不變。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the older A330-300 (card AC-0049): the neo adds the cockpit mask, tall curved Sharklets and bigger engines. Versus the A350-900 (card AC-0001): both wear masks, but the A330neo is shorter with a lower-set wing and different winglet curve.
aircraft.similarZh: 同舊款 A330-300 比（本網 AC-0049 有卡）：neo 有黑面罩窗框、大彎翼尖同大一號引擎；舊款翼尖小翼矮而且窗框冇黑邊。同 A350-900 比（本網 AC-0001）：兩者都有黑面罩，但 A330neo 機身較短、翼尖弧度不同，而且主翼位置較低。
aircraft.introEn: The A330's efficiency makeover: new Trent 7000 engines and winglets make the A330-900 a low-cost long-hauler and one of the fastest-growing widebodies, occasionally seen in Hong Kong with foreign carriers.
aircraft.introZh: A330 的節能新裝版：換上 Trent 7000 大引擎同新翼尖，A330-900 以低成本飛長途，是全球增長最快的廣體機之一，偶爾亦有外航飛來香港。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The A330neo family has -800 and -900 models; this card uses the mainline -900 (A330-941). The photo is an Air Senegal A330-941 (operated by Hi Fly Malta) departing on delivery.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: A330neo 家族有 -800 與 -900 兩型，本卡以主力的 -900（A330-941）為代表。相片是塞內加爾航空的 A330-941 交機起飛（由 Hi Fly Malta 營運）。

history.statusZh: 服役中並持續交付（首家用戶 TAP 葡萄牙航空 2018 年投產；用戶包括達美、ITA、印尼鷹航等）。
history.statusEn: In service with deliveries continuing (launched by TAP Air Portugal in 2018; operators include Delta, ITA Airways and Garuda Indonesia).

photo.creditEn: Photo: Anna Zvereva / Flickr via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0) · Air Senegal A330-941 (9H-SZN) departing (2019)
photo.captionZh: A330-900 拉起：黑面罩窗框、新大彎翼尖同 Trent 7000 大引擎。
photo.captionEn: An A330-900 rotating: cockpit mask, tall Sharklets and big Trent 7000s.

engines.noteZh: 普惠齒輪渦輪扇引擎

range.noteZh: 航程（ICAO Doc 8643 約 3,300 海里；後期高重量版更遠）
range.noteEn: Range (about 3,300 nmi per ICAO Doc 8643; later high-weight versions go further)

wings.zh: 主翼修長，翼尖小翼向上微彎；翼下引擎位置偏前。
wings.en: Slender wing with small upturned winglets; engines sit well forward.

engines.zh: PW1500G 齒輪扇引擎艙短粗，風扇直徑約 1.85 米，在這尺寸的客機中算大。
engines.en: Short, fat PW1500G geared-fan nacelles — big fans for this size of jet.

fuselage.zh: 機身比 A320 窄，駕駛艙窗是弧形大窗，最後一塊窗呈淚滴形收尾，是 A220 的小標記。
fuselage.en: Narrower than an A320, with curved cockpit windows ending in a teardrop pane — an A220 signature.

tail.zh: 傳統尾翼，垂直尾翼後掠角度明顯，尾錐裝 APU 排氣。
tail.en: Conventional, noticeably swept tail with APU exhaust in the cone.

recognitionEn: Slender wing with small upturned winglets; engines sit well forward.
Short, fat PW1500G geared-fan nacelles — big fans for this size of jet.
Narrower than an A320, with curved cockpit windows ending in a teardrop pane — an A220 signature.
Conventional, noticeably swept tail with APU exhaust in the cone.
recognitionZh: 主翼修長，翼尖小翼向上微彎；翼下引擎位置偏前。
PW1500G 齒輪扇引擎艙短粗，風扇直徑約 1.85 米，在這尺寸的客機中算大。
機身比 A320 窄，駕駛艙窗是弧形大窗，最後一塊窗呈淚滴形收尾，是 A220 的小標記。
傳統尾翼，垂直尾翼後掠角度明顯，尾錐裝 APU 排氣。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the E195-E2 (card AC-0079): near-identical size — split them by the A220's bigger windows and teardrop cockpit pane. Versus the A320neo (card AC-0003): the A220 is a size smaller with similar range.
aircraft.similarZh: 同對手 E195-E2 比（本網 AC-0079 有卡）：兩者尺寸接近，A220 的窗更大、機身直徑略闊（2-3 佈局一樣），靠駕駛艙淚滴窗同翼形分辨。同自家 A320neo 比（本網 AC-0003）：A220 細一級、載客少約 30 人，但航程相近。
aircraft.introEn: A clean-sheet design for the 100–160 seat market: big windows, wide seats in a 2-3 layout with only one middle seat per row, and frugal geared fans — the A220-300 is the fastest-growing small mainline jet.
aircraft.introZh: 為 100–160 座市場全新設計的窄體機：大窗、闊座位（2-3 佈局冇「中間位」之苦）同慳油齒輪扇引擎，A220-300 是近年全球增長最快的小型幹線客機。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Born as Canada's Bombardier CS300 (BD-500) and renamed when Airbus took over in 2018; this card uses the larger -300 (a shorter -100 exists). The photo is a QantasLink A220-300 landing at Canberra.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 前身是加拿大龐巴迪 CS300（BD-500），2018 年由空中巴士接手改名 A220；本卡以較大的 -300 型為代表（家族另有 -100 型）。相片是澳洲航空旗下 QantasLink 的 A220-300 降落坎培拉。

history.statusZh: 服役中並持續交付（2016 年以 CS300 之名由 airBaltic 首航；用戶包括達美、法航、JetBlue 等，訂單持續增加）。
history.statusEn: In service with deliveries continuing (entered service as the CS300 with airBaltic in 2016; operators include Delta, Air France and JetBlue).

photo.creditEn: Photo: Bidgee / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 3.0 AU) · QantasLink A220-300 (VH-X4B) landing at Canberra Airport (2024)
photo.captionZh: QantasLink 的 A220-300 降落：淚滴形尾窗、大窗排同短粗引擎艙。
photo.captionEn: A QantasLink A220-300 landing: teardrop cockpit pane, big windows, stubby nacelles.

engines.noteZh: CFM International 渦輪扇引擎（與 A320neo／737 MAX 同家族）
engines.noteEn: CFM International turbofans (same family as the A320neo/737 MAX engines)

seats.noteZh: 視佈局（東航兩級艙 164 座）

range.noteZh: 基本型航程；增程型 ER 約 5,555 公里
range.noteEn: Baseline range; the ER version reaches about 5,555 km

wings.zh: 主翼翼尖向上翹起的小翼，形狀介乎 A320neo 鯊鰭同 737 MAX 分叉之間，要配合其他特徵分辨。
wings.en: Upturned winglets somewhere between the A320neo's Sharklet and the MAX's split tip — use other cues too.

engines.zh: LEAP-1C 引擎艙與 A320neo 的 LEAP-1A 幾乎同款（同家族），單靠引擎分唔到，要睇機身。
engines.en: LEAP-1C nacelles are near-identical to the A320neo's LEAP-1A (same family) — engines alone won't split them.

fuselage.zh: 駕駛艙用四片式風擋（側窗弧線特別圓），機鼻線條比 A320 圓潤；機身直徑與 A320 相近。
fuselage.en: Four-piece cockpit glazing with a distinctly curved side pane and a rounder nose than the A320; similar fuselage width.

tail.zh: 傳統尾翼，垂直尾翼根部延伸段較短，尾錐收尾與 A320neo 唔同角度。
tail.en: Conventional tail with a shorter fin-root fillet and a differently angled tail cone from the A320neo.

recognitionEn: Upturned winglets somewhere between the A320neo's Sharklet and the MAX's split tip — use other cues too.
LEAP-1C nacelles are near-identical to the A320neo's LEAP-1A (same family) — engines alone won't split them.
Four-piece cockpit glazing with a distinctly curved side pane and a rounder nose than the A320; similar fuselage width.
Conventional tail with a shorter fin-root fillet and a differently angled tail cone from the A320neo.
recognitionZh: 主翼翼尖向上翹起的小翼，形狀介乎 A320neo 鯊鰭同 737 MAX 分叉之間，要配合其他特徵分辨。
LEAP-1C 引擎艙與 A320neo 的 LEAP-1A 幾乎同款（同家族），單靠引擎分唔到，要睇機身。
駕駛艙用四片式風擋（側窗弧線特別圓），機鼻線條比 A320 圓潤；機身直徑與 A320 相近。
傳統尾翼，垂直尾翼根部延伸段較短，尾錐收尾與 A320neo 唔同角度。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the A320neo (card AC-0003): near-identical size and engines — the curved four-piece cockpit glazing and rounder nose are the reliable tells, and the C919's winglets are shorter. Versus the 737 MAX 8 (card AC-0074): the MAX has split winglets and sits lower.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 A320neo 比（本網 AC-0003 有卡）：兩者大小、引擎幾乎一樣，最可靠是睇駕駛艙四片風擋的弧形側窗同機鼻弧度；C919 的翼尖小翼亦較短。同 737 MAX 8 比（本網 AC-0074）：MAX 翼尖分叉、機身較矮，C919 兩樣都唔同。
aircraft.introEn: One with a special Hong Kong connection: the C919's first trip outside the mainland in December 2023 was to Hong Kong, including a low flypast over Victoria Harbour; since 2025 China Eastern has flown it on scheduled Shanghai–Hong Kong services.
aircraft.introZh: 香港讀者特別有共鳴的一款：C919 在 2023 年 12 月首次飛出內地就係嚟香港，仲在維港上空低飛展示；2025 年起東航更用它執飛上海虹橋—香港定期航班，在香港機場已經見得到真身。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: China's first mainline narrowbody built to international standards; figures are for the baseline aircraft (an ER version exists). The photo is China Eastern's first C919 (B-919A) landing at Beijing Capital.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 中國第一款按國際標準研製的幹線窄體客機；本卡數字為基本型（另有增程型 ER）。相片是中國東方航空首架 C919（B-919A）在北京首都機場降落。

history.statusZh: 服役中並持續交付（中國東方航空 2023 年首航；國航、南航等陸續接收，主要飛中國國內幹線，東航以 C919 飛上海—香港定期航班）。
history.statusEn: In service with deliveries continuing (China Eastern launched it in May 2023; Air China and China Southern followed; mainly Chinese trunk routes, plus China Eastern's scheduled C919 service between Shanghai and Hong Kong).

photo.captionEn: The first production C919 landing: four-piece glazing and the rounded nose are the keys.

engines.zh: PW1900G 齒輪扇引擎艙比 E190 的 CF34 大一圈，艙體短粗。
engines.en: PW1900G nacelles are a size up from the E190's CF34s — short and fat.

fuselage.en: The longest E-Jet fuselage with a dense, long window line; 2-2 seating means no middle seats.

tail.zh: 傳統尾翼，尾錐比 E190 修長。
tail.en: Conventional tail with a slimmer tail cone than the E190's.

recognitionEn: A new, longer wing with raked tips and no tall winglet.
PW1900G nacelles are a size up from the E190's CF34s — short and fat.
The longest E-Jet fuselage with a dense, long window line; 2-2 seating means no middle seats.
Conventional tail with a slimmer tail cone than the E190's.
recognitionZh: 全新主翼比上一代長，翼尖向後斜削（raked），沒有大彎小翼。
PW1900G 齒輪扇引擎艙比 E190 的 CF34 大一圈，艙體短粗。
機身是 E-Jet 家族最長的，窗排密而長；2-2 座位佈局冇中間位。
傳統尾翼，尾錐比 E190 修長。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the E190 (card AC-0013): about 5 m longer, over 6 m more span, visibly bigger engines and raked tips. Versus the A220-300 (card AC-0077): similar size — the A220 has bigger windows and the teardrop cockpit pane; the E2's windows are smaller and denser.
aircraft.similarZh: 同上一代 E190 比（本網 AC-0013 有卡）：E195-E2 長約 5 米、翼展大 6 米有多、引擎明顯大一號，翼尖斜削而非小翼。同對手 A220-300 比（本網 AC-0077）：大小接近，A220 窗更大、駕駛艙尾窗呈淚滴形，E195-E2 的窗較細密。
aircraft.introEn: Embraer's second-generation E-Jet: a new wing and geared fans give the E195-E2 mainline efficiency at 130-seat size — a new mainstay of European and South American regional networks.
aircraft.introZh: 巴西航空工業的第二代 E-Jet：新翼、新齒輪扇引擎，E195-E2 以 130 座級的尺寸飛出幹線機的效率，是歐洲同南美支線網絡的新主力。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The largest E-Jet E2 (ERJ 190-400); the family also has the E190-E2 and E175-E2. Figures are for the E195-E2. The photo is a KLM Cityhopper aircraft landing at Berlin.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: E-Jet E2 家族最大的一員（ERJ 190-400）；家族另有 E190-E2 與 E175-E2。本卡數字為 E195-E2。相片是荷蘭皇家城市短途航空（KLM Cityhopper）的 E195-E2 降落柏林。

history.statusZh: 服役中並持續交付（巴西 Azul 航空 2019 年首航；用戶包括 KLM Cityhopper、Porter、Helvetic 等）。
history.statusEn: In service with deliveries continuing (launched by Brazil's Azul in 2019; operators include KLM Cityhopper, Porter and Helvetic).

seats.noteZh: 機師 1 名＋乘客最多 5 名
seats.noteEn: One pilot plus up to five passengers

wings.zh: 三葉主旋翼，旋翼頭是星形柔性 Starflex 設計，沒有傳統鉸鏈外露。
wings.en: Three-blade main rotor on a Starflex head with no exposed hinges.

engines.zh: 單台 Arriel 引擎裝在座艙後上方，排氣口在機身上方側面；只有一台引擎是同 H145 等雙引擎機的最大分別。
engines.en: One Arriel on top behind the cabin — a single engine is the big split from twins like the H145.

fuselage.zh: 機身短圓，大面積弧形風擋；固定滑橇起落架，是輕型通用直升機的經典樣。
fuselage.en: Short, round fuselage with a big curved windscreen and fixed skids — the classic light utility shape.

tail.zh: 尾槳是傳統兩葉開放式，裝在垂直尾翼右側；尾翼下方有水平安定面。
tail.en: Conventional two-blade open tail rotor on the fin, with a tailplane below.

recognitionEn: Three-blade main rotor on a Starflex head with no exposed hinges.
One Arriel on top behind the cabin — a single engine is the big split from twins like the H145.
Short, round fuselage with a big curved windscreen and fixed skids — the classic light utility shape.
Conventional two-blade open tail rotor on the fin, with a tailplane below.
recognitionZh: 三葉主旋翼，旋翼頭是星形柔性 Starflex 設計，沒有傳統鉸鏈外露。
單台 Arriel 引擎裝在座艙後上方，排氣口在機身上方側面；只有一台引擎是同 H145 等雙引擎機的最大分別。
機身短圓，大面積弧形風擋；固定滑橇起落架，是輕型通用直升機的經典樣。
尾槳是傳統兩葉開放式，裝在垂直尾翼右側；尾翼下方有水平安定面。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the H135 (card AC-0019): twin engines and a fenestron there; one engine and an open tail rotor here — check the tail. Versus the Bell 407 (card AC-0018): four blades and a sleeker body there; three blades and rounder here.
aircraft.similarZh: 同自家 H135 比（本網 AC-0019 有卡）：H135 是雙引擎加涵道尾槳（fenestron），H125 單引擎加開放尾槳，一睇尾部就分到。同 Bell 407 比（本網 AC-0018）：407 是四葉旋翼、機身較修長；H125 三葉旋翼、機身較圓。
aircraft.introEn: One of the world's best-selling light helicopters: the single-engine, skid-geared H125 (AS350 Squirrel) even landed on the summit of Everest in 2005 — it does everything from mountain rescue to lifting work over Hong Kong.
aircraft.introZh: 全球賣得最好的輕型直升機之一：H125（AS350 松鼠）單引擎、滑橇起落架，2005 年更創下在珠穆朗瑪峰頂降落的世界紀錄——由山區救援到香港上空的觀光吊運都見到佢。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Born as the 1970s Aérospatiale AS350 Écureuil ('Squirrel') and renamed H125 in 2015; this card uses today's H125 (AS350 B3e). Hong Kong helicopter operators also fly the AS350/H125 family. The photo is an LAPD aircraft.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 前身是 1970 年代的 Aérospatiale AS350 松鼠（Écureuil），2015 年改名 H125；本卡以現行 H125（AS350 B3e）為代表。香港的直升機營運商亦有 AS350／H125 系列在飛。相片是洛杉磯警局的 H125。

history.statusZh: 服役中並持續生產（AS350 家族累計交付逾 7,000 架，遍布警務、救援、吊運同觀光；2015 年起以 H125 之名銷售）。
history.statusEn: In production and worldwide service (over 7,000 of the AS350 family delivered for police, rescue, lifting and touring work; sold as the H125 since 2015).
