seats.noteZh: 乘客最多 9 名（加機師 1–2 名）；救護佈局載擔架 2–4 張
seats.noteEn: Up to nine passengers plus one or two pilots; air-ambulance layouts carry two to four stretchers

wings.zh: 主旋翼四葉（新款 D-3 五葉），旋翼頭低矮貼近機頂。
wings.en: Four-blade main rotor (five on the new D-3) on a low mast.

engines.zh: 兩台引擎並排裝在座艙上方，排氣口向後；機頂有明顯的引擎整流罩隆起。
engines.en: Two engines side by side above the cabin with a pronounced top fairing.

fuselage.zh: 座艙方正寬闊，側面大趟門，機尾有左右對開艙門方便抬擔架入艙——救護型的招牌。
fuselage.en: Boxy, wide cabin with big sliding doors and rear clamshell doors for stretchers — the ambulance signature.

tail.zh: H145 改用涵道尾槳（fenestron）：尾翼入面一個圓形風扇；舊款 EC145 則是開放尾槳，是兩代最快分辨法。
tail.en: The H145 switched to a fenestron — a fan inside the fin; the older EC145 has an open tail rotor, the quickest generational tell.

recognitionEn: Four-blade main rotor (five on the new D-3) on a low mast.
Two engines side by side above the cabin with a pronounced top fairing.
Boxy, wide cabin with big sliding doors and rear clamshell doors for stretchers — the ambulance signature.
The H145 switched to a fenestron — a fan inside the fin; the older EC145 has an open tail rotor, the quickest generational tell.
recognitionZh: 主旋翼四葉（新款 D-3 五葉），旋翼頭低矮貼近機頂。
兩台引擎並排裝在座艙上方，排氣口向後；機頂有明顯的引擎整流罩隆起。
座艙方正寬闊，側面大趟門，機尾有左右對開艙門方便抬擔架入艙——救護型的招牌。
H145 改用涵道尾槳（fenestron）：尾翼入面一個圓形風扇；舊款 EC145 則是開放尾槳，是兩代最快分辨法。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the H135 (card AC-0019): both have fenestrons, but the H145 is a class bigger (nine seats vs six) with rear clamshell doors. Versus its EC145 parent: open tail rotor there, fenestron here.
aircraft.similarZh: 同自家 H135 比（本網 AC-0019 有卡）：兩者都有涵道尾槳，但 H145 大一級（9 座對 6 座）、機尾有對開艙門。同前身 EC145 比：EC145 是開放式尾槳，H145 是涵道尾槳加新航電，外觀睇尾翼即分到。
aircraft.introEn: The world's air-ambulance and rescue workhorse twin: a big cabin, rear clamshell doors and a fenestron — H145s fly ambulance services across Britain, Germany and France, and its UH-72 military version serves throughout the US Army.
aircraft.introZh: 全球空中救護同搜救的主力雙引擎直升機：H145 以大座艙、後艙門同涵道尾槳見長，英國、德國、法國的救護直升機好多都是佢，軍用版 UH-72 更用遍美軍。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Developed from the Eurocopter EC145 (BK117 C-2), renamed H145 in 2015 with a fenestron and Helionix avionics; this card uses the H145 (BK117 D-2), and the latest D-3 has a five-blade rotor. The photo is a Yorkshire Air Ambulance aircraft.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 前身是 Eurocopter EC145（BK117 C-2），2015 年改名 H145 並換上涵道尾槳同 Helionix 航電；本卡以 H145（BK117 D-2）為代表，最新 D-3 型改用五葉旋翼。相片是英國約克郡空中救護的 H145。

history.statusZh: 服役中並持續生產（EC145 2002 年投產，H145 2014 年起交付；全球機隊逾千架，最新五葉 D-3 型持續交付）。
history.statusEn: In production and worldwide service (EC145 from 2002, H145 deliveries from 2014; a fleet of over a thousand, with the five-blade D-3 now delivering).

photo.author: James
photo.creditZh: 相片：James／Flickr 經 Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 2.0）· 約克郡空中救護 H145（G-YOAA）飛行中（2020 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: James / Flickr via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0) · Yorkshire Air Ambulance H145 (G-YOAA) in flight (2020)
photo.captionZh: 救護黃的 H145：涵道尾槳、方正大座艙同滑橇一覽無遺。
photo.captionEn: An ambulance-yellow H145: fenestron, boxy cabin and skids.

engines.noteZh: 勞斯萊斯渦輪扇引擎，後置機身兩側
engines.noteEn: Rolls-Royce turbofans on the rear fuselage

seats.noteZh: 典型商務佈局（最多 19）

range.noteEn: Baseline G650 (7,000 nmi); the G650ER reaches 13,890 km (7,500 nmi)

wings.zh: 低翼，後掠角大，翼尖有小翼；機翼裝在機身後半段，令機鼻顯得特別長。
wings.en: Low, strongly swept wing set well back, giving a long nose; small winglets.

engines.zh: 兩台 BR725 裝在機尾兩側（後置引擎），進氣口圓大，是商務機的標準佈局。
engines.en: Two BR725s flank the rear fuselage — the classic business-jet layout, with big round intakes.

fuselage.zh: 機身修長，窗戶是灣流招牌的大橢圓窗，一排約 8 隻；機鼻尖長下垂。
fuselage.en: Slim fuselage with Gulfstream's signature large oval windows (about eight a side) and a long pointed nose.

tail.zh: T 形尾翼：水平尾翼裝在垂直尾翼頂端。
tail.en: T-tail with the tailplane on top of the fin.

recognitionEn: Low, strongly swept wing set well back, giving a long nose; small winglets.
Two BR725s flank the rear fuselage — the classic business-jet layout, with big round intakes.
Slim fuselage with Gulfstream's signature large oval windows (about eight a side) and a long pointed nose.
T-tail with the tailplane on top of the fin.
recognitionZh: 低翼，後掠角大，翼尖有小翼；機翼裝在機身後半段，令機鼻顯得特別長。
兩台 BR725 裝在機尾兩側（後置引擎），進氣口圓大，是商務機的標準佈局。
機身修長，窗戶是灣流招牌的大橢圓窗，一排約 8 隻；機鼻尖長下垂。
T 形尾翼：水平尾翼裝在垂直尾翼頂端。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the G550 (card AC-0066): bigger, more oval windows and a longer, faster airframe here. Versus the Global 7500 (card AC-0083): the Bombardier is longer with squarer windows; both are rear-engined T-tails, so window shape and nacelle shape decide it.
aircraft.similarZh: 同自家 G550 比（本網 AC-0066 有卡）：G650 的窗更大更橢圓、機身更長更快；G550 窗較細隻而且數量多。同對手 Global 7500 比（本網 AC-0083）：Global 機身更長、窗較方大；兩者都係後置引擎 T 尾，要數窗形同睇機尾引擎艙形狀。
aircraft.introEn: The business-jet benchmark for speed and range: cruising at Mach 0.90 with over 12,900 km of range for Hong Kong–New York-class legs, and unmistakable on any business apron for its huge oval windows.
aircraft.introZh: 商務機界的速度與航程標竿：G650 以 Mach 0.90 高速巡航、逾 12,900 公里航程直飛香港—紐約級別的航線，招牌大橢圓窗在商務機坪一眼就認到。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The family pairs the baseline G650 with the longer-range G650ER (about 930 km more), identical in shape; the photo is a Royal Netherlands Air Force G650ER (V-117) government aircraft. G650s are frequent visitors to Hong Kong's business-aviation apron.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 家族有基本型 G650 與長程型 G650ER（航程多約 930 公里），外形相同；本卡規格以兩型並記，相片是荷蘭皇家空軍的 G650ER（V-117）政府專機。香港國際機場的商務機坪亦常見 G650 系。

history.statusZh: 服役中（2012 年投產，後由 G700／G800 家族接棒新交付；全球機隊龐大，包括多國政府專機）。
history.statusEn: In service (entered service in 2012; new deliveries have passed to the G700/G800 family, but the G650 fleet remains large, including several government fleets).

photo.creditZh: 相片：荷蘭國防部／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 4.0）· 荷蘭皇家空軍 G650ER（V-117）政府專機（2023 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: Dutch Ministry of Defence / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) · Royal Netherlands Air Force G650ER (V-117) government aircraft (2023)
photo.captionZh: 政府專機版 G650ER：招牌大橢圓窗、後置引擎同 T 尾齊晒。
photo.captionEn: A government G650ER: signature oval windows, rear engines and T-tail.

length.noteZh: 全長（現役商務機中最長之一）
length.noteEn: Overall length (among the longest business jets)

engines.noteZh: 通用電氣渦輪扇引擎，後置機身兩側
engines.noteEn: GE turbofans on the rear fuselage

seats.noteZh: 典型佈局（最多 19）

cruise.noteZh: 典型巡航（高速巡航 Mach 0.90、極速 0.925）

wings.zh: 全新跨音速主翼，後掠大、翼尖有小翼，翼面比舊款 Global 更修長。
wings.en: New transonic wing — more sweep and span than the older Globals, with winglets.

engines.zh: 兩台 GE Passport 裝在機尾兩側，引擎艙比 Global 6000 更修長，排氣錐明顯。
engines.en: Two GE Passports flank the tail, in slimmer nacelles than the Global 6000's with visible exhaust cones.

fuselage.zh: 機身非常長，窗戶大而方，數量多（每邊約 14 隻）；機鼻圓滑，駕駛艙窗呈彎月形。
fuselage.en: Very long fuselage with many large, squarish windows (about fourteen a side) and a smooth nose with crescent cockpit panes.

tail.zh: T 形尾翼，垂直尾翼後掠，尾錐裝 APU 排氣。
tail.en: T-tail with a swept fin and APU exhaust in the tail cone.

recognitionEn: New transonic wing — more sweep and span than the older Globals, with winglets.
Two GE Passports flank the tail, in slimmer nacelles than the Global 6000's with visible exhaust cones.
Very long fuselage with many large, squarish windows (about fourteen a side) and a smooth nose with crescent cockpit panes.
T-tail with a swept fin and APU exhaust in the tail cone.
recognitionZh: 全新跨音速主翼，後掠大、翼尖有小翼，翼面比舊款 Global 更修長。
兩台 GE Passport 裝在機尾兩側，引擎艙比 Global 6000 更修長，排氣錐明顯。
機身非常長，窗戶大而方，數量多（每邊約 14 隻）；機鼻圓滑，駕駛艙窗呈彎月形。
T 形尾翼，垂直尾翼後掠，尾錐裝 APU 排氣。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Global Express XRS (card AC-0055): about 3 m longer with nearly 3,000 km more range and more, bigger windows. Versus the G650 (card AC-0082): oval windows there, squarish ones here, and a longer fuselage.
aircraft.similarZh: 同自家 Global Express XRS 比（本網 AC-0055 有卡）：7500 長約 3 米、航程多近 3,000 公里，窗更多更大。同對手 G650 比（本網 AC-0082）：G650 窗是橢圓形、Global 是方形大窗；Global 機身亦較長。
aircraft.introEn: Among the largest and longest-legged business jets in service: 14,260 km of range and Mach 0.90 cruise put Hong Kong–US East Coast within reach — a head-turning regular at Hong Kong's business apron.
aircraft.introZh: 現役最大、最長程的商務機之一：Global 7500 以 14,260 公里航程同 Mach 0.90 高速巡航直飛香港—北美東岸級別航線，是香港商務機坪的矚目常客。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Launched as the Global 7000 and renamed when range grew to 7,700 nmi; the faster Global 8000 followed. Figures are for the 7500. The photo is a Swiss Air Force Global 7500 (T-787) VIP aircraft landing at Berlin.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 原名 Global 7000，因航程增至 7,700 海里改名 7500；家族後續有更快的 Global 8000。本卡數字為 7500。相片是瑞士空軍的 Global 7500（T-787）政要專機降落柏林。

history.statusZh: 服役中並持續交付（2018 年底投產；用戶以企業、租賃同政府專機為主，機隊持續增長）。
history.statusEn: In service with deliveries continuing (entered service in late 2018; corporate, charter and government operators, with a growing fleet).
